The objective of the game is to form sets and runs of cards, and to get rid of all the cards in your hand before the other players.Each turn, players can draw a card from the stock pile or pick up a card from the discard pile and then discard a card from their hand.Sets consist of three or four cards of the same rank (e.g. J-J-J-J), and runs are three or more cards of the same suit in sequence (e.g. Q-K-A).The game ends when a player has no cards left in their hand or when the stock pile runs out.
Important note: This is a simulation game for entertainment purposes only. Suitable for adults (18 years and older). The objective of the game is to form sets and runs of cards.

This is a classic 4x4 jigsaw puzzle game with 16 scattered pieces split from a complete beauty-themed image. ---
Basic Game Rules
Piece Swap Mechanics
- At the start of each round, the 16 puzzle pieces are randomly shuffled and fill the entire 4x4 grid layout, with each piece being an equal cut of the original complete image.
- Press and hold any puzzle piece, drag it to the position of another target piece, then release your finger to swap the two pieces.
- There are no limits on swap direction or distance; you can adjust pieces repeatedly until they are in the right position.
Auto-Lock Mechanism
Once a puzzle piece is moved to its exact correct position matching the original image, the system will automatically trigger the lock effect. The piece will be fixed in the grid and disabled from further dragging or swapping, with a clear visual indicator to separate completed areas from unadjusted pieces.

---
Level Clear Rules
Core Clear Condition: Restore all 16 puzzle pieces to their correct positions to form a complete, seamless beauty image before the countdown timer at the top of the screen expires.
- If the puzzle is not fully completed when the countdown ends, the round is deemed failed, and you can choose to restart the current level.
- When restarting a failed round, all previously locked pieces will be reset, and the 16 pieces will be randomly shuffled again for a new attempt.

---
Pro Tips for Faster Clearing
- Prioritize edge and corner pieces first: The corner and outer edge pieces of the 4x4 grid have distinctive features, and locking these pieces first helps build the puzzle framework quickly.
- Focus on detailed clues: Use unique details such as facial features, hairstyle, and clothing patterns from the beauty image to match adjacent piece connections accurately.

A TOOL FOR CREATIVES
While Dialed is a game, it is also a workout for your brain. It is the perfect companion for:
Graphic Designers and Illustrators: Sharpen your ability to identify HEX and RGB values on the fly.
Photographers: Improve your eye for color grading and white balance.

Gamers: Anyone who loves easy to learn, impossible to master mechanics.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

Sleek UI: Smooth animations and a minimalist layout that feels right at home on iOS.
Global Leaderboards: Compete for the title of Master of the Spectrum.
Unlockable Themes: Customize your dial and interface as you level up.
Accessibility First: Includes specialized modes for various types of color blindness, ensuring everyone can experience the joy of the hunt.

WHAT THE WORLD IS SAYING
The most satisfying haptic experience I have had on an iPhone. It is like a fidget spinner for your eyes. — AppReview Daily
As a professional painter, I thought this would be easy. I was wrong. Dialed is my new obsession. — User Feedback

Your eyes are capable of seeing millions of colors, but your brain often takes shortcuts. Dialed forces you to slow down, look closer, and truly see. Crimoku is not a game of chance or reflexes. It is a mental challenge designed for fans of clever puzzles. Your mission is to reconstruct the crime scene using pure logic: investigate the mansion, compare the suspects’ statements, and use deduction to find the only possible solution.
How to play:
In each level, you will face a new scenario. You have a house map, a cast of characters, and a set of clues. To win in Crimoku, you must discover:
The exact position of each suspect on the grid.

The identity of the culprit: the person who shares a room with the victim.
Investigation rules
To advance in your detective career, you will need to follow the golden rules of the board:
Unique placement: Two characters can never share the same row or column.
Irrefutable evidence: Every clue you receive is always 100% true.
Spatial logic: Use references such as “next to”, “in the lounge”, or “opposite” to rule out wrong positions.
Grid system: Mark your deductions as “Possible”, “Discarded”, or “Confirmed”, just like in a classic logic puzzle.
Why choose Crimoku
Mental training: Ideal for players looking for thinking games that improve focus and concentration.
Progressive difficulty: From simple cases that teach the mechanics to complex mysteries for expert detectives.
No rush: A relaxing game with no timers, designed to be solved calmly.
Clean interface: A carefully designed visual style that lets you focus on what matters: deduction.
If you enjoy crime riddles, grid-based puzzles, and the satisfaction of seeing every piece fall into place, Crimoku: Mystery and Logic is the original challenge you were waiting for.
Analyze the evidence. Rule out the innocent. Find the culprit. Crimoku is a logic puzzle game where every clue matters. Place the suspects, find the victim and reveal the killer. Crime Logic Puzzle

Every move changes the board and creates new opportunities to find words and clear space with the reaction caused by a tile match.

Letter Tile Match blends classic word puzzle games with the strategy of matching games. Plan each move carefully, choose words that clear maximum space, and meet your objective before you run out of moves. This matching game rewards smart decisions and analytical play. Inspired by the word search genre and word connect games, this free word game for adults offers a fresh take on puzzle gameplay with tile matching.

How to play this letter game

• The goal of this word puzzle is to meet level objectives within a limited number of moves.
• Look at the board and find words using the available letter tiles.
• Tap Submit to remove the selected letter tiles from the grid.
• Obstacles next to removed letters break, and ice beneath the tiles cracks.
• New letter tiles fall from above and create new opportunities to make a tile match.
• Longer words unlock boosters and help clear difficult sections of the board.
• You can't pass a level if you run out of moves before meeting the goal.

How to master this letter-matching game

• Look for longer words that will clear more tiles and free up space on the board.
• Target concentrated groups of obstacles so that one word can break several objects in one go.
• Save simple words for later when you might need a safe move to finish the level.
• Plan ahead and make every move count in this strategic matching game.

Letter Tile Match combines relaxing word games for adults with the satisfying mechanics of match games and tile match puzzles. Matching games for adults and thoughtful word puzzles come together in this game to create a calm and rewarding challenge.

Play Letter Tile Match to find words, solve various levels, and train your brain with engaging word puzzle games.

games.name: Layer Tower
games.description:
I. Core Game Objective
Control the size of building floors with one finger, stack floors with precision to build a skyscraper, challenge your highest floor count and all-time best score, and create your very own city skyline.
II. Basic Controls
All actions can be completed with just one finger on the screen:
Press and hold the screen, and the current pending floor will expand evenly outwards at a constant speed.
Release your finger, and the floor will immediately stop expanding, lock in its current size, and fall vertically to complete a stacking action.
III. Core Game Rules
Foundation BoundaryAt the start of each round, there is a fixed foundation with a standard size, which serves as the maximum allowable boundary for all floors. The final size of any floor must not exceed the scope of the foundation.
Valid StackingWhen the locked size of the released floor is fully within the foundation dimensions, the floor will land securely on the structure below. You will successfully stack 1 floor, your floor count increases by 1, and the game automatically progresses to the next round of floor generation and resizing.
Invalid Placement PenaltyWhen the locked size of the floor exceeds the foundation boundary, the portion that extends beyond the foundation will break off and collapse immediately, while 1 health point will be deducted. The remaining valid portion that fits within the boundary will fall to become the new stackable floor, and the game continues to the next round.
Health SystemYou start each round with 3 default health points. 1 point is deducted for each invalid placement, and there is no way to restore lost health points.
IV. Game Over Conditions
The round ends immediately when either of the following conditions is met:
Your health points are reduced to 0.
After falling, the floor makes no valid contact with the already stacked structure below (completely suspended), which is judged as a stacking failure. Tap to scale floor build tower

Shoot Bullets: No need to adjust the direction (the shooting direction is fixed). Simply tap any area on the screen to fire a bullet. The bullet will fly straight along the preset fixed path, aiming at the target ball area.​
Target Locking: After entering a level, a target ball marked with a clear number (e.g., 1-9) will appear in the center of the screen. The target ball is surrounded by closed colored lines (boundary lines), which are dangerous areas to avoid.​

After elimination, the next target ball (with a randomly changing number) will be unlocked automatically, starting a new round of challenges.​
III. Win/Loss Judgment Rules​
Failure Conditions: If the fired bullet fails to hit the target ball, or if it touches or collides with the surrounding boundary lines of the target ball, the current round will be deemed a failure, and you will need to retry the level. It puts more emphasis on logical planning and organized arrangement, with zero threshold for beginners, strategic depth for ongoing play, and a consistently relaxed, pressure-free experience.
* At the start of each level, multiple transparent vases are displayed, each filled with a random mix of different flower types and colors in a messy stack. Players need to sort and organize all flowers via simple tap controls.

* Sorting Requirement: Each vase can only hold flowers of the same type and color. Flowers must be stacked in order, and the top flower of the target vase must match the selected flower for a successful placement.
* Elimination Mechanism: When a single vase is completely filled with identical flowers with no mixed varieties, it automatically triggers a beautiful bloom elimination animation, completing the sorting requirement for that vase and rewarding players with points and in-game items. games.name: Betano
games.description:
Blast Trivia centers on a straight quiz round with a visible countdown on every question and three lives per run. After you continue from the entry screen into a session, Blast Trivia walks you through ten multiple-choice items. Each time you answer correctly in Blast Trivia, your score increases by a fixed amount. A wrong tap or an expired timer removes one life, and the round can end early if those lives are gone. Blast Trivia keeps the loop simple: read the prompt, tap one of three options, and see color feedback before the next item appears.

Answer order in Blast Trivia is shuffled whenever a question is shown, so the correct response may appear on any of the three answer buttons. That helps Blast Trivia feel fair and discourages guessing by position alone. After you choose, Blast Trivia highlights the right option and, when needed, the option you selected, then continues after a brief pause. Timers reset for each new card, so you always see how much time is left on the current step.

While you play, Blast Trivia shows your current question number out of ten, your score, and lives left. Labels stay visible on the same screen so you can scan the essentials quickly. Blast Trivia does not hide its core rules behind extra menus during a round; the same flow repeats until you finish or run out of lives.

When a run ends in Blast Trivia—because you cleared every question or exhausted your lives—you see a results view with your score, a ratio of correct answers to the full ten-question set, the seconds recorded for the last timer snapshot, and a short outcome line that states whether you cleared the deck or stopped on lives. The Play again control in Blast Trivia creates a new session and opens the next round without sending you back through the entry screen.

Blast Trivia favors steady pacing over long tutorials. The question card stays central, answers sit beneath it, and the header keeps the timer and resources in view. If you want a compact trivia session with a predictable structure, Blast Trivia offers a fixed-length path when you clear every card and an earlier stop when mistakes add up, with immediate visual responses after each choice.

The questions in Blast Trivia cover familiar school-day topics and general knowledge, written for quick reading on a phone. Blast Trivia is written for a general audience and avoids graphic or aggressive themes in its text. Blast Trivia bundles scores, lives, timers, and a tidy recap into one self-contained round after another.

Session details in Blast Trivia update while you play so the results summary can show consistent numbers when the round completes. Blast Trivia stays approachable whether you play a single round or several in one sitting, with the same scoring and life rules whenever you return. Betano - Quick quiz, ten questions, timer, three lives!

games.name: Neck Gather
games.description:
Core Gameplay
The character runs forward automatically—no need to manually control the movement direction. Simply swipe left or right on the screen to maneuver the character horizontally (swipe left to move left, swipe right to move right).
During the run, floating "Energy Rings" will appear. Touching them successfully collects the rings—each ring collected makes the character’s neck lengthen by one segment in real time, and the longer the neck, the more advantages you’ll have.
Various obstacles (such as moving baffles, stationary bollards, and sudden traps) are scattered along the path. Dodge them by swiping horizontally—colliding with any obstacle will shorten the character’s neck, and the game ends when the neck length drops to 0.
Colorful "Transformation Gates" (red, blue, green, yellow, etc.) will randomly spawn on the track. The moment the character passes through a gate, it will automatically change to the gate’s color. Subsequent Energy Rings must match the character’s current color to continue lengthening the neck . Dodge obstacles, collect matching rings to lengthen neck & pass color gates

This is a casual mobile game featuring finger flicking, physics bouncing, and number merging. Simply slide and release to launch number pucks, use physics ricochets to collide identical numbers and merge them into larger values, and challenge higher scores and bigger numbers!
1. Basic Controls (Playable with One Hand)
Launch Preparation
Hold the launch area at the bottom of the screen and slide left/right to adjust the firing angle.
Launch the Puck
Release your finger to instantly shoot out a round puck with a number on it.
Physics Movement
The puck moves freely inside the rectangular arena, bouncing automatically when hitting walls. It bounces randomly until it stops or collides.

I. Game Orientation & Core Objective​
Core Goal: By observing structures, matching tools, and planning sequences, complete all screw removal or assembly tasks—disassemble mechanical devices, return components to their positions, or form complete structures to unlock subsequent levels and rewards.​
II. Basic Operations​
1. Core Operation Logic​
Selecting Screws: Tap any screw on the screen.​
Placing Screws: After removal, screws must be placed into storage slots.​
III. Core Gameplay & Level Types​
1. Three Core Modes​
(1) Puzzle Disassembly Mode​
Rule: Screws must be removed in a logical sequence — prioritize removing outer supporting screws first, then inner fixing screws. An incorrect order will cause the structure to jam, requiring level reset or use of the "Step Rewind" item.​
IV. Clearance Tips & Notes​
Observe First: At the start of the level, browse the entire structure and mark load-bearing screws (key screws supporting core components) to avoid jamming due to incorrect removal.​
Avoid Blind Operations: When encountering intersecting screws, try removing one first, observe structural changes, and then decide on the next target screw. Remove screws logically, avoid jams, unlock levels.

Story

The first day of the long holiday.
When I woke up, I was in my room.

…But something felt off.

Suddenly, my computer turned on by itself, displaying a disturbing message:

“You have work. Get ready now.”

Panicking, I tried to leave the room—but the door wouldn’t open.
I couldn’t find the key anywhere.

—I need to get ready for work, but I can’t even leave my house.

At this rate, I’ll be late.
I have to find a way out of here—

About the Game

This is an escape game set inside your home.
Explore each room, collect items, solve puzzles, and find your way out.

Everyday furniture and objects hide unexpected tricks and mechanisms.

Features
Completely free to play until the end
Beginner-friendly difficulty, perfect even for newcomers
Hint and answer system available to match your progress
Lively interactions using familiar home environments
Auto-save for both progress and puzzle states
How to Play

Simple and intuitive controls:

Explore: Tap to investigate
Move: Tap areas of interest or use the arrows at the bottom of the screen
Select Items: Tap item icons at the top
Use Items: Select an item, then tap where you want to use it
Hints: Access from the MENU button in the top-left corner
Recommended For
Fans of escape games
Players who enjoy solving puzzles
Those looking for a game they can play in short sessions
Anyone who likes mysterious and slightly eerie stories
From the Developer

This game was created by a solo developer.
I’m constantly experimenting and improving to make enjoyable experiences for players.

If you like this game, please check out my other apps as well!

My holiday… has yet to begin.

games.name: 16 Bead Fun: Online Sholo Guti
games.description:
16 Beads Game is one of the most loved traditional board games in India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and other South Asian countries. This classic 16 goti game is also known as 16 bit strategy board game where two players compete using skill, patience, and smart planning. In India, this game is known by many names such as Sur Baggi, 16 Koti, 16 Khadi Game, 16 Sal, 16 Goti, 16 Beads Game, Bagh Bakri, Baghchal, and Bara Tehni. This timeless game is cherished by players of all ages.

The 16 goti ka game is played by moving beads on a lined board and capturing opponent pieces by jumping over them. Because of its simple rules and deep strategy, many people compare this 16 bit game with classic board games like checkers. Whether you play casually or competitively, this 16 beads game keeps your mind active and engaged.

In different regions, this game is known by different namesIn Bangladesh 🇧🇩, it is popularly played as BaghChal, while in other regions it is known as Bagh Bakri and other traditional forms.. In India 🇮🇳, players call it 16 koti, 16 khadi game, sur baggi, or sola khadi game. Across villages and cities, this 16 sal board game has been part of childhood memories for generations. Internationally, many players also know it as Sixteen Soldiers or bead strategy game.

This 16 bit, 16 beads game, also known as 16bit, 16 Koti, 16 Khadi Game, 16 Sal, or 16 Goti Ka Game, follows simple rules that anyone can understand. Each player starts with sixteen beads placed on the board. Players take turns moving their beads and capturing opponent pieces through smart jumps. The goal is simple: capture all opponent beads to win the match.

Rules:

◉ Capture all opponent 16 beads to win
◉ Strategic jumps allow you to remove opponent pieces
◉ Smart positioning is the key to victory

Game Features ❤️

Local Multiplayer Offline (2 Players) 😍
◉ Play with friends and family on the same device
◉ No internet needed – enjoy 16 bead offline game anytime

games.name: BLFFD
games.description:
BLFFD is the ultimate digital party game where your ability to lie is just as important as your knowledge. Designed for 2 to 20 players, this high-stakes trivia game challenges you to create the most believable fake answers to trick your friends while you try to hunt down the actual truth. Whether you are hosting a small game night or a massive online gathering, BLFFD delivers a seamless and competitive experience that keeps everyone on their toes.

The game flow is designed to be fast-paced and engaging. It begins in the Lobby, where the host can customize settings including language, total rounds, and categories. Once the game starts, the system shuffles the turn order and assigns a Chooser. This player selects a category, and our smart deprioritization algorithm picks a question that players in the room have seen the least, ensuring every round feels fresh and unpredictable.

During the Bluffing phase, everyone must submit a fake answer. To keep the game challenging and fair, BLFFD features a sophisticated cross-language blocking system. It checks your submission against the correct answer and its synonyms across all supported languages. If your bluff is too close to the truth, the game will prompt you to try again. This phase also introduces the Buff Bluff mechanic. Each player gets one chance per game to activate a Buff Bluff. If you successfully fool your friends while this is active, you earn double the points for every person you trick.

Once all bluffs are in, the Voting phase begins. All fake answers are mixed with the real one and shuffled. You must cast your vote for the answer you believe is correct, but you are strictly forbidden from voting for your own bluff. Scoring is simple but competitive: you get 2 points for finding the correct answer and 1 point for every player who falls for your bluff. If you use your Buff Bluff strategically, those points can stack up quickly and shift the leaderboard in an instant.

The Reveal phase is where the chaos happens. The host controls the pacing as the game unveils who submitted which bluff and who was fooled by them. At the end of the set number of rounds, the game checks for a winner. If there is a tie at the top of the leaderboard, BLFFD automatically triggers extra tie-breaker rounds until a single champion is crowned.

Technical reliability is at the core of the BLFFD experience. The game features robust reconnection logic, allowing players to jump back into their session if they lose their connection. It also includes ghost cleanup to remove inactive players during the lobby or end-game phases, and server time synchronization to ensure all timers are accurate for every participant.

Whether you are a master of deception or just looking for a laugh with friends, BLFFD offers a unique blend of trivia and social strategy. Download BLFFD today, set up your lobby, and see who among your friends is the ultimate bluffing champion. Outsmart friends in BLFFD! Create clever lies, find the truth, and win.

Survey the main parking lot and identify vehicles of matching colors.

Check each vehicle's path carefully. Select only cars that are unblocked and can accelerate safely out of the lot.

Tap or click a vehicle to make it drive away, off the screen, and into the leftmost open space in the upper parking area.

Your goal is to fill the upper spaces with three cars of the same color lined up side by side.

Successfully match three to clear them from the board and make room for more cars.

If your upper parking fills up with no possible matches, all vehicles will lose their colors, and the game is lost.

Clear all vehicles from the main lot to win the level!

A unique hybrid of parking puzzles and match-3 gameplay

一筆書きパズルは、古くから親しまれてきた知的遊びです。すべての星をつなげた時の達成感、あと一歩で行き止まりになるハラハラ感、そしてもう一度挑戦したくなる中毒性…Powl星つなぎは、そんな一筆書きパズルの楽しさを美しい星空の世界観で体験できるゲームです。直感的な操作で誰でもすぐに遊び始められ、1プレイ数分で完結するので、通勤・通学中や休憩時間、寝る前のひとときなど、いつでもどこでも楽しめます。

Enjoy real-time chat during your Mancala games. Talk to friends in private matches or interact with opponents while playing live.


📝 THE RULES OF MANCALA
Mancala (Kalaha) is a classic two-player strategy board game played on a board with twelve pockets and two stores. At the start of the game, each pocket contains four stones. Players take turns picking up all stones from one of their pockets and distributing them counter-clockwise, placing one stone in each pocket and their own store while skipping the opponent’s store.

If the last stone lands in your store, you earn an extra turn. If the last stone lands in an empty pocket on your side and the opposite pocket contains stones, you capture those stones and move them to your store. The game ends when one player has no stones left in their pockets or when a player concedes. The player with the most stones in their store wins.

Mancala is known around the world by many different names, including Congklak, Mangala, Sungka, Ô ăn quan, Congkak, Igisoro, Kalaha, Oware (Awale), Pallanguli, Dakon, Bao, Bohnenspiel and more.

games.name: The Urban Rewind
games.description:
The Urban Rewind is a timed, multiple-choice trivia game centered on music and pop culture. Players test their knowledge across entertainment categories while managing a virtual currency system (“Mics”), unlocking achievements, and progressing through tiered levels.

Categories & Access

At launch, players have access to:
* Hip-Hop
* R&B

The TV and Movies categories are visible but locked, indicated with a lock icon.

Players begin with 3 Mics. Locked categories and additional Mics can be purchased via in-app purchases. Tapping a locked category or “Buy Mics” opens the checkout interface with the correct product and pricing.

On successful purchase:
* Mic balances or category access update immediately.
* If a category is unlocked, the user is automatically taken to that category’s “Good Luck” screen.
On failed or canceled transactions:
* The user returns to the previous screen.
* No changes are made to access or Mic balance.

Players can assign purchased Mics to specific categories from the Play screen. During active gameplay, Mics default to the current category but may be adjusted.

Gameplay & Mic Rules

Each session presents one question at a time with four answer choices (A/B/C/D). After selecting an answer, players receive immediate feedback (“Correct” or “Incorrect”) along with explanatory text.

Mics function as the attempt system:
* A player is not considered to have lost while 1 Mic remains.
* If prompted to purchase Mics at this stage, the gameplay timer resets to 10 seconds once the prompt is accepted or dismissed.
A loss occurs only when the Mic count reaches 0.
* When this happens, the session ends and a Results screen is displayed.
* If a user purchases Mics after reaching 0, they cannot resume the ended session. They must restart the category from 0 correct answers (clean restart), though they may restart within their highest unlocked level band.
* After purchasing Mics following a loss, users are redirected to the Home screen.

Leveling & Progression
Each category features a cumulative badge system. All badges are grayed out at the start.

Level thresholds:
* Gold: 15 correct answers
* Platinum: 20 additional correct answers
* Multi-Platinum: 25 additional correct answers
* Diamond: 30 additional correct answers

Levels must be completed sequentially.

Once Diamond is achieved:
* The category is considered complete.
* The user is routed back to the beginning to replay the category.
* The Diamond badge remains visible until Gold is reached again during replay.

The highest level achieved in each category is permanently recorded. If a user exits or loses, they resume from the difficulty band of their highest unlocked level rather than starting from the beginning.

Audio & Sponsor Integration

Sponsor-provided background music (Artist + Title) plays on:
* Splash screen
* Login screen
* Rules screen
* Category selection screen

Music is ON by default when the app launches or when returning to the main screen. Users may tap a track to open an external link (e.g., Spotify or social media) in their browser.

During gameplay:
* Correct and Incorrect sound effects play for every question.
* On level-up, a dedicated Level-Up sound plays, and background music is temporarily paused.

UI & Session Management
Before starting any category, users see a “Good Luck” screen displaying their current level.

If a user leaves mid-session, the app saves:
* Question index
* Mic count
* Progress

Upon returning, users are prompted to Continue or Start Over.

A Results screen appears when:
* The user exits,
* A level threshold is reached, or
* Mics reach 0.

The Results screen displays total correct and incorrect answers, Mic changes, and the next milestone required for level advancement. Step up to the mic! Test your throwback knowledge in Hip-Hop, R&B, TV & movies.

PulseGrids presents a unique casual logic puzzle experience focused on rhythm and spatial reasoning. Inspired by cellular automata and light pulse propagation, the rules are highly straightforward.

The game board consists of a 7x7 grid. Each cell is either in an active state or a silent state. Your interaction is to tap on any cell, sending a pulse. This pulse flips the tapped cell's state and simultaneously flips the state of its four orthogonally adjacent neighbors.

The objective is to silence the entire board using the minimum number of taps. You must strategize and calculate the exact sequences required to reach a unified silent state. games.name: Arrow Rush 3D
games.description:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube

► LETTER BY LETTER

Listen up cryptogram, crossword, and word puzzle fiends: there’s an exciting new word game on the block and you don’t want to miss out! Quotegram is the cryptogram word brain puzzle of choice for anyone who’s a pro at decoding games, because here, you’ll need to decode the puzzle and fill in the missing letters to reveal the quote. Each level you’ll be presented with a quote, and it’s up to you to put your brain to the test and decode what letters are missing from each word, similar to a crossword puzzle. While some quotes may be pretty famous and therefore easy to guess, as you progress through the levels this cryptogram logic puzzle will really throw you for a loop. But it’s not all hard work – along the way you’ll come across a variety of inspiring and fun quotes from all walks of life to help keep you going when the going gets tough.

► Fancy features: 

● Customize your play  – The point of this cryptogram decoding game is to work on your logic skills, not stress, so we’ve created the ultimate space to do so. Pick which background you’d like to have while working on the puzzles, and choose the soundtrack that best fits your mood. You’re also sure to love the simple graphics and no-frills interface that make guessing words a cinch.

● Give your brain a workout  – We’ve all heard that crossword puzzles and other word games are good for our minds, but sometimes doing the same type over and over again gets stale. By having to not only guess the word based on the letters available, but also the quote as a whole, you’re kicking the brain into gear and really upping the potential benefits.

● Relax as you learn  – All work and no play… no need to fill in the rest, you’re sure to know it! It is true though, there’s no need to stress yourself out working on difficult brain puzzles. Sit back and relax while you play thanks to the customization aspect – not only does that make it more fun, but it really creates the right mood for focusing on decoding the cryptogram and learning.
 
► TRAIN YOUR BRAIN 

Ready, set, guess the word! Gone are the days when the only word game out there was a boring old crossword. Quotegram takes your standard cryptogram word game and adds an extra fun twist by using famous quotes instead. Levels increase in difficulty to keep you on your toes, while the customizable music and background keep the mood chill. 

This decoding game contains inspirational messages that you’ll need to uncover, letter by letter as you discover or rediscover exciting quotes, boost your brain thanks to the power of logic puzzles, and have some good old-fashioned word game fun! ● Plan Ahead: Every level has a limited number of moves, so smart decisions are the key to victory.

games.name: Arrow Sort
games.description:
Ready for a fresh twist on the sort puzzle genre? Arrow Sort is a colorful and satisfying sorting game where you pick arrows from the board, collect them in your hand, and complete matching color sets to clear the level.

The rules are simple. Tap an arrow on the board to pick it up and add it to your hand. Fill a color set by collecting all the arrows of the same color. Complete every set to beat the level. Sounds easy? Think again — your hand has limited space, and every move shifts the arrows around you.

How to Play
Arrows sit on a grid, and each one points in a direction. When you pick up an arrow, the ones behind it slide forward to fill the gap. Plan your picks carefully — choosing the wrong arrow can block the ones you need. Fill your hand slots, complete color sets before you run out of room, and watch the board clear piece by piece.

Satisfying Sort Puzzle Gameplay
Arrow Sort takes the color sorting concept and adds a layer of spatial thinking. Unlike a simple matching game, you need to read the board, spot which arrows will shift when others are removed, and figure out the best order to collect each set. Every level is a fresh logic puzzle that keeps your brain working.

Powerful Boosts When You Need Them
Stuck on a tricky level? Use powerups to turn things around:
- Free Escape — return an arrow from your hand back to the board
- Add Next Set — bring in the next color set early to open up new moves
- +1 Hand Slot — expand your hand capacity for extra breathing room

Pick your powerups before a level or use them mid-game when it counts.
Hundreds of Levels
Start with simple boards and work your way through increasingly complex layouts. New arrow colors, larger grids, and trickier set combinations keep the challenge growing. Whether you have two minutes or twenty, there is always a level waiting for you.

Play On Your Terms
No time pressure. No move counters rushing you. Take your time, think through each pick, and enjoy a relaxing color sort experience at your own pace. If a level gets the better of you, use Play On to add extra hand slots and keep going.

Features
- Unique arrow sorting mechanic with grid-based movement
- Easy to pick up, hard to put down
- Colorful and polished puzzle design
- Strategic powerups to master tough levels
- Coin rewards and daily bonuses
- Shop with useful boosters and bundles
- Lives system so you can always come back for more
- Smooth, satisfying animations with every match

If you love brain teasers, sort puzzles, or color matching games, Arrow Sort delivers a fresh challenge that is easy to learn and endlessly fun to play. Download now and see how many sets you can sort! Sort colorful arrows, match sets & clear the board in this addictive puzzle game

games.name: Sweetegree
games.description:
Sweetegree is a colorful puzzle game where matching is not just about finding the same picture — it is about finding the right temperature balance.

Every fruit on the board has a state: some are too hot, others are frozen cold. Your goal is to pair them with the right fridge tile and bring everything back to the perfect sweet degree.

Tap two tiles, check the temperature rule, and make the match before the timer runs out. The faster you read the board, the longer you survive.

A Simple Idea with a Clever Rule

Hot fruits need a fridge that is cold enough.
Frozen fruits need a fridge that is warm enough.

That small twist turns every board into a quick logic challenge. You are not just matching icons — you are comparing temperatures, planning taps, and looking for the best pair under pressure.

Successful matches slide together with smooth animations, refill your timer, and help you build momentum toward a higher score.

Different Ways to Play

Random Mode
Play fast, unpredictable rounds where boards change, layers shuffle, and the timer keeps pushing you forward. Great for short sessions and score chasing.

Orders Mode
Serve fruit orders for customers. Each ticket asks for specific fruits and temperatures, so you need to scan the board carefully and complete the request in time.

Level Builder
Choose the fruits you want to play with and let Sweetegree create a custom puzzle board around your selection.

Draw Your Own
Build your own level tile by tile using the in-game editor. Design the board, set up the challenge, and play your own temperature puzzle.

What Makes Sweetegree Different
• Matching based on temperature logic, not just identical tiles
• Hot and frozen versions of each fruit
• Six fruit types with different visual states
• Multi-layer boards that reveal new decisions as you play
• Timer refill system that rewards fast and accurate matches
• Orders mode with goal-based challenges
• Built-in tools for custom and hand-made levels
• High scores, coins, and game history saved automatically
• Smooth tile movement and satisfying match feedback
• Offline play with no lives system and no waiting between attempts
• Made for Quick Thinking

Sweetegree is easy to start, but every round asks you to pay attention. Is the fruit hot or frozen? Is the fridge temperature right? Is there a better pair hidden under another layer?

Each match is small, but the decisions add up quickly.

Play a short round, chase a new record, complete customer orders, or create your own puzzle layout.

Find the right temperature. Match the fruit. Reach the perfect Sweetegree. Hot fruit, frozen fruit, one perfect Sweetegree. Read the temperature, tap the right fridge, clear tricky layers, and build sweet combos fast.

games.description:
**Items:** A deck of cards (using only Aces (1)–10, 40 cards total)
**Objective:** Be the last player still able to play a card.
How to Play
1. Draw a "number line" in the center of the table, starting with **5** (marked with a card).
2. Each player is dealt **5 cards**, with the remaining cards piled to one side.
3. Each player must play one card and move the number line:
- When playing a **red card** (hearts, diamonds), the number line moves **+** the card's face value.
- When playing a **black card** (spades, clubs), the number line moves **−** the card's face value.
- The number line cannot exceed **20** or fall below **0**, otherwise the play is invalid, and the player must discard the card and draw a card to end the turn.
4. If a player cannot play a card (all cards in hand would result in an out-of-bounds move), they are **eliminated**. 5. The last player standing wins. Can you be the last player still able to play a card?

-  Unlock more space as you progress

-  Reveal the Pixel art image

-  A puzzle built around space, order, and movement

CREATE YOUR PLAYERS & START THE FUN
Start by setting up your group. Add multiple players, type in their names, and choose unique colored avatars for everyone. You can add as many friends as you want to join the fun, making it the ideal group game for both small gatherings and massive house parties.

TWO GAME MODES: CLASSIC & DRINKING
Choose the perfect vibe for your gathering with two distinct ways to play:
• Classic Mode: Compete for points. Answer your truth honestly or complete your dare successfully to earn a point. If you refuse, you get nothing! Play strategically and aim for the top of the leaderboard.
• Drinking Mode: Turn your truth or dare session into an interactive drinking game! In this mode, if you fail a challenge, refuse to answer, or want to skip a card, you must take a shot. The game features a built-in shot tracker to count exactly how many drinks each person has consumed.

INTUITIVE SWIPE MECHANICS & TIMERS
The gameplay is simple, sleek, and highly interactive. When it is your turn, you face the classic choice on your screen.
• Swipe Left to choose a Truth.
• Swipe Right to choose a Dare.
• Can't decide? Tap the Random button and let fate choose for you.
Once your card is revealed, you can complete the task and tap "Done", or tap "Failed" / "Drink instead" if you back out. Not feeling the card? Hit the Reroll button to get a new prompt! Plus, some intense dares even come with a built-in on-screen timer to add extra pressure as you race against the clock!

8 UNIQUE PACKS FOR EVERY MOOD
Customize your gameplay by choosing from eight specially crafted card packs. The game allows you to seamlessly switch between different categories mid-game, so you can transition from lighthearted fun to extreme challenges whenever the group is ready.
1. Party Starter: Start the night right. The ideal warm-up with balanced questions and fun challenges to get everyone comfortable and laughing.
2. Icebreaker: Easy chats, zero awkwardness. Perfect for getting to know each other, breaking the silence, and starting casual conversations with new friends.
3. Embarrassing Fun: Maximum cringe, maximum laughs. Face hilarious, awkward situations and funny tasks that will leave the entire room in tears.
4. 18+: No filters. Just heat. A spicy, dirty truth or dare pack made exclusively for adults. Expect mature themes, intimate adult party game questions, and bold challenges.
5. Deep Talk: Questions worth thinking about. Step away from the crazy antics and dive into meaningful, thoughtful, and profound discussions.
6. Romantic Spark: Cute, flirty, closer. A fantastic couples game pack for partners or crushes looking to connect on a deeper, romantic level.
7. Hardcore: No mercy. No safe picks. Extreme questions and relentless challenges that will test your absolute limits.
8. Absurd Mode: Logic left the room. Completely ridiculous, chaotic, and weird prompts for those who enjoy pure, unpredictable nonsense.

DYNAMIC LEADERBOARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS
Keep track of the action with an active in-game leaderboard that displays the current round, whose turn it is, total scores, and the number of shots taken by each player. Even if the game ends mid-round, you will be taken to the "Party Legends" final podium screen. Here, the top players are awarded gold, silver, and bronze medals based on their points. The app also tracks all drinking stats and awards the hilarious "Party Animal" achievement to the specific player who consumed the most shots during the match.

Download now and experience a modern, interactive truth or dare game! Fun party drinking app for parties, couples & friends! Fun 18+ adult dirty dares

games.name: Multiplying Dead
games.description:
Game Core Overview
This is a casual level-based shooting mobile game that blends auto-firing, parkour movement and math calculation mechanics. It boasts ultra-simple controls and full strategic depth. Players take full control of a weapon unit that moves forward automatically, dodge obstacles and pick calculation gates via left-right positioning, multiply the weapon count through math operations, clear enemies along the way, and challenge higher levels and scores!
I. Basic Controls (Zero Threshold for Beginners)
1. Core Movement Rules
Auto Forward Movement: The weapon moves forward continuously once entering a level, with no manual forward control required, freeing your hands to focus on positioning.
Left-Right Control: Hold and swipe left/right on the screen to control the weapon’s horizontal movement and switch lane positions.
Auto Firing: The weapon fires bullets nonstop throughout the game, no tapping to shoot needed; it attacks enemies on sight and maintains full firepower at all times.
II. Core Gameplay: Multiply Weapons via Math Calculation
The core thrill of the game lies in changing the weapon count by passing through math gates — choose the calculation gates wisely to build an ultra-powerful firepower army!
1. Math Gate Mechanics
Gates marked with math calculations (such as ×2, +28, -10, ÷2, etc.) appear along the level path; the corresponding calculation takes effect instantly when the weapon passes through the gate.
Real-Time Weapon Count Change: The calculation result directly applies to the current weapon count. Buff gates greatly boost firepower, while debuff gates weaken combat effectiveness.
You start with 1 basic weapon by default. Each additional weapon means extra fire output, drastically improving enemy-clearing efficiency. Swipe to move, pick math gates, multiply weapons & shoot enemies nonstop!

games.name: Aqua Nexus Pipe
games.description:
Game Core
This is a casual puzzle game where you solve levels by planning paths and connecting pipes.The game map is laid out on a grid. At the start, only colored ports appear on the map with no pre-built pipes.You must draw paths manually to connect matching-color ports and pair all ports to clear the level.
Core Rules
Connection RuleOnly two ports of the same color can be connected. Ports of different colors cannot be linked.Each color has exactly one pair of ports. You must create a pipe path for each matching pair.
Pipe PlacementYou control pipe placement manually. Pipes can run straight or turn along the grid, allowing free route planning.Pipes must form a single, continuous, unbroken path to fully connect the two ports of the same color.
Restriction RulePipes must never cross or overlap each other.If your pipe intersects or overlaps any existing or currently placed pipe, placement fails and you must undo and re-plan the route. Connect same-color ports with pipes. No crossing paths in this puzzle game.

games.description:
Your voice is your weapon.
True Headache is a multiplayer party mini-game collection controlled entirely by your microphone. Shout, bark, read aloud, and shoot — 4 wildly different voice games that'll have you laughing until it hurts every round!

— GAME MODES —

【Tug of War Shout】30-second Endurance Battle
Keep shouting to pull the rope forward! Louder = more pulling power, but your voice gets tired — shout too hard and you'll enter "voice-out" mode, completely stuck. Three escalating thresholds force you to scream louder and louder. Steady output or all-out explosion? The strategy is yours.

【Bark Battle】15-second Rhythm Battle
Pick a dog breed and bark at your phone! 9 breeds from quick-fire small dogs to heavy-hitting big dogs, each with totally different gameplay: Terriers rapid-fire; muscle dogs charge and one-shot. Hit the beat for combo bonuses — it's not just about who barks loudest, but who barks best.

【Cringe Read-Aloud】60-second Courage Battle
Embarrassing sentences pop up on screen — you must read them loudly, clearly, and quickly! Voice recognition judges accuracy. Louder = higher score, faster = bigger multiplier. Playing in public? Now THAT'S a cringe moment.

【Gun Duel】Shout to Shoot
Voice-powered physics gunfight! Making noise = pulling the trigger. Both sides hold one gun and shoot at each other. Run out of HP and you lose; KO your opponent mid-game for an instant win. Different vibe from the first 3, but same rule — you gotta shout.

— MATCH MODE —

Tap "Start PK" and the system randomly draws 3 rounds to form a BO3 match. You and your opponent each complete three rounds, comparing total wins. After the match, settle rank points and climb the ladder with skill.

— PRACTICE MODE —

Don't want ranked? Pick any game and practice solo — no match counts, pure voice training.

— FEATURES —

· Voice is your controller — no screen tapping, entirely voice-controlled
· 4 distinct game modes — endurance/rhythm/courage/shooting, fresh every time
· BO3 match system — best of 3, full strategy
· 9 dog breeds to choose — fast attack or heavy hit, your style
· Rank point system — every PK matters
· Anti-cheat design — random yelling/audio players/white noise all ineffective

Friend groups, family game nights, road trips, beach days, weekend hangouts — anytime you need.

HOW IMPOSTER WORKS
1. Pass the phone. Each player sees their role and the secret word — except the imposter.

games.name: Dial Tone - Rhythm Game
games.description:
Dial Tone is a rhythm game where you make the music.

Three concentric rings glow on a dark screen, divided into quarter notes, eighth notes, and sixteenth notes. Lasers fire in from the corners, placing colored blocks onto the rings. A beat hand sweeps like a clock, and every block it passes plays a note. Your job: rotate the rings and fill one completely to clear it.

But here‘s the catch. As outer rings fill up, they become obstacles. A laser that collides with the wrong ring ends the game. The fuller the rings get, the more you‘re juggling, and the more complex the music becomes.

There are no points. Your score is the tempo. You start slow, and every time you clear a ring, the BPM ticks up. How fast can you go?

The music is yours. No two sessions sound the same. Every block you place adds notes to a chord. The result is a polyrhythmic, ever-changing composition that you‘re building as you play. A song that no one has heard before and no one will hear again.

WHAT MAKES DIAL TONE DIFFERENT

Unlike traditional rhythm games, you don‘t follow a pre-made song. The music emerges from your gameplay. Every session produces a unique piece shaped by your decisions, your reflexes, and the rising tempo.

The interaction is pure and tactile: spin the rings with your finger like a rotary dial. No tapping to a beat. No memorizing patterns. Just a fluid, physical mechanic that starts meditative and becomes frantic.

DESIGNED WITH CARE

• Dial Tone honors iOS Accessibility settings for color filtering, reduced motion, and sensitivity to flashing lights.
• Tiny download. Everything — visuals, music, and gameplay — is generated in code.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions. No tracking. No internet connection required. Just you and the game. Spin the rings. Build the beat. No two games sound the same. A rhythm game where every session creates its own evolving song. The faster you go, the wilder it gets. The Beat Is Calling

games.name: Mythic Bouncer
games.description:
In **Mythic Bouncer**, the player finds themselves amidst ancient celestial temples, hovering high above the clouds. The hero wields a bronze shield adorned with Greek motifs—the very tool used to control the movement of a divine orb. The orb continuously ricochets off walls, the ceiling, and the hero's shield, hurtling toward the stone structures that must be destroyed. Each precise deflection alters the orb's trajectory and brings the player closer to the moment when the celestial expanse is finally cleared of these ancient edifices.

In **Mythic Bouncer**, everything revolves around the rhythm of the orb's movement and the precision of the player's reactions. The player maneuvers the shield from side to side, striving to prevent the orb from falling away. Should it slip past and vanish beyond the boundaries of the playing field, the attempt ends in the loss of a life. Thus, every bounce becomes a small test of mindfulness and control.

The stone buildings in **Mythic Bouncer** vary in size and durability. Smaller structures crumble quickly, while massive temples can withstand multiple impacts before shattering into pieces. With every hit, the stone blocks crack and gradually disintegrate, clearing the sky and earning points for the player. The more massive the building, the more challenging it is to destroy—and the more valuable the reward for a successful strike.

Occasionally, a golden artifact appears amidst the ruins. If the player manages to catch it with their shield, a rare and delightful event occurs in **Mythic Bouncer**: a second orb appears in the sky, and a lost life is restored. Now, two orbs move simultaneously along different trajectories, making the action even more dynamic and demanding the player's absolute concentration.

As the game of **Mythic Bouncer** progresses, the celestial space is gradually cleared of temples, and the pace of movement becomes increasingly rapid and precise. A mechanic that appears simple at first glance transforms into a meditative yet tense test of reflexes, where every bounce can prove decisive. Reflect the celestial orb with your shield and destroy ancient temples.

Callbreak – Offline Card Game (Simple, Smooth & Fun Experience)

Looking for a simple, enjoyable, and strategic card game that you can play anytime without internet? This Callbreak game is designed for players who love clean gameplay, smooth controls, and a relaxing experience without unnecessary complexity.

Built with a focus on offline play, this version of Callbreak lets you enjoy the classic card game anywhere—no connection needed. Whether you are playing during travel, at home, or with friends nearby, the game provides a consistent and engaging experience powered by intelligent AI opponents.

About the Game

Callbreak (also known as Lakadi or Lakdi) is a popular trick-based card game widely played in Nepal and India. It uses a standard 52-card deck and is played among four players, where each player receives 13 cards.

The main objective is to predict (call) the number of tricks you can win in a round and then play strategically to achieve that target. Spades act as the trump suit, adding depth and decision-making to every move. The player with the highest score after all rounds wins the game.

What Makes This Callbreak Special

Simple and Clean Gameplay
The game focuses on clarity and ease of use. No confusing menus or complex systems—just straightforward Callbreak the way it should be played.

Play anytime without needing internet. The game is optimized for offline use with smooth performance and no interruptions.

Compete against well-designed AI players that provide a balanced challenge. Suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

games.name: Zishes – Marketplace
games.description:
Zishes is a fully skill-based competitive app designed to offer an engaging, transparent, and fair experience where all outcomes are determined solely by user performance. The platform allows users to participate in interactive challenges across a range of categories, and every result is based entirely on measurable skill factors such as accuracy, timing, consistency, and speed, with no elements of luck or chance involved. 
Users can freely explore and practice challenges through limited free-to-play sessions and futher using Skill Charge as simple gameplay energy to enter skill zone rounds. Skill Charge may be replenished through in-app purchases but cannot be used to enter tournaments, cannot be exchanged or redeemed for any value, does not influence results, and cannot be converted into rewards or progression. 
Competitive access is instead determined by the Victory Meter, an earned-only progression system that increases as users perform well in practice challenges. Victory Meter cannot be purchased, cannot be converted into money, and exists strictly as an indicator of skill mastery that unlocks challenges participation. All tournaments follow predetermined rules and transparent timing systems, and prizes are awarded strictly based on user performance, with no randomness, probability, or automated selection of any kind. 
Zishes includes no gambling or simulated gambling features, no betting or wagering, no loot boxes, no randomized outcomes, no cash prizes, no withdrawals, and no mechanics that resemble games of chance. Every aspect of gameplay is deterministic and skill driven, and users may practice at no cost before choosing to compete. The platform emphasizes responsible participation, fairness, and clarity, providing users with detailed rules, clear scoring explanations, and transparent tournament structures. 
Zishes is designed to ensure that no user gains any competitive advantage by spending money, as paid features are limited solely to replenishing Skill Charge for practice and do not influence tournament eligibility or outcomes. All rewards are fixed, predefined, and awarded only according to performance metrics that can be measured, repeated, and verified. The Victory Meter maintains a safe and compliant separation between earned gameplay progression and paid functionality, ensuring that tournament access is entirely merit based. 
Zishes promotes a safe and enjoyable environment with strong fair-play protections, anti-abuse measures, participation limits, and clearly stated guidelines to maintain competitive integrity. The platform does not support gambling of any kind, does not host chance-based contests, and never allows users to wager, stake, or win real money. All participation is voluntary, all results are skill determined, and every user has equal opportunity to succeed by improving their performance. 
Zishes is built to make competitive digital experiences enjoyable, transparent, and responsible, offering a secure and non-gambling skill environment that rewards mastery, practice, and genuine player ability. The Skill-Based Marketplace.

games.name: Shan Koe Mee
games.description:
This mini-game was sponsored by M9 Asia Myanmar.

Designed for fans of strategy and luck, this version is built strictly for entertainment. No real money, no risks—just pure, offline gameplay against our smart AI. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a beginner looking to learn the rules, this app offers the perfect digital playground.

🃏 How to Play
The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

🌟 Key Features
100% Free to Play: No real money involved. Play for fun, anytime, anywhere.

Play Offline: No internet? No problem. Challenge our computer AI and sharpen your skills.

Smooth Gameplay: Enjoy clean graphics and an intuitive interface designed for a seamless mobile experience.

Authentic Rules: Perfectly mirrors the traditional Myanmar scoring system.

💡 Why Choose Our Shan Koe Mee?
This app is perfect for those who want to enjoy the cultural heritage of Myanmar gaming without the pressure of gambling. It’s a game of wits, luck, and quick thinking!

Download now and see if you can hit a 9! Shan Koe Mee - The most beloved card mini-game right on your phone

Patches: The Ultimate Rectangle Logic Puzzle - inspired by Shikaku

6×6 · 10×10 · 12×12 · 20×20 · 30×30 and 5 different shapes!

Dive into Patches, the addictive logic puzzle based on Shikaku, the classic Japanese grid-dividing game - also known as Rectangles or Divide by Box. If you love Shikaku puzzles and want to put your spatial reasoning to the test, Patches is the perfect rectangle logic puzzle for you!
Your goal: Partition the grid into rectangles and squares so that each shape contains exactly one numbered clue matching its area. The unique twist: Each clue also tells you the shape direction: Square, wide, tall, free, or any!

How to Play Patches:
1. Every cell contains a shape icon and a number. The number indicates how many cells your rectangle must span.
2. Draw rectangles by dragging across the grid. A valid selection appears in orange; an invalid one turns red. To undo a rectangle, simply tap it.
3. Your goal is to tile the entire grid so that every cell belongs to exactly one rectangle. No empty cells, no overlapping.

The Five Shape Types:
◾ Square: Equal width and height.
◾ Wide: Width exceeds height.
◾ Tall: Height exceeds width.
◾ Free: Any proportion, but the cell count is fixed.
◾ Any: No restrictions whatsoever.

These five constraints are what give every puzzle its distinct challenge.

Features:
• Daily Challenges: A fresh Patches logic puzzle every day – keep your streak alive!
• Multiple Board Sizes: From compact 6×6 grids to massive 20×20 boards – plus 10×10, 12×12 and more. Choose the rectangle puzzle size that matches your skill level!

games.name: Pirots
games.description:
Pirots centers around memory, attention, and short rounds where your goal is to accurately replicate a sequence you’ve just seen. At the start of each level, the game displays a set of fruits on the board, giving the player a few seconds to memorize their positions. The images then disappear, and the second phase of the challenge begins: you must tap on all the fruits in the correct sequence, relying solely on your memory and the provided ordering cue.

In Pirots, each round becomes slightly more difficult. Initially, there are only two fruits on the board, making the task seem simple; however, as you progress, the number of items increases, making it harder to retain the entire sequence in your mind. A single mistake—or running out of time before completing your selection—immediately results in having to restart the round. This creates a palpable sense of tension throughout the game: you must observe carefully, memorize quickly, and act without hesitation.

A key feature of Pirots is that its difficulty scales smoothly and gradually. New rounds unlock only after you have successfully cleared the previous ones, giving the player ample time to adapt to the rules and experience a genuine sense of progress. Each successful attempt brings a satisfying feeling of precision—as if a short visual puzzle has just clicked perfectly into place.

Pirots feels like a calm yet demanding game focused on visual memory. It avoids cluttering the experience with unnecessary actions, keeping the spotlight firmly on the core objective: observe, memorize, and replicate the sequence. Pirots leaves you with a desire to tackle the next round with even greater precision—to recall the fruit positions faster and make it all the way to the final challenge without making a single mistake. Memorize the fruits and reveal them in the correct order.

games.name: LastCards
games.description:
LAST CARDS — PREMIUM COMPETITIVE CARD ACTION

Race to empty your hand in a fast, tactical shedding game built for quick rounds and real competition. The same rules power offline play and online servers, so what you practice is what you play.

CORE GAMEPLAY
• Standard 52-card deck plus 2 Jokers (54 cards) — 2 to 7 players, 7 cards each, classic match-suit-or-rank play.
• Can’t play? Draw one — your turn ends (drawn card can’t be played same turn).
• Multi-card turns: drop multiple cards of the same rank, build same-suit runs up or down, then bridge with a cross-suit tie-in — deep combos without losing clarity.

SPECIAL CARDS — TURN THE TABLE
Twos stack draw penalties; Black Jacks pile on; Red Jacks cancel stacks while keeping the “pick-up chain” tense. Kings reverse flow (with smart two-player behavior), Aces change suit, Queens lock suits, Eights skip, and Jokers are full wildcards — with a clear order when effects collide.

LAST CARDS DECLARATION (STANDARD MODES)
When you’re about to go out in one turn, declare “Last Cards” before your turn — miss the call or bluff the table and face penalties. High-skill, high-drama finishes.

MODES FOR EVERY MOOD
• Play with AI — sharpen tactics offline.
• Practice — same as AI; no leaderboard impact.
• Online — Quick Match or Private Game with a room code; casual wins can count on leaderboards when the match is trophy-eligible (not private).
• Ranked — signed-in quick match, MMR, and competitive ladders (60s turns).
• Ranked (Hardcore) — stricter finish rules, 30s turns, separate MMR and leaderboard (e.g., no winning on an Ace; Joker last-card restrictions).
• Tournament — knockout elimination: last to finish each round is out until one champion remains (vs AI or online).
• Bust — large-party elimination mode (up to 10 players): 52-card deck, no Jokers, round structure and placement rules that keep big tables moving; offline and online with dedicated leaderboards.

COMPETE & PROGRESS
Climb mode-specific leaderboards, track ranked performance, and show up signed in for the full competitive experience (anonymous sign-in may be available depending on setup).

POLISH & FAIR PLAY
Clean presentation, responsive pacing, and server-backed online sessions with disconnect handling suited to real multiplayer.

Drop in for a casual hand, grind ranked, or run a tournament — Last Cards is built for players who want skill, speed, and spectacle in every round. LastCards is Fast, competitive card game with combos, strategy, and online play

games.name: Word Blocks
games.description:
Word Blocks is an exciting and engaging word puzzle game that will appeal to anyone who loves words, logic, and relaxing fun. Its core idea is simple but highly captivating: using a set of wooden cubes decorated with letters, you need to create the longest and most complex words within a limited time. This concept combines brain training, language skill development, and genuine pleasure from finding solutions, encouraging players to replay levels again and again.

Why Word Blocks?
The game combines the best qualities of puzzles: it is engaging, easy to learn, yet offers high variability and difficulty. It is perfect for those who want not only entertainment but also to train their mind, expand their vocabulary, and develop strategic thinking. With this game, you can easily disconnect from everyday hustle, relax peacefully, and at the same time perform a beneficial mental workout.

Main idea of the game
In Word Blocks, your main task is to form words from a given set of letters displayed on wooden cubes. The game encourages creativity, requiring you to find not only short, familiar words but also to build long chains, discover rare combinations, and solve complex puzzles. The more words you create and the more difficult they are, the higher your score and achievements.

Levels of difficulty and variety of challenges
Each level in the game is unique. You will face different tasks, from quickly finding short words to discovering long, rare, and complex combinations. The limited number of cubes adds excitement and encourages you to be creative and think strategically. The better prepared you are, the more difficult levels you will be able to complete.

Boosters and helper tools
To handle especially challenging tasks and make the gameplay even more fun and diverse, the game includes boosters — special helpers that greatly enhance the player's capabilities:

*Removing unnecessary obstacles — helps get rid of distracting barriers,
*Time freeze — allows you to temporarily stop the countdown without resetting the already elapsed time,
*Shuffle — rearranges the order of letters in words,
*Magnet — allows you to attach the desired letter to an empty cell..
These tools not only assist in overcoming difficult levels but also make the game more friendly and accessible for beginners. Additionally, they add excitement when trying to beat your own records or compete with friends.

Suitable for Everyone
Word Blocks is the perfect choice for a wide range of players:

*For children — developing vocabulary and learning through play,
*For teenagers and adults — brain training, enhancing attention, and language skills,
*For seniors — maintaining mental activity and memory.

The game is also great for occasional entertainment or regular practice, allowing you to improve your skills and achieve new results in a comfortable environment. Create words from cubes, challenge your mind and boost your language skills.

The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

games.description:
Game Rules: Pentrix (Five in a Row)

Basic Information
Number of Players: 2

Board Size: 15×15 (can also be 13×13 or 19×19 as variations)

Piece Colors: Black and white, one player takes one color

Objective: The first player to connect five consecutive pieces of the same color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally on the board wins.

Detailed Game Rules
1. Opening Rules
Black moves first (a "forbidden move" rule can be used to balance the first player's advantage, see below)

The initial board is empty.

2. Placement Rules
Players take turns placing one of their pieces on the intersections of the board.

Once a piece is placed, it cannot be moved or withdrawn (no take-backs unless agreed upon by both players).

3. Determining the Winner: The first player to form a five-in-a-row of their pieces on any straight line wins.

More than five consecutive pieces (e.g., a six-in-a-row) also counts as a win.

For example: ⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫ (a six-in-a-row) also counts as a win.

Draw Rule: If the board is full and no one has formed a five-in-a-row, the game is a draw. Welcome to join Declamatory Incubous Ming

games.name: 5D Chess
games.description:
5D Chess reimagines the classic game of chess by introducing time travel and parallel timelines as core gameplay mechanics. Instead of playing on a single board with a linear sequence of moves, players compete across multiple boards that exist at different moments in time and across alternate realities. The result is a strategic experience that goes far beyond traditional chess.

At its foundation, the game still follows the familiar rules of chess. Pieces move in the same ways they always have: bishops diagonally, rooks along ranks and files, knights in L-shaped jumps, and so on. However, players are no longer restricted to moving pieces only within the present moment of a single board. Pieces can travel backward or forward through time, interact with earlier positions, and even create entirely new timelines.

When a piece moves into the past, it creates a branching timeline that develops independently from the original board. This produces multiple parallel versions of the game that exist simultaneously. Each timeline evolves based on the moves played within it, allowing the game to expand dynamically as new timelines are created. Players must think not only about space on a chessboard but also about how their moves affect the structure of time itself.

The interface organizes boards along a visual timeline so players can clearly track how events unfold across dimensions. Each board represents a specific point in time within a particular timeline. As the game progresses, additional boards appear, forming a network of interconnected realities. Players must monitor threats, defenses, and opportunities across these timelines simultaneously.

Because of this structure, strategy becomes dramatically more complex. A move made in the present might be countered by sending a piece into the past to alter the position before that move ever happened. Alternatively, players can create new timelines to escape dangerous situations or launch attacks that originate from different moments in time. Planning several moves ahead now involves understanding how multiple timelines may evolve in parallel.

Victory is still achieved through checkmate, but the concept expands significantly. Your king must remain safe across all active timelines while you attempt to trap your opponent’s king somewhere within the multiverse. This means that defensive play requires managing threats across many boards at once, while offensive strategies may involve coordinating attacks that originate from different timelines.

The result is a game that rewards deep planning, pattern recognition, and creative problem solving. Players who enjoy complex strategy games will find that 5D Chess offers a unique challenge that continually evolves as new timelines appear.

Features include:

Traditional chess mechanics combined with time-travel gameplay
Parallel timelines that branch when pieces move into the past
Multiple boards representing different moments in time
A clear timeline visualization system for tracking alternate realities
Complex strategic interactions across timelines and boards
Matches that evolve dynamically as new timelines form
A challenging experience for players who enjoy deep strategic thinking

Every match of 5D Chess becomes its own multiverse puzzle. Instead of calculating moves only along a single board, players must understand how their actions ripple through time and across alternate realities. A single decision can create new possibilities, new threats, and entirely new timelines that reshape the game.

Whether you are a long-time chess player or someone interested in unusual strategy games, 5D Chess offers a distinctive experience that expands the boundaries of what chess can be. Play chess across time and parallel timelines in the multiverse

games.name: Detective Me: Imposter Game
games.description:
Detective Me is a fun and entertaining game that is great for social gatherings. In multiplayer (online) mode, you can play with friends from different phones.
One player clicks "Create Game" and enters his name. A 6-digit code is generated. The other players click "Join Game", enter their name, game code, and join the game. When everyone joins, the host starts the game. By clicking "See Word", the program shows a word from the selected word list. Everyone sees the same word, except for one person, who sees "Imposter" instead of the word. During the game, you can make notes (visible only to you) that will help you navigate more easily when voting at the end. The game can be played in 2 ways: question and answer and one word/phrase at a time (as you wish). In the case of question and answer, the players take turns asking each other questions to try to find out who the imposter is, and the imposter tries to guess the word during the question and answer. During the question and answer, the player must try to answer the question given to him as accurately as possible so that the imposter cannot guess the word from his answer, but the other players understand the content of the answer. The questions are asked in turn, each player answers the question given to him and asks a question to whom he would like to, except for the person who asked him the last question.
It is forbidden to lie when answering the question. You must always answer correctly. You can answer approximately, not very specifically, but you cannot lie.
It is forbidden to ask similar questions - "What is the first letter of the word", "How many letters does the word consist of", etc. In the case of a word/phrase, the players take turns saying one word/phrase that is associated with the given word. When the time is up, voting begins
In the voting phase, you choose a suspicious player.
When everyone has voted, the host's "View Results" button becomes active.
The Results page displays:

who received how many votes,
who voted against whom.
If there is a player with the most votes, they leave the game
After the results, the host can:
continue the game, if they still want to continue finding the imposter
start a new game with the same word list
end the game
Additional information notes

The game keeps you in a constant state of fast focus, where spotting matches and reacting faster than your opponents is essential. This naturally improves your reaction speed and attention. Sound effects, visual feedback, and smooth animations support the experience, making every action feel more responsive and clear. Built-in training helps you quickly grasp the mechanics so you can jump straight into gameplay.
