games.name: Twordle
games.description:
Love daily word games but looking for a true test of deduction? Welcome to Twordle!

Twordle takes the classic 5-letter guessing format and turns it into a pure logic puzzle. We don't just hand you the correct letters—we make you earn them. By removing automatic letter-highlighting, Twordle becomes less about vocabulary and more about deep strategy and deduction.

🧠 The Twordle Twist
Unlike other word games, when you submit a guess, we do NOT tell you which specific letters are correct. Instead, we give you two numbers:

Yellow Number: How many letters are in the word, but in the wrong spot.

Green Number: How many letters are in the exact correct spot.
It is up to you to use logic, process of elimination, and clever guessing to figure out which letters are which!

🎯 How to Play

Type any 5-letter word to begin.

Look at the numbers on the right side of your guess to see how close you are.

Manual Tracking: Tap letters directly on the game board to color-code them (Gray, Yellow, or Green). This automatically updates your keyboard so you can keep track of your assumptions!

Made a mistake? Use the "Clear" (X) button next to your row to reset your colors for that guess.

Find the hidden word before you run out of tries!

✨ Key Features

Two Difficulty Modes: Relax with 10 guesses in Easy Mode, or sweat it out with only 6 guesses in Hard Mode.

Helpful Hints: Stuck? Tap the magnifying glass icon to reveal a random correct letter. (Use them wisely—you only get 3 per game!)

Detailed Statistics: Track your games played, total wins, and current streak.

Export & Import Save Data: Back up your stats safely using a secure code, so you never lose your streak if you switch devices.

Offline Play: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Play Twordle anywhere, anytime.

Sleek Dark Mode: A beautiful, distraction-free interface that is easy on the eyes.

Developed by Shadow Gamer.
Are you ready to crack the code? Download Twordle today and put your logic to the ultimate test!

Visit our website twordlegame.wordpress.com to learn more. A brain-teasing 5-letter puzzle game. Can you guess the hidden Twordle?

games.name: Sacred Recall
games.description:
Sacred Recall is an memory game built around two different ways to test how well you remember what you just saw.
In Symbol Memory, glowing tiles light up in a sequence that you need to repeat from memory. But the board does not stay polite for long — tiles may shuffle, some may disappear, and you still have to tap the correct order before your 3 lives run out.
In Sacred Pairs, memory works a little differently. Instead of matching identical cards, you connect meaningful Egyptian pairs like gods and their symbols, animals, or sacred signs. You can play alone or challenge a second player on the same device.
The game also includes a Collection where you can review the pairs you have learned and read short descriptions of Egyptian gods and symbols. That gives the game a little more depth than a usual memory board and makes each round feel like part puzzle, part discovery.
Simple to understand, satisfying to improve at, and just mysterious enough to keep pulling you back in, Sacred Recall turns memory into a small ancient challenge.

games.name: Relate: Word Puzzle Game
games.description:
How are words related? Discover the connections!

Relate is a fresh kind of word puzzle game where every word is connected to others by meaning. See a graph of linked words with relationship clues on the arrows -- like "SEED grows into TREE" or "FIRE melts ICE" -- and fill in the missing letters to complete every connection.

Not just another word search or crossword. Relate challenges you to think about HOW words connect, then spell your way to victory.

WHAT MAKES RELATE DIFFERENT

Unlike other word games, Relate shows you a web of word relationships. Each level presents a graph of word nodes connected by arrows. The arrows carry clues that describe the relationship between words. Your job: figure out the words and type the missing letters so every clue sentence becomes true.

Start simple with two connected words, then progress to complex webs of four, five, or six words with branching connections. It is easy to learn but deeply satisfying to master.

HOW TO PLAY

1. See a graph of connected word bubbles with hidden letters
2. Read the relationship clue on each arrow (e.g., "opens", "melts", "grows into")
3. Tap a word bubble to select it
4. Use the keyboard to fill in the missing letters
5. Complete all words to solve the level

100 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS

Every level is carefully designed with unique words -- no repeats across the entire game. Progress through five difficulty tiers:

- Beginner: 2 words, simple pairs (HOT is opposite of COLD)
- Easy: 3 words with chain connections (HEN lays EGG hatches into CHICK)
- Medium: 4 words with branching paths
- Hard: 5 words with complex relationship webs
- Expert: 6 words with multiple intersecting connections

FEATURES

- Beautiful cream and violet design with gentle sparkle animations
- Relaxing gameplay at your own pace -- no timers, no pressure
- Hint system: reveal a letter, reveal a word, or eliminate wrong letters
- Daily rewards with coins and hints
- Earn coins by solving levels and watching optional reward videos
- Starter pack and coin bundles available for extra help
- Works offline -- play anywhere without internet

TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Relate is more than a word game. It builds vocabulary, strengthens logical thinking, and exercises your ability to see connections between concepts. Perfect for word puzzle fans, crossword lovers, brain teaser enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys a clever challenge.

Whether you love word association games, connection puzzles, or classic word games like crosswords and anagrams, Relate offers something genuinely new. Download free and start discovering how words relate! Connect words by relationships. Solve clues, fill letters, train your brain!

games.description:
This very famous game is the second most played in Argentina (popularly known as J_D_TE) after Truco and one of the most played in Latin America, with names like 150. The objective is to get rid of all your cards. The round begins with 2 to 4 players and one card turned face up. Valid plays are same suit, same number, or special plays (10 or wild card).

CARDS WITH POWERS:

7 - Play again
10 - Change suit
11 - Skip the next player
12 - Reverse the direction of play
2 - 2 penalty cards to the next player (cumulative)
Wild Card - 5 penalty cards to the next player (cumulative)

Important Notes:

- The cards a player has at the end of the round add up to their face value, except for 2s (20 points) and wild cards (50 points). The first player to reach 100 points is eliminated.

- When you're down to just one card, you have to shout "LAST CARD," otherwise the penalty is drawing two additional cards from the deck.

- The last player standing wins the entire game.

Welcome to Word Bucket — a unique and addictive puzzle game that takes the sorting genre to a whole new level!

Your task is simple but requires logic and knowledge: sort words and items by their semantic categories, placing them into the correct buckets. If you love games like "water sort" or "ball sort", this will be your new favorite, because here you sort meanings, not just colors!

🧠 HOW TO PLAY:
• Tap any bucket to pick up the top word or icon.
• Move the item to another bucket if its top word belongs to the same category, or place it into an empty bucket.
• Gather all words of the same category in one container to successfully close it.
• Complete the level by correctly sorting all the items!

🌟 GAME FEATURES:
• Unique Gameplay: Sorting by categories is a fresh take on popular logic games.
• Brain Training: Expand your vocabulary, improve memory, and develop logical thinking while having fun.
• Mystery Levels: Challenge your intellect in special levels with hidden items — guess the categories blind!
• Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a level? Use a Hint, Undo your move, or add an Extra Bucket to pass even the hardest puzzles.
• Play Offline: Enjoy the game anywhere, anytime. No Wi-Fi required!
• Relaxing Atmosphere: No timers or penalties. Play at your own pace!

Word Bucket is the perfect way to unwind after a long day while keeping your mind sharp. Test your logic, knowledge, and categorization skills!

Can you sort all the words into the right buckets? Download Word Bucket: Sort Puzzle now and start your brain-teasing adventure! Sort words by categories! A fun and relaxing logic puzzle to train your brain.

games.name: Betwinner
games.description:
Betwinner is a casual chess trivia quiz made for quick play on your phone. Choose a difficulty before each round and answer multiple choice questions about chess rules, pieces, famous players, major tournaments, and chess history. Every tap counts toward your score.

When you open the app you see Easy, Medium, and Hard on the start screen. Each level uses its own question pool. Easy covers how pieces move, board layout, check, checkmate, and simple facts for newcomers. Medium adds tournament hosts, title rules, notable games, and broader culture. Hard brings deep history, world champions, classic matches, federation details, and expert facts.

Each round in Betwinner presents chess questions one at a time with four answer choices. Tap the option you believe is correct. Right answers add to your score and advance the round. Wrong answers reveal the correct choice so you learn before the next card. A progress bar and question counter show how far you are through the set.

A round timer runs for the whole session. Answer as many questions as you can before time runs out. Finish the full set to complete the round with a full summary. If the timer hits zero first, the round ends and your results are saved for that attempt.

During play you track score, remaining time, difficulty level, and current question number. The layout is vertical with large touch friendly buttons and readable question cards.

After the round ends, Betwinner shows a results screen with your final score, personal best, level played, correct answers, questions answered, and whether you finished the set or ran out of time. Tap Play Again to return to the start menu and choose a new level.
Replay one difficulty to improve or switch levels to explore new topics.

Betwinner highlights correct answers in green and wrong ones in red while revealing the right option. Brief pauses between cards keep the flow clear.

The question library covers rules and pieces including movement, captures, castling, and pawn specials. . Notation basics and symbols from published games appear alongside famous players, world titles, and historic championship matches. International events, national championships, and well known tournament cities are included, plus federation facts and team competitions that shape modern competitive chess. Whether you follow live events or study on your own, the quiz blends familiar ideas with details that may be new even to regular players.

Betwinner fits short breaks and longer sessions. Pick a level, read the card, tap an answer, and continue until the round ends. The focus stays on knowledge and steady pacing under the clock.

Tips for stronger runs in Betwinner. Start on Easy while learning piece names and rules. Try Medium for tournament and culture facts. Choose Hard for championship history and advanced trivia. Watch the timer and answer at a steady pace.

Replay to beat your best on each level. Compare Easy and Hard results to see where your knowledge is strongest. Wrong answers act as quick lessons because the right option appears before the next question.

Betwinner is chess trivia in a clean mobile package. Three levels, timed rounds, multiple choice play, score tracking, personal bests, progress feedback, and detailed round results are included. Install Betwinner and test your chess knowledge. Betwinner is a chess trivia quiz with Easy, Medium, and Hard rounds.

A logic puzzle experience that challenges your mind through structural balance and tactical merging. Navigate a dynamic grid populated with numerical tiles.

Core Mechanics:
- Select a boundary line to trigger the folding mechanism.
- One segment of the grid folds over the other.
- Identical numbers combine to form a higher value.
- Non-matching numbers merge by adding their values.
- Invalid moves are prevented to keep the challenge fair.

Plan your folds carefully to prevent gridlock and achieve a high score. Each move requires spatial awareness and careful planning. Enjoy a clean interface and smooth interactions designed to help you focus on the puzzle. Fold to merge identical numbers, aim for the highest score in CascadeFold!

games.name: Spot Flash Color
games.description:
Spot Flash Color shows you a sequence and asks one question: what is different?

A row of colored pairs appears on screen. Each position holds two colors stacked vertically — a top and a bottom. You have two seconds to memorize the sequence. Then it vanishes. Then it returns, identical in every way except one position, where something has changed.

Tap the position that changed.

At first the change is obvious. A red pair becomes green. You see it immediately. You tap it. You score. The next sequence is longer. The change is slightly less obvious. You start to look more carefully, building a mental map of the sequence before it disappears.

Then the changes become subtle. Not red to green — red to purple. Two colors that look similar under pressure, similar in memory, different only if you were paying close attention to exactly the right thing. Then the change is not a color at all — a pair that was red on top and blue on bottom is now blue on top and red on bottom. Same colors. Wrong order. You have to remember not just what colors were present but where each one sat.

At high scores the sequence holds twelve pairs. The change is a single step along a color wheel — nearly invisible, detectable only by someone who has trained their color memory to a level most people never reach.

Spot Flash Color is a game about attention. About the quality of the mental photograph you take in the two seconds you are given, and whether that photograph is detailed enough to survive the moment of darkness before the answer is revealed.

No ads. No luck. No timers at first. Just a sequence, a change, and the question of whether you saw it. A sequence of colored pairs flashes on screen. One pair changes. Tap the position that changed. The sequence gets longer. The changes get subtler.

games.name: Match Blend Pigment
games.description:
Match Blend Pigment gives you paint tubes and a target color and asks you to recreate it.

A color swatch sits on the left. Your mixing palette is on the right. Below both: a set of pigment tubes — cadmium red, ultramarine blue, cadmium yellow, titanium white. Drag a tube upward to add more of that pigment to the mix. The swatch on the right updates as you blend. When it looks right, submit.

The mixing behaves like real paint. Red and blue make purple. Red and yellow make orange. All three primaries together make brown. This is subtractive mixing — the way pigments actually work, not the way screens do. Players who have mixed paint before will find their intuition transfers directly. Players who haven't will develop new intuition quickly, because the feedback is immediate and visual and honest.

There are no numbers. No percentage readouts, no color codes, no distance meters. Just two swatches side by side and the gap between them. The game scores you by how close the match is, but it never tells you the score until after you submit. You look, you judge, you commit.

As your score climbs the palette shrinks. White is removed first — you can no longer lighten colors by adding white, which forces darker and more saturated mixes. Then the palette narrows to three primaries, then two. Matching a complex tertiary color using only cadmium yellow and ultramarine blue is a genuinely difficult color reasoning challenge.

At higher scores a slider lock activates. Once you push a pigment past a threshold, it cannot be reduced. You have committed that pigment to the mix — just like real paint, which cannot be unmixed once added.

Match Blend Pigment is a game about color perception. About looking carefully at two swatches and knowing which direction to push the mix. About developing an intuition for how pigments interact that most people have never been asked to cultivate.

No ads. No timers at first. No luck. Just color, paint, and the difference between what you see and what you made. A target color appears. Mix your pigments until the swatches match. The palette shrinks as your score climbs. Trust your eyes — no numbers shown.

games.name: Win Tactix
games.description:
Win Tactix is ​​a casual chess trivia quiz made for quick play on your phone. Choose a difficulty before each round and answer multiple choice questions about chess rules, pieces, famous players, major tournaments, and chess history. Every tap counts towards your score.

When you open the app you see Easy, Medium, and Hard on the start screen. Each level uses its own question pool. Easy covers how pieces move, board layout, check, checkmate, and simple facts for newcomers. Medium adds tournament hosts, title rules, notable games, and broader culture. Hard brings deep history, world champions, classic matches, federation details, and expert facts.

Each round in Win Tactix presents chess questions one at a time with four answer choices. Tap the option you believe is correct. Right answers add to your score and advance the round. Wrong answers reveal the correct choice so you learn before the next card. A progress bar and question counter show how far you are through the set.

A round timer runs for the entire session. Answer as many questions as you can before time runs out. Finish the full set to complete the round with a full summary. If the timer hits zero first, the round ends and your results are saved for that attempt.

During play you track score, remaining time, difficulty level, and current question number. The layout is vertical with large touch friendly buttons and readable question cards.

After the round ends, Win Tactix shows a results screen with your final score, personal best, level played, correct answers, questions answered, and whether you finished the set or ran out of time. Tap Play Again to return to the start menu and choose a new level.
Replay one difficulty to improve or switch levels to explore new topics.

Win Tactix highlights correct answers in green and wrong ones in red while revealing the right option. Brief pauses between cards keep the flow clear.

The question library covers rules and pieces including movement, captures, castling, and pawn specials. . Notation basics and symbols from published games appear alongside famous players, world titles, and historic championship matches. International events, national championships, and well-known tournament cities are included, plus federation facts and team competitions that shape modern competitive chess. Whether you follow live events or study on your own, the quiz blends familiar ideas with details that may be new even to regular players.

Win Tactix fits short breaks and longer sessions. Pick a level, read the card, tap an answer, and continue until the round ends. The focus stays on knowledge and steady pacing under the clock.

Tips for stronger runs in Win Tactix. Start on Easy while learning piece names and rules. Try Medium for tournament and cultural facts. Choose Hard for championship history and advanced trivia. Watch the timer and answer at a steady pace.

Replay to beat your best on each level. Compare Easy and Hard results to see where your knowledge is strongest. Wrong answers act as quick lessons because the right option appears before the next question.

Win Tactix is ​​chess trivia in a clean mobile package. Three levels, timed rounds, multiple choice play, score tracking, personal bests, progress feedback, and detailed round results are included. Install Win Tactix and test your chess knowledge. Win Tactix is ​​a chess trivia quiz with Easy, Medium, and Hard rounds.

In head‑to‑head you can run alongside a rival, use power‑ups to slow them down or slap them on the shoulder in jest. Seasonal events inspired by memes bring new memerot and quests.

Colourful graphics, funny animations and upbeat music create the feeling of a cheerful race . Intuitive controls are adapted for smartphones, and the game runs smoothly even on low‑end devices . games.name: Bhabhi Thulla
games.description:
Bhabhi Thulla brings the desi card-table classic to your phone — beautifully redesigned for mobile, smooth on every Android device, and packed with features for solo and multiplayer play.

Whether you call it Bhabhi, Bhabi, Thulla, Donkey, or the Getaway card game, you already know the rules — slap down the highest card, dodge the leftover hand, and don't be the last one stuck with cards. Now you can play anywhere, anytime, against smart AI bots or with real friends in private rooms.


★ WHAT'S INSIDE

▸ Online multiplayer — Create a room, share a 5-letter code on WhatsApp, and your friends jump in instantly.
▸ Play vs CPU — 3 to 6 player tables with smart bots that play like real opponents.
▸ Coin tables — Set a buy-in for every seat. Win to collect stakes, escape the Bhabhi to keep your coins, head-to-head draws return everyone's coins.
▸ Daily bonus — Spin the wheel once a day for free coins.
▸ 5,000 starter coins — Hit the ground running, no purchase required.
▸ Guest play OR Google Sign-In — Your coins follow you across devices when signed in.
▸ Real-time game — Sub-second card moves, 30-second turn timers, auto-rejoin on disconnect.


★ HOW TO PLAY

The first player to drop the Ace of Spades opens. Players follow the lead suit; the highest card wins the trick and takes the lead. Can't follow suit? Discard any card and force the trick winner to pick up the pile — that's a Thulla! Run out of cards and you escape (Bhabhi-free). The last player still holding cards becomes the Bhabhi.

Special moves: take all cards from a neighbour to load them up, or surrender a trick you can't win — every choice matters.


★ WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT

✓ Designed for desi card-game lovers in India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and the diaspora.
✓ Smooth portrait-mode UI optimised for one-hand play.
✓ Smart bots that bluff, dump, and play strategically — not random.
✓ Quick games (5–10 minutes per round) — perfect for a chai break.
✓ Private rooms with deep-link invites — tap a link, jump in.
✓ Lightweight, low data usage, runs on every modern Android phone.


★ FOR COMPETITIVE PLAYERS

▸ Set custom coin buy-ins from 500 coins upward.
▸ Bot games scale with table size (500 / 1,000 / 1,500 / 2,000 coins).
▸ Fair zero-sum economy — every escaper wins their buy-in back; the Bhabhi covers all of them.
▸ Mid-game forfeit penalty — leaving costs your stake. No coward exits.


★ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: Is Bhabhi Thulla free?
A: Yes — completely free to download and play. No required purchases.


Q: How many players can join a room?
A: 3 to 6 players per table.

Q: How do I invite friends?
A: From the room lobby, tap "Share Invite" — WhatsApp, Messages, anywhere. Your friend taps the link and lands directly in the room with the code pre-filled.

Q: What's the difference between Bhabhi and Thulla?
A: They're the same game, just regional names. "Bhabhi" (Hindi/Urdu) refers to the last player left holding cards. "Thulla" (Punjabi) refers to the act of forcing an opponent to pick up the trick. Bhabhi Thulla combines both into one classic game.

Q: Will there be tournaments?
A: Yes — leaderboards, daily challenges, and tournament rooms are on the roadmap.


★ ABOUT THE GAME

Bhabhi is one of South Asia's most-loved card games — played at family gatherings, college canteens, and chai stalls for generations. We rebuilt it for mobile with respect for the original gameplay, modern UX, and the feel of a real card table.

Built by South Asian developers, for South Asian card lovers everywhere.

Download Bhabhi Thulla now and find out who's the real cards champion in your circle. Play Bhabhi Thulla online with friends — coins, rooms and daily bonus.

games.name: Favbet

Favbet is a fast paced esports trivia quiz built for fans who love testing what they know about competitive gaming. From legendary Dota 2 finals to classic Counter Strike Major moments, every round of Favbet puts your memory and reaction speed to the test. Pick a difficulty, answer fifteen questions before the timer runs out, and aim for your personal best score on every level. The mix of speed and trivia turns each session into a small esports trip down memory lane.

Inside Favbet you will find three clearly separated difficulty modes. Easy is great for warming up and learning the basics of the global esports scene, with friendly questions about famous games, popular publishers, and well known regions. Medium turns up the heat with deeper questions about iconic teams, star players, and tournament moments that shaped the modern competitive era. Hard is built for true scene veterans who follow Valorant Champions, The International, IEM, BLAST Premier, and other top tier events. Each difficulty has its own unique question pool, so the challenge keeps changing as you switch modes and rebuild your run from scratch.

A full round inside Favbet is short, focused, and easy to fit into a quick break. You get sixty seconds on the clock and fifteen multiple choice questions to answer. Every correct answer rewards you with twenty points and pushes your score higher on the live HUD. The wrong answer is highlighted in red and the right one lights up in green, so you always learn something new even when you miss. The compact format is perfect for short trips, queue times, lunch breaks, or those quiet moments when you simply want a fun mental warm up.

The clean interface keeps everything you need on one screen. The top HUD shows your current score, the remaining time, your lives, and the active level, so you can plan your pace at a glance. Big touch friendly answer buttons make it easy to play with one hand on the bus, on the couch, or at your desk.
Favbet covers a wide spread of esports topics. You will see questions about classic and modern Counter Strike, the Dota 2 pro circuit, Valorant world championships, League of Legends World Finals, Rainbow Six Siege Six Invitational, the Overwatch League, fighting game majors, and the rise of Call of Duty competitive play. Favbet also touches the history of legendary organizations like Fnatic, Ninjas in Pyjamas, Astralis, Cloud9, Team Liquid, FURIA, Natus Vincere, FaZe Clan, Team Spirit, OG, Evil Geniuses, and G2 Esports, plus the cities and arenas that turned esports into a true global stage.

Every time you finish a round, the result screen shows your final score, the number of correct answers, time left on the clock, the chosen level, and your personal best for that level. Try to beat your own record on Easy, then move to Medium, and finally aim for a clean run on Hard, where every wrong tap can cost you a place on your own leaderboard.

If you love quick reaction quizzes, modern esports culture, or simply want a smart way to spend a few minutes, Favbet is ready to play. Tap, answer, score, and try again. The format stays light, the questions stay sharp, and your best score is always one round away from a new high. Favbet is an esports trivia quiz with three difficulty levels and 60s rounds

games.name: CogniStreak: Memory Challenge
games.description:
CogniStreak: Memory Challenge


1. How well do you remember?
2. Do you recall concrete words or approximate meanings.

THE GAME
See it. Remember it. Select it.

Words appear on your screen — then vanish. Seconds later they return, hidden among impostors: words that feel eerily familiar but were never there.
Pick only what you actually saw. Nothing more.
Most people fail. Not because they forget — but because their brain generates memories of words that never appeared.

You may recall what you vaguely understood than what you concretely saw.

━━━ WHY THIS IS HARDER THAN IT LOOKS ━━━
Your brain doesn't store reality. It stores patterns.
When you see "Truth," your brain may record "Fact."
When you see "Chair," it already expects "Table."
CogniStreak is built around these predictable errors — using them to reveal exactly how your memory filters and reconstructs what you experience.
━━━ WHAT YOU'LL DISCOVER ━━━
The Meaning Trap — Do you recall exact words, or just their general meaning?
False Familiarity — Why your brain confidently recognises words it never saw.
Pressure Points — Where your accuracy collapses under speed.
Pattern Blindness — Which word groups consistently fool you, and why.
━━━ THE RAI: RECALL AGILITY INDEX ━━━
One score. Three dimensions.
Retention — What you actually held in memory.
Resistance — Your ability to reject convincing impostors.
Latency — The speed of your decisions under pressure.
Maximum: 100. Most players never reach it. You are about to find out where you stand.
━━━ THE DAILY RECALL TRIAL ━━━
Every day at midnight: a new word set. The same challenge for every user worldwide. One attempt. No retries. No replays.
Your score is permanent. Your streak is on the line.
This is not a casual game. It is a daily measure of where your memory stands.
━━━ 50 LEVELS. ONE TRUTH. ━━━
From familiar, concrete words to abstract concepts. From comfortable speeds to pressured recall. Each level is designed to expose a different way your memory misleads you.
━━━ FREE vs PRO ━━━
FREE includes:
· Levels 1–5 to start
· Daily Recall Trial
· Flash Mode — rapid word presentation
· Recall Profile with performance stats
PRO — one-time purchase, no subscription:
· All 50 levels, ad-free
· Speed Mode — 15% faster word presentation
· Challenge Mode — double the impostors
· Endless Mode after Level 50
· Full Tier Weakness Analysis
━━━ THE SCIENCE ━━━
Built on three documented memory phenomena:
False Memory Effect — the brain manufactures confident memories of things it never encountered. Not a flaw. How human memory works.
RSVP Presentation — rapid serial visual presentation, used in cognitive psychology research worldwide.
Fuzzy Trace Theory — why abstract words (Truth, Logic, Justice) are harder to recall accurately than concrete words (Chair, Apple, River).
━━━ IN THE AGE OF AI ━━━
AI remembers everything, finishes your sentences, and handles your cognitive load by default. The question is: how sharp is your own recall when the tools are gone?
CogniStreak doesn't answer that for you. It shows you.
━━━ CLEAN BY DESIGN ━━━
No accounts. No logins. No cloud required.
Works fully offline — your data stays on your device.
━━━ DISCLAIMER ━━━
CogniStreak is an entertainment product. It makes no clinical claims about memory improvement, cognitive health, or neurological function. Word recall game built on false memory effect. Test your short-term memory

games.name: El Impostor- Edicion Argentina
games.description:
Hey, get the mate ready and get the party started, the game's on! 🧉
"The Impostor: Argentina Edition" is the ultimate social deduction game, designed for those who know how to lie and those who know how to catch the liar. If you liked games like Among Us or Mafia, but felt they were missing that "je ne sais quoi" that's so special to us, this is your game!

HOW TO PLAY?
The premise is simple, but it requires a lot of cunning and wit. A group of friends gets together, but one (or more) is hidden.

Get your card: The game will give everyone a keyword or cultural reference (e.g., "The Obelisk," "Asado," "Mate"). Everyone gets the same one... except the Impostor, who knows nothing!

Debate and lie: The debate rounds begin. You have to give subtle clues without being too obvious. The Impostor has to use all their cunning to blend in, throw fruit at everyone, and make sure no one suspects they're "out of it."

Vote for the suspect: Who was the most smooth-talking? If the Impostor is caught, the honest ones win. If the Impostor manages to frame someone else, they get away with it!

🎮 GAME MODES (Something for everyone)
🎭 The Impostor (The Classic): The classic. One secret word for everyone and an Impostor trying not to get caught. Pure deduction!

🌀 Crazy Mode: Can you handle it? Here, everyone receives different but very similar words. Total confusion reigns, and the Impostor has a golden opportunity for chaos.

✍️ Custom Mode: Your rules, your group! Upload your own inside jokes or keywords to play with friends the way you want.

👥 Who Am I?: Ideal for two players. Take turns asking questions and guessing the other player's hidden character (from Lilo & Stitch to Lightning McQueen).

⚽ Soccer Corner: * Soccer Impostor & Who Am I?: All the soccer folklore in one place. Only for those in the know.

Soccer Tower: A battle of titans. Defend your club (e.g., "Barcelona Players") and try to guess your opponent's by naming players. If you guess wrong, your tower falls!

🔥 WHAT MAKES IT UNIQUE?

100% Argentinian: Full of our references, from Maradona to choripán. The key words will make you laugh and spark lively debates.

Deduction and Nonsense: The fun isn't in the cards, but in what you say. The Impostor has to use his street smarts to survive.

Guaranteed Fun: Ideal for pre-parties, family gatherings, or playing with friends and having a great time. Laughter and heated debates are guaranteed!

ARE YOU READY TO SHOW OFF YOUR CUNNING?
Download "The Argentinian Impostor" now and prove if you're a master of deception or the best lie detective.

Proudly developed by ArFaTech.
Made in Córdoba / Buenos Aires. Debate, lie, and discover the imposter in this fun group game.

games.name: Word Unblock
games.description:
Word Unblock is a fresh, relaxing twist on classic word puzzles that combines the satisfying unblocking with the clever challenge of word associations. If you love logic puzzles, category games, and the feeling of unraveling a complex board, this game offers a unique way to challenge your mind.

At its core, the game is about discovering relationships between words. Instead of matching identical tiles, you use your vocabulary and lateral thinking to group cards by shared topics or themes. Clearing a correct association removes those cards and physically unblocks the layers resting beneath them, revealing new words and paths to victory. Because the cards are stacked, strategy plays a crucial role in planning your moves to uncover deeply buried topics.

Designed to be a stress-free experience, the game features hundreds of hand-crafted layouts and thousands of unique categories with no harsh timers. It offers a perfect balance of cognitive exercise and zen-like relaxation, complete with customizable, beautiful themes, helpful strategic tools, and full offline play. Word Unblock provides the perfect brain-training escape whenever you need to unwind. Match word by category to unblock layered cards.

Bead 16 is a traditional two player abstract strategy game where players move their pieces across the board and capture opponent pieces by jumping over them. The player who captures all opponent pieces wins the match. The game is popular across India, Bangladesh, Pakistan and other South Asian regions, and is also known by names like Sholo Guti, 16 Goti, 16 Kaati, Indian Checkers and Sixteen Soldiers.

If you enjoy classic board games like checkers, draughts, Alquerque, chess style strategy games or local desi board games, Bead 16 gives you a familiar but fresh challenge. Every move matters. Plan your jumps, protect your beads, trap your opponent and capture all pieces to win.

1. Core Objective​
Drag the provided gears from below to the upper installation area freely. Make all gears mesh with each other and rotate simultaneously to clear the level! Enjoy the fun of mechanical linkage and exercise spatial logic thinking.​
2. Basic Operations​
Observe the interface: The upper part is the gear "installation area" (including the initial drive gear), and the lower part is the gear library with optional gears (containing gears of different sizes and numbers of teeth).​
Drag to install: Long-press any gear below, drag it to the pillar in the installation area, and release to complete placement.​
Adjust position: Long-press and drag placed gears again to fine-tune their positions until they mesh accurately with other gears (a meshing prompt effect will appear).​
3. Key Clearance Rules​
Effective meshing: Gears must interlock with each other (no suspension or misalignment) to transmit power.​
Full gear linkage: After activation, all gears in the installation area must rotate synchronously (no stationary gears) to meet the clearance conditions. Drag gears to mesh, make all rotate together, and clear the level!

What is the game about?

Why it’s addictive:

games.name: Cube Pop™
games.description:
In Cube Pop™, it’s all about momentum. Quick decisions, clean timing, and keeping the action moving before the board pushes back.

Tap to launch an animal onto the conveyor and it immediately goes to work, firing shots that pop cubes of its own color. The number above each animal shows how many hits it can make before it’s spent. When that number hits zero, it exits the action. If it still has ammo left, it waits in one of five holding slots, ready to jump back onto the conveyor the next time you tap.

Those holding slots turn simple taps into real choices. Do you send an animal back in now, or wait for a better setup? Do you line up colors, or drop a booster to break open the board and create space? Used well, boosters can reset the flow, trigger satisfying chains, or save you from a tight spot.

The conveyor won’t carry everything forever. It has a capacity, and overfilling it slows the pace. Success comes from launching in the right order, managing what’s waiting, and steadily breaking down the cube wall until nothing’s left standing.

What makes Cube Pop™ click?
- Instant controls: One tap is all it takes - easy to learn, hard to stop.
- Color-based popping: Animals only affect matching cubes, keeping the action clean and readable.
- Flow management: Conveyor limits add light strategy without slowing the game down.
- Five holding slots: Plan ahead, reshuffle, and time your launches.
- Impactful boosters: Not just flashy - each one changes how the board plays.
- Short, punchy rounds: Built for quick breaks that turn into longer sessions.
- Pure pop satisfaction: Every hit visibly clears space and progress.

A fast, flow-driven action puzzle where smart timing beats brute force - and every tap matters. Satisfying & relaxing game

Word learning and review

Seeing a word once is often not enough to remember it over time. That’s why Pingua combines word learning with a review system. You can revisit previous words, refresh your memory, and spend more time on the words that still need practice.

Each word can move through four levels:
New
Medium
Good
Perfect

These levels help you understand which words are new, which are becoming familiar, and which ones you remember with more confidence. Instead of reviewing everything at random, you can focus your time more clearly.

For English learners

If you’re learning English, Pingua includes dedicated sections for phrasal verbs, collocations, and irregular verbs. These sections are made specifically for English learning. They help you recognize common expressions, useful word combinations, important patterns, and irregular verb forms. They are not presented as general features for every language.

Motivation with streak, combo, and rewards

Consistency matters when learning a language. Pingua makes your routine visible with a streak, adds energy with combo for correct answers in a row, and shows your progress through diamonds, EXP, and badges. The gamified experience is designed to motivate practice without making unrealistic promises.

Dictionary and word levels

The dictionary helps you quickly check the meaning of the words you practice. Together with the New, Medium, Good, and Perfect levels, it gives you a clearer view of what you know and what may be worth reviewing again.

Word games for active practice

Pingua turns review into a more active experience with word games. Learning does not have to mean reading long lists only; you can switch between short, varied, and motivating practice modes.

These games help reinforce words you have already seen, keep your focus, and bring variety to your routine. Even short sessions can feel more purposeful when each one has a clear goal.

Who is Pingua for?

Pingua is useful for students, self-learners, beginners starting a new language, English learners, and anyone who prefers short, frequent practice over long occasional study sessions. The app can also support vocabulary building for school, work, travel, tests, ESL practice, or personal goals.

Start with Pingua and build your own routine: learn new words, review with intention, practice through games, and follow your progress step by step.

games.description:
Melbet is a sports trivia game built around a colorful spin wheel and quick multiple choice questions. Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard on the start screen. Each difficulty uses its own question set so casual fans and serious sports lovers both find a fitting challenge.

The sport wheel is the center of every round. Eight categories appear on the wheel including Football, Tennis, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Golf, Boxing, and Athletics. Each sector has a distinct color. Tap the SPIN button or swipe the wheel with your finger. The wheel animates and stops on one sport. That sport decides which trivia topic your next question will focus on.

After each spin you see a question card with a sport tag and four answer buttons. Tap the answer you believe is correct. Correct picks add points and show positive feedback. Wrong picks highlight the right answer so you can learn. A countdown runs while you think. If time runs out the game reveals the correct answer and moves on.

Your status bar stays visible during play. Score tracks points from correct answers. Time shows remaining seconds for the current question or spin status when the wheel is active. The question counter shows progress through the full round. Level shows whether you are on Easy, Medium, or Hard.

A complete round in Melbet walks you through many spin and answer cycles until the set ends. Melbet then opens a results screen titled Round Complete. You see your final score, how many questions you answered correctly, which difficulty you played, your personal best saved on your device, and an outcome label. Answer every question correctly for a Victory outcome. Miss any question and the outcome shows Complete so you can try again.

Tap Play Again to return to level selection and start fresh.

What you get in Melbet

Simple touch controls made for phones. A spin wheel that adds variety to every question. Eight sport themes across major athletic disciplines. Three difficulty levels from Easy to Hard. Multiple choice format that is easy to read and tap. Clear feedback after each answer. Timed questions that keep each round energetic. Results with score, accuracy, level, and personal best.

Die App kann begleitend als Hörtraining genutzt werden, zum Beispiel bei Single Sided Deafness (SSD) sowie bei beidseitiger Hörstörung nach Versorgung mit Hörgeräten und/oder Cochlea-Implantaten.

Kinder entdecken die Inhalte über zwei einfache und motivierende Spielideen: ein Suchspiel und ein Hör-Merkspiel.

Im Suchspiel warten 5 Wimmelbilder, auf denen jeweils 10 passende Abbildungen gefunden werden können. Dazu gibt es passende Hör-Merkspiele mit jeweils 6 Bildpaaren. So wird genaues Hinhören auf spielerische Weise gefördert.

Die App lässt sich an die Bedürfnisse des Kindes anpassen:
Es kann zwischen einer männlichen und einer weiblichen Stimme gewählt werden. Außerdem stehen drei verschiedene Hörstufen zur Verfügung:

- Geräusche
- Wörter
- Sätze

Dadurch können Kinder in ihrem eigenen Tempo üben und Schritt für Schritt mehr Sicherheit im Hören gewinnen.

Das macht Hörspaß für Jecke Öhrcher besonders:
- Für Kinder ab 3 Jahren
- Speziell für Familien mit hörbeeinträchtigten Kindern
- Spielerische Hörförderung mit Suchspiel und Hör-Merkspiel
- 5 Wimmelbilder mit jeweils 10 Suchaufgaben
- Hör-Merkspiele mit jeweils 6 Bildpaaren
- Wahl zwischen männlicher und weiblicher Stimme
- Übungen auf Geräusch-, Wort- und Satzebene
- Begleitend nutzbar bei Hörgeräte- und Cochlea-Implantat-Versorgung
- Werbefrei, kostenlos und sicher für Kinder
- Auf mehreren Geräten spielbar

Die App basiert auf dem Wimmelbuch „Meine Hörklinik“.

Hörspaß für Jecke Öhrcher unterstützt Kinder und Familien mit spielerischen Übungen, die Freude machen und das Hörenlernen im Alltag begleiten.

games.description:

4. Each round, players receive the same secret prompt, except the impostor
5. Discuss the prompt without saying it directly
6. Vote who you think the impostor is

Game Modes:

Instead of the secret prompt, impostors see: YOU ARE THE IMPOSTOR!
They must bluff their way through the round, using context clues from other players' discussions.

Impostors see a random prompt from the same category being played that round.

games.name: Writer's Deadline
games.description:
Ready to beat the Deadline?

Welcome to Writer’s Deadline, a word game that combines the spatial strategy of block-dropping games with the brain-churning vocabulary of classic word grids. Dripping in the nostalgic backdrop of 20th-century journalism, use your typewriter and ink ribbons to build words and clear the board to write your articles to climb the ranks of the newspaper publishing world!

You control an endless number of pairs of letters by sliding, rotating, and dropping them into place to build words two letters at a time.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Career Mode: Break the Story. Test your cognitive skills across your own randomized career journey with levels each with a specific goal and conditions to work under:
•Additional Rules: Challenge your vocabulary with rules about what kind of words you can build, such as words cannot have the letter “T” or words must start with “L”.
•Varied Obstacles: Navigate around writer’s blocks, cope with typo blocks, deal with a board full of junk letters, or work under time constraints.
•Buy Bonuses and Inventory: Buy copy desk sundries and bonuses from your earnings to help tackle more difficult levels as you progress.
•Freelance Gigs: Running low on dough? Take on embarrassing side jobs to earn more. Swallow your pride and work as a birthday card punster or a teen magazine contributor all the way up to ghostwriting or political hackwriting to keep your career afloat.

Pure Mode: The Arcade Challenge. No rules, just the deadline. Survive as long as you can in an endless high score chase. Dial in your preferred difficulty to control minimum word lengths and achieve your personal best score.

PLAY WHEN YOU WANT

Writer’s Deadline is always saving your progress, even mid-game! Take that phone call or text message, the game will be waiting for you when you’re ready to resume. It’s the ultimate casual word game that lets you stop and start when you want, whether you have plenty of time or only a few minutes!

LEARN NEW WORDS

Writer’s Deadline uses a sanitized, tournament grade North American dictionary, containing offline definitions to help you learn new words you might accidentally stumble upon! UK and other dictionaries are coming soon!

AESTHETIC VIBES

Built for tactile satisfaction, every rotation, drop, and clear is felt rich by the mechanical ASMR of vintage typewriters and analog office equipment. Steel typewriter keycaps, rich textured ink ribbons, 35mm film reels, and spinning newspapers complete the feel of when journalism was a heralded and respected profession.

The deadline is approaching. Stack your letters, sharpen your vocabulary, and get the paper out on time. Slide, Rotate, Drop, and Win! A Strategic Letter Drop Game

games.name: Chess Master

♟️Chess Master – The Ultimate Strategy Board Game

🧠 About the Game
Chess Master reimagines the timeless classic of strategy and intellect. Built for both beginners and grandmasters, it’s a modern digital battlefield where every move tests your focus, logic, and creativity. With a sleek interface, smooth gameplay, and realistic animation, it turns every match into a mental masterpiece. Play offline against intelligent AI or prepare for online duels coming soon.

📜 A Brief History of Chess
The roots of chess trace back over a thousand years to ancient India, where Chaturanga represented the four divisions of the army. Through Persia, it became Shatranj, introducing “Shah Mat” — the King is dead. From there, it spread to Europe, evolving into the modern form we play today. By the 19th century, chess had become a global symbol of intellect and discipline, inspiring tournaments, champions, and computers like Deep Blue. Chess Master continues this legacy — honoring history through technology.

♔ Gameplay Basics
Two players, 64 squares, 16 pieces each — King, Queen, Rooks, Bishops, Knights, and Pawns.
The mission: Checkmate the opponent’s King, leaving it no escape.
Each piece has its rhythm — the Queen’s dominance, the Knight’s leap, the Pawn’s quiet ambition.
In Chess Master, smooth visuals and human-like AI bring every move to life, creating a balance between beauty and intellect.

🚀 Why Play Chess Master
• Premium Design – Elegant boards, rich textures, and gold-blue tones inspired by tournament sets.
• Smart AI – Adapts to your playstyle and difficulty level.
• Relaxing Atmosphere – Subtle music and clean animations to enhance focus.
• Offline & Online (Coming Soon) – Enjoy anywhere, anytime.
• Personal Themes – Light or dark mode for your comfort.

Chess Master isn’t just about winning — it’s about thinking deeper and improving with every move.

🎯 Master Every Move
Each game sharpens your mind. Learn openings, practice tactics, and discover your style — defensive like Karpov or attacking like Tal.
Understand patterns, create plans, and develop vision that extends beyond the board. The game will soon include AI-based move analysis and tutorials to guide your growth from novice to strategist.

🌍 A Universal Game
Chess unites all ages and cultures. From India’s heritage to global tournaments, it remains a common language of thought and respect. Chess Master celebrates this unity, connecting players worldwide through the shared pursuit of mastery.

💡 A Game Beyond the Board
Every move in chess mirrors life — decisions, risks, sacrifices, and triumphs. Chess Master trains your concentration, patience, and foresight. It’s not just a pastime; it’s mental fitness wrapped in elegance.

🔮 Future Vision
Coming soon to Chess Master:
• Global online multiplayer
• Game history and move tracking
• Achievements and trophies
• Custom boards and piece designs
• Grandmaster-level lessons

🏁 Conclusion
Chess Master is where intelligence meets artistry. It’s calm yet competitive, ancient yet futuristic. Whether you’re learning the basics or chasing perfection, each game tells your story — one move at a time.

♟️ Step onto the board. Think ahead. Rule the game. Welcome to Chess Master. Chess board game

¡Hey, prepara el mate y que empiece la fiesta, el juego ha comenzado!

Si te gustaron juegos como Among Us o Mafia, pero sentiste que les faltaba ese "je ne sais quoi" que es tan especial para nosotros, ¡este es tu juego!

¿CÓMO JUGAR?
La premisa es simple, pero requiere mucha astucia e ingenio. Un grupo de amigos se reúne, pero uno (o más) está escondido.

Obtén tu tarjeta: El juego le dará a cada uno una palabra clave o referencia cultural (por ejemplo, "El Obelisco", "Asado", "Mate"). Todos obtienen la misma... ¡excepto el Impostor, que no sabe nada!

Vota por el sospechoso: ¿Quién fue el más persuasivo? Si atrapan al Impostor, ganan los honestos. Si el Impostor logra incriminar a alguien más, ¡se sale con la suya!

 MODOS DE JUEGO (Algo para todos)
 El Impostor (El Clásico): El clásico. Una palabra secreta para todos y un Impostor tratando de no ser atrapado. ¡Pura deducción!

Modo Loco: ¿Puedes soportarlo? Aquí, todos reciben palabras diferentes pero muy similares. Reina la confusión total, y el Impostor tiene una oportunidad de oro para el caos.

Modo Personalizado: ¡Tus reglas, tu grupo! Sube tus propios chistes internos o palabras clave para jugar con amigos como quieras.

 ¿Quién Soy Yo?: Ideal para dos jugadores. Túrnense para hacer preguntas y adivinar el personaje oculto del otro jugador (desde Lilo & Stitch hasta Rayo McQueen).

Rincón del Fútbol: * Impostor del Fútbol y ¿Quién Soy Yo?: Todo el folclore del fútbol en un solo lugar. Solo para los que saben.

Torre del Fútbol: Una batalla de titanes. Defiende tu club (por ejemplo, "Jugadores del Barcelona") e intenta adivinar el de tu oponente nombrando jugadores. ¡Si adivinas mal, tu torre se cae!

¿QUÉ LO HACE ÚNICO?

100% Argentino: Lleno de nuestras referencias, desde Maradona hasta choripán. Las palabras clave te harán reír y generarán debates animados.

6 grandes catégories : Histoire, Sciences & Nature, Géographie, Arts & Lettres, Divertissement, Sport & Loisirs. Plus de 200 thèmes : mythologie, cinéma, musique, gastronomie, sport, géographie, sciences, pop culture, web, jeux vidéo, philosophie, cuisine du monde, et bien d'autres.

PENSÉ POUR L'APÉRO
Pas de compte, pas de pub, pas de friction. Tu ouvres, tu joues. Mode sombre auto, accessibilité (contraste, daltonisme, animations réduites), retours haptiques et SFX soignés.

Fait avec amour en France. Tes signalements (bouton dédié dans l'app) nous aident à corriger et enrichir le catalogue en continu.

games.name: Blokk Slide
games.description:
Blokk Slide is a casual puzzle game — a sliding-tile puzzle where you rearrange colored blocks until the center of the board matches a target pattern.

Each tile slides into the empty slot beside it. You swipe. The board shifts. The center updates. It's a race between your hand and your eye.

— THREE WAYS TO PLAY —

Daily puzzle. One shared challenge every day, the same for every player on Earth. Solve it fast, climb the global leaderboard, keep your streak alive. A new puzzle drops at UTC midnight.

Solo. Three difficulties — Easy (5×5 board, 3×3 target), Medium (6×6 board, 4×4 target), Hard (7×7 board, 5×5 target). No clock, no pressure. Practice at your own pace.

Multiplayer. Create a room, share the 6-digit code, race up to 7 friends on the same scrambled board. First solve wins. Extra time options for tighter or looser rounds. No accounts. No sign-up. Just play.

— WHY IT'S DIFFERENT —

• A fair daily. Everyone on the planet gets the same board. Your time stands next to theirs on the leaderboard.

• Built for a minute. Or ten. Puzzles solve in under a minute on Easy, scale up to a few minutes on Hard. Good for a coffee break, good for a long commute.

• Quiet design. Clean typography, honest colors, no pop-ups, no streak-nagging notifications. The puzzle is the whole show.

• Works offline. Solo mode plays without a network. Daily puzzles play offline too, but your time only counts on the leaderboard if you're connected when you solve.

• Light + dark mode. Follows your system setting.

— ABOUT PLAYING WITH FRIENDS —

Multiplayer rooms are private by default — you get a 6-digit code to share. Up to 8 players per room. The host picks difficulty and extra time (10, 20, 30, or 60 seconds). Everyone sees the same scramble and the same target. No chat — just a shared countdown and a race track so you can see who's ahead.

— WHAT WE DON'T DO —

No ads inside active gameplay. No hearts, lives, or energy timers. No purchase prompts mid-puzzle. No app-locked content. The full game is free — we support the game with optional, respectful ads between runs.

Blokk Slide is made by a small team. Feedback is welcome and read. Slide tiles. Match the pattern. Daily puzzle. Race 7 friends. Free, quick.

games.name: DUELO
games.description:
Duelo ist ein Partyspiel für spannende Wissensduelle – kein klassisches Quiz.

Spiele 1 gegen 1 oder im Team mit Freunden.
Gespielt wird immer geheim – niemand kennt die Einschätzung der anderen Spieler.

Es gibt zufällige oder eigene Themen.
Zum Beispiel können Themen wie Automarken kommen:
Audi, BMW oder Mercedes.

Bei zufälligen Themen werden automatisch 10 oder 20 Sekunden passend zum Thema festgelegt.
Bei eigenen Themen kann die Zeit selbst eingestellt werden.

Nach dem Thema folgt die geheime Einschätzung:
Im 1-gegen-1 schätzt jeder für sich selbst ein,
wie viele Begriffe er innerhalb der Zeit nennen kann.
Im Team schätzt du immer für deinen Teampartner ein.

Nach jeder Runde wechseln die Einschätzungen im Team,
sodass jeder einmal für den anderen einschätzt.

Die höchste Einschätzung beginnt.
Bei gleicher Einschätzung entscheidet ein Stechen mit
Schere, Stein, Papier.

Die ausgewählte Person muss dann innerhalb der vorgegebenen Zeit
so viele Begriffe wie möglich nennen.

Am Ende wird aufgelöst, ob die Person ihre Einschätzung geschafft hat.
Schafft sie es, erhält sie einen Punkt.
Schafft sie es nicht, erhält sie keinen Punkt.

Wer bei minus 2 Punkten ist, scheidet aus.
Im 1-gegen-1 gewinnt dadurch der andere Spieler.
Bei mehreren Spielern scheiden die Spieler nach und nach aus,
bis ein Gewinner übrig bleibt.

Duelo ist perfekt für Freunde, Familie und Partyrunden,
aber auch ideal für Menschen, die sich noch nicht gut kennen.
Es sorgt für Spaß, Spannung und überraschende Momente.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit. Sort words, solve groups, and relax with solitaire-style puzzles.

games.name: Chess Pro Trainer™
games.description:
Are you able to solve chess puzzles but struggle to find those same tactics in your own games? Or are you simply looking to improve your tactical awareness? Then this app is for you.

Chess Pro Trainer is unlike anything you have seen before and will transform how you train tactics. It is designed to improve your tactical vision, calculation, pattern recognition, and overall chess strength through realistic in-game simulation training. This is more than just a chess app — it is a complete tactical training system.

What sets this app apart from traditional puzzle apps is that you do not know when the tactic occurs. In most puzzle apps, you know a tactic exists from the very first move. Here, the tactic may appear on the 1st, 3rd, or even 7th move, creating a true in-game simulation experience. Each position is taken from real games played by everyday players, YouTube creators, super grandmasters, and some of the greatest players in chess history.

Most puzzle apps only train you HOW to solve tactics. Chess Pro Trainer teaches you HOW and WHEN to look for them using the 6 Tactics Recognition Conditions taught throughout the app. This creates a far more realistic and practical training experience that translates directly into your real games.

Unlike traditional puzzle apps where moves are simply marked right or wrong, Chess Pro Trainer features an advanced alternate acceptable move system. In many positions, users can earn credit for finding Valid, Equal, or even Better moves compared to the move played in the actual game. This creates a more realistic calculation environment while rewarding creativity, strong decision-making, and engine-level tactical vision.

By focusing on the most critical moments in real games, this app trains your decision-making skills where it matters most. Training this way will dramatically accelerate your improvement and help you reach your goals faster.

The app includes the following core training modules:

1. Tactics Recognition Training
The core of the app. Each position is divided into two phases:
Phase 1 ("Pre-Tactic") — Answer Yes/No to the question: "Is there a tactical sequence here?" while the game progresses automatically.
Phase 2 ("Tactic") — Solve the position by making the correct moves just like a traditional puzzle.
Includes an advanced analysis board powered by the Stockfish chess engine to explore positions and variations.

2. Genius Training
Focuses on aggressive, high-level play involving sacrifices. Develop your attacking instincts and calculation.

3. Checks Training
Master the ability to identify all possible checks — a fundamental skill that is often overlooked but critical for strong play.

4. Coordinated Squares Training
Learn to recognize key "action squares" — squares attacked by multiple pieces — which are often the foundation of powerful tactics. The closer they are to your opponent's king, the more important they become.

5. Unprotected Pieces Training
Train your ability to identify vulnerable pieces using a unique and deeper definition of what "unprotected" truly means.

Track your progress with a scoring system, global leaderboard, and detailed statistics. Choose difficulty levels for each module and customize your experience with board themes, sound settings, and training preferences. Practice your coordinates with the Learning Coordinates module or dive into the hypothetical with the Random Position Generator module.

Whether you are a beginner or an advanced player, Chess Pro Trainer provides a focused and efficient way to improve your chess skills.

Chess Pro Trainer is a growing training platform with many new modules, features, and innovations already planned — this is just the beginning. You may never need another chess app again. NO ADS! FREE DAILY TRAINING! Master tactics by learning WHEN to look for them.

games.name: BlastGrid: Tactical Fuse

Your mission is to systematically demolish obstacles, navigate treacherous environments, and reach the extraction point before the fuse runs out. The Art of Tactical Demolition

High-Score Optimization: Speed is rewarded. Faster completion times grant significant score multipliers, encouraging players to refine their routes and master the mechanics.

Features & Technical Excellence
Responsive Grid Movement: Experience latency-free controls designed for rapid directional shifts, essential for escaping your own blast radius.

Persistent Progress Tracking: Clear both stages to secure your place in the archives. Monitor your best runs and improve your tactical efficiency over time.

Atmospheric Visual Clarity: A sleek, high-contrast interface ensures that every trap, brick, and fuse is clearly visible, even during the most frantic sequences.

Resource Management: With only three lives to spare across both stages, you must balance aggressive clearance with defensive survival.

Cognitive Benefits & Engagement
BlastGrid: Tactical Fuse serves as an excellent mental workout, enhancing several key cognitive functions:

Spatial Reasoning: Visualizing the blast radius before the fuse ignites.

BLE Chess is a local two-player chess game that lets two nearby Android phones connect using Bluetooth Low Energy.

One player hosts the game as White, and the other player joins as Black. Once both phones are connected, every move is sent through Bluetooth so both boards stay synchronized.

No online account is required. No internet connection is needed for gameplay.

Play chess nearby

BLE Chess is designed for two people who are physically close to each other.

One phone chooses:

Host / White

The other phone chooses:

Join / Black

The phones then connect through Bluetooth and the chess match can begin.

Features
Two-player local chess over Bluetooth Low Energy
No Wi-Fi required for gameplay
No online server required
Host plays White
Join player plays Black
Automatic move synchronization between both phones
Legal move validation
Check and checkmate detection
Pawn promotion
En passant support
Resignation option
Optional chess clocks
Time controls including Blitz, Rapid, and Classical modes
Board automatically flips for the Black player
Simple visual advantage bar
Clean and colorful chess board interface
BLE reset option if the connection needs to be restarted
Time controls

You can play without a timer or choose from several chess clock options:

No time
3+2 Blitz
10 min Rapid
15+10 Rapid
30 min Classical

When a timed game is active, each player’s clock runs during their turn. If a player runs out of time, they lose the game.

When one player moves a piece, the move is sent to the other device. The second phone receives the move and updates its board automatically.

This makes the game feel like a shared chess board between two nearby players.

Who is this app for?

BLE Chess is for anyone who wants to play chess locally with a friend using two Android phones.

It can be useful for:

Casual chess games
Playing without internet
Testing Bluetooth chess communication
Learning chess with a friend nearby
Quick local matches at home, school, work, or while traveling

BLE Chess requires Bluetooth to be enabled.

On some Android versions, the app may also request Bluetooth-related permissions so it can scan, advertise, and connect to nearby devices.

The app uses ads.

Oyun Nasıl Oynanır?
Oyuna başlarken herkes gizli bir mekanı öğrenir, ancak aranızdan biri (veya birileri) "Casus" olarak seçilir ve nerede olduğunu bilmez. Amacınız sırayla birbirinize zekice sorular sorarak casusun kim olduğunu bulmak. Ancak dikkatli olun! Sorularınız fazla açıklayıcı olursa casus mekanı tahmin edip oyunu kazanabilir. Geniş ve Dinamik İçerik: Tekrara düşmeyen, zengin kelime ve mekan havuzuyla (tüm terimler ve mekanlar dengeli bir şekilde genel kategorilere yedirilmiştir) her oyun yepyeni bir maceraya dönüşür.

Tek Cihaz, Maksimum Eğlence: Herkesin oyunu indirmesine gerek yok! Tüm arkadaş grubunuzla tek bir telefon üzerinden oynayabilirsiniz.

Her Ortama Uygun: Ev partileri, kafeler, yolculuklar veya kamp ateşinin etrafı... Oynamak için sadece birbirinizi duymanız yeterli.

Gözlem yeteneğine, blöf yapma becerisine ve sezgilerine güvenenleri piste alalım. Bakalım aranızdaki casusu kim bulacak? Ya da... casus olarak ne kadar uzun süre saklanabileceksin?

Hadi, hemen indir ve ajan avı başlasın! Kim masum, kim casus? Arkadaşlarınızla toplanın, zekice sorular sorun ve gizli ajanı ortaya çıkarın! Bol blöf ve kahkaha garantili parti oyunumuzla tanışın.

Bir av.

Herkes aynı hedef.
Sen ne kadar yaklaşabilirsin?

Bu oyun harflere değil, anlama bakar.

Bir kelime yaz ve gönder 
Sıcaklık göstergesi sana ne kadar yaklaştığını söylesin 
Stratejini geliştir ve doğru kelimeyi bul

Günlük Meydan Okuma

Bir sonraki günün kelimesini beklerken sıkıldın mı?
Günün kelimesini bulduğun o an… yetmedi mi?
O “BULDUM!” hissini hemen tekrar yaşamak istiyorsun, biliyoruz :)

Hem o nostaljik sıcak-soğuk hissini,
hem de kelime oyununun keyfini sevdin…
ve şimdi daha fazlasını istiyorsun.

İşte burada devreye giriyor:
Sınırsız tekli oyun modu.
Oyna, dene, yaklaş… stratejini geliştir ve ustalaş.

Her deneme seni daha iyi yapar.
Her oyun yeni bir taktik.

Ve sana küçük bir sır…

Düello modu yakında!
Sen mi daha iyisin, yoksa arkadaşın mı?
Çok yakında öğreniyoruz ;)

Genel Lider Tablosu
Bugünün en iyisi kim?
Tüm zamanların lideri kim? 

Rekabet et, sıralamada yüksel ve zirveye çık.

Daha çok oyna, daha çok puan kazan.
Ama unutma…
En büyük puan günün kelimesini bulmakta.

Seri Sistemi & Ödüller 
Her gün oyna, serini koru. Daha uzun seri, daha büyük ödül. 

Akıllı İpuçları 
Zorlandığında doğru hamleyi yap. İpuçlarını stratejik kullan, fark yarat.

HOW TO PLAY?
Your goal is to be the first player to reach the target score by collecting cards. But be careful; every decision carries a risk!

Go for FLIP 7: If you manage to collect 7 different numbers in a single round, you achieve a FLIP 7! Earn massive bonus points and end the game instantly as a legend.

MASTER YOUR STRATEGY (SPECIAL CARDS)
It’s not just about numbers! Use special cards to disrupt your opponents' plans:

x2: Double your current round score and take the lead!

Flip 3: Force a chosen opponent to draw 3 mandatory cards. Will they survive without busting?

Freeze: Freeze an opponent! They stay with their current score and cannot make a move this round.

WHY FLIP7?
Fast & Dynamic: Quick rounds filled with constant excitement.

Competitive: Outsmart your friends and rivals with clever tactics.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple rules, but winning requires the perfect balance of greed and caution.

Take the risk, stand at the right time, and become the Flip 7 champion!

games.name: Kick Tac Toe
games.description:
WER KENNT MEHR?

Kick Tac Toe kombiniert Fußball-Wissen mit Tic-Tac-Toe — und einer Datenbank von über 15.000 Profi-Fußballern. Drei Zeilen, drei Spalten. Neun Felder, neun kleine Quizfragen:

· Welcher Fußballer hat für Frankfurt UND Bayern gespielt?
· Welcher Kolumbianer ist für Dortmund aufgelaufen?
· Welche Schalke-Spieler haben den DFB-Pokal gewonnen?
· Wer spielte für den HSV und in der Premier League?

Wer den richtigen Namen nennt, sichert sich das Feld. Drei in einer Reihe — gewonnen.

Klingt einfach? Probier es.

——————

KOSTENLOS SPIELEN — KEIN ABO, KEINE WERBUNG

Das gesamte Spiel ist kostenlos verfügbar: Solo gegen Computer, Duell gegen Freunde, alle Joker, alle Schwierigkeitsstufen, Zeitfenster-Filter und Eigenes Spiel. Wer zusätzlich Statistiken und Lösungsvorschläge will, schaltet Pro einmalig frei.

——————

EIN SPIELPRINZIP, VIELE WEGE

· SOLO gegen den Computer: vier Schwierigkeitsstufen vom Anfänger (Kreisklasse) bis zum Experten (Königsklasse).
· DUELL gegen einen Freund: Lieblingsverein wählen, abwechselnd raten, wer mehr weiß gewinnt.
· FORMATE: Einzelspiel, Best-of-3, Best-of-5 oder Endlos.
· EIGENES SPIEL: Vereinsauswahl, Kategorien, Zeitfenster und KI-Stärke selbst konfigurieren.

——————

AUSWAHL-MODUS

Im Multiple-Choice-Modus bekommst du pro Feld vier mögliche Spieler vorgeschlagen — du musst nur den richtigen erkennen. Perfekt für den Einstieg in Kick Tac Toe.

——————

DREI JOKER PRO SPIEL

· Vorname: zeigt den Vornamen eines Lösungsspielers.
· Laufbahn: blendet alle Vereinsstationen eines Lösungsspielers ein.
· Auswahl: legt dir vier mögliche Spieler vor — du wählst.

ZEITFENSTER-FILTER

Lust auf 70er-Stars? 90er-Helden? 2010er-Talente? Stell den Zeitraum ein, der dich interessiert — die Datenbank passt sich an.

——————

DIE DATENBANK

Über 15.000 Profi-Fußballer mit kompletten Karrieredaten: Vereine, Jahre, Spiele, Tore, Nationalmannschaft, Position, Titel. Basierend auf Wikipedia, regelmäßig aktualisiert.

Die Datenbank reicht zurück bis 1963 und kennt alle aktuellen Erst- und Zweitligisten, weitere Traditionsmannschaften aus der 3. Liga sowie über 30 internationale Vereine.

——————

KICK TAC TOE PRO MACHT DICH ZUM PRO.

· STEAL-MECHANIK: Stiehl deinem Gegner eine Zelle, indem du selbst einen passenden Spieler nennst.
· SPIELERPROFILE: Karriere, Stationen, Spiele und Tore aufrufen.
· LÖSUNGSMATRIX: nach Spielende alle möglichen Antworten sehen.
· DATENBANK-RECHERCHE: Lass dir alle Spieler anzeigen, die für Hertha und Stuttgart gespielt haben. Schlage nach, welche Brasilianer bisher für Werder aufgelaufen sind. Oder welche polnischen Spieler in den 80ern bei Nürnberg waren.

Einmaliger Kauf. Kein Abo, keine wiederkehrenden Kosten.

——————

DATENSCHUTZ

Keine Konten, keine Tracker, keine personalisierte Werbung. Spielername und Lieblingsverein bleiben lokal auf deinem Gerät. Spielverlaufsdaten werden anonymisiert ausgewertet — ausschließlich zur Verbesserung des Spiels. Server in Deutschland.

Volle Datenschutzerklärung: kicktactoe.de/datenschutz

——————

Für alle, die behaupten, sie kennen jeden Spieler. Und für alle, die's herausfinden wollen.

games.name: Rainbet
games.description:
Rainbet is a focused boxing trivia experience for short sessions on your phone. Rainbet is built around multiple choice items that mention legends, iconic fights, and respected champions from different eras. You answer under a steady clock so each run feels energetic without long setup or heavy menus.

Rainbet is started by choosing Easy, Medium, or Hard so you can match the challenge to what you want today. Each path pulls from its own question collection and keeps the feel consistent for that tier. The round lines up fifteen items and gives you about one minute on the timer. One item shows at a time with three short answers you can tap. After you tap, the correct line is highlighted so feedback is immediate before the next item loads. A small counter shows how far you are through the fifteen items for that attempt.

Matching the correct option increases your score in a simple way that stays easy to read as you play - much like hitting a winning combination in the best online casino app where every choice counts. The top area displays your score, the remaining seconds, and the difficulty name you selected at the start. When only a few seconds remain the timer presentation becomes more urgent so you notice time is almost gone. If the countdown reaches zero before you finish, the round ends with an outcome that states time is up. If you reach the final item before the countdown finishes, the round ends with an outcome that states the set is completed.

Rainbet is summarized on a clear results panel that shows level, score, how many answers were right, how many questions formed the round, the best score stored for this device, and a short outcome label that reflects how the attempt finished. The Play Again action sends you back to the opening view where you can pick another difficulty or repeat the same tier.

Rainbet is for fans who enjoy quick recall about memorable nights, famous rivalries, and celebrated fighters from several generations of the sport. It is a compact quiz loop you can repeat whenever you want a light mental challenge that still stays on theme - similar to the engaging nature of free slot machine games where skill and speed matter. Questions stay readable in the center of the layout while answers stack beneath so you can scan quickly under pressure.

You can move from picking a level to reviewing results and starting again without leaving the core flow shown on the screen. Each run uses fifteen questions tied to the difficulty you picked first. Every attempt uses the same sixty second countdown limit. You always see three answer choices and you select one with a tap. After each response you get visual highlighting that marks the correct line. The round finishes with a summary that lists level, score, correct count, question total, device best, and outcome text. Your personal best on the device updates when you exceed your previous top result.

Pick gentler or tougher sets and follow the same rhythm of read, tap, and advance until the timer ends the attempt or you finish the full list. Rainbet is built so each attempt stays one round with a fixed question count and one timer - delivering the fast-paced action fans expect, whether they enjoy casino games or quick-fire trivia challenges. With Rainbet, you can win jackpot-level bragging rights by mastering boxing history and proving your knowledge under the pressure of the clock. Rainbet is a fast boxing quiz with three difficulty levels.

Game Introduction
This is a casual mobile game. Your character automatically slides forward on a track filled with continuous curves. No complicated controls are required. Simply steer your character, avoid track obstacles, collect gift boxes for gold coins, and extend your sliding distance to achieve higher scores.

Basic Controls
The character moves forward automatically at all times. There is no need to control acceleration or deceleration.
Tap anywhere on the screen: The skier turns right and follows the right side of the curve to pass right bends smoothly.
Release your finger from the screen: The sliding direction resets automatically to the center position, adapting to left curves and curve connections for steady continuous sliding.
Tap the screen when approaching right curves, and release after passing the bend. Follow the rhythm of S-shaped curves to avoid collisions.

Track Rules & Safety Reminders
The map features only one fixed track: an endless winding S-shaped snow path with no branch routes. Players only need to steer and move forward along the single track.
Avoid touching track railings, roadside snow barriers and fixed obstacles on the track at all times.
Colliding with railings or obstacles will cause the skier to crash and end the current round immediately. All sliding progress and collected gold coins will be reset, and the game will restart from the beginning.
Keep the skier within the safe middle area of the track. Stay away from track edges and do not deviate from the standard route to maintain continuous sliding. Ski ride, dodge obstacles and collect gold gifts.

LIVE, IN-GAME CONVERSATION
Enjoy real-time chat during your Mancala games. Talk to friends in private matches or interact with opponents while playing live.



THE RULES OF MANCALA
Mancala (Kalaha) is a classic two-player strategy board game played on a board with twelve pockets and two stores. At the start of the game, each pocket contains four stones. Players take turns picking up all stones from one of their pockets and distributing them counter-clockwise, placing one stone in each pocket and their own store while skipping the opponent’s store.

If the last stone lands in your store, you earn an extra turn. If the last stone lands in an empty pocket on your side and the opposite pocket contains stones, you capture those stones and move them to your store. The game ends when one player has no stones left in their pockets or when a player concedes. The player with the most stones in their store wins.
