games.name: Electric Maze 3D
games.description:
Electric Maze 3D is a fast, satisfying physics puzzle where you shoot a charged particle across a neon board and let electrostatic forces bend its path. Every level places fixed + and − charges in your way—attract, repel, curve, and sling your shot until you reach the glowing ⭐ exit.

It’s simple to learn, hard to master: move and rotate your launcher, pick the charge sign, set the power, and FIRE. Use smart planning… or experiment with quick retries until you find the perfect line.

Every stage is a compact electric-field puzzle. The fixed + and − orbs are always active, constantly pushing or pulling on your fired charge as it flies. Opposites attract and like charges repel, so your route is never a straight shot for long. Fly closer to a charge to bend harder, skim past it to slingshot around, or use repulsion like a bumper to kick your path into a new lane.

Charge size matters, too: larger charges create stronger forces and can dramatically warp your trajectory, while smaller charges create gentle curves that are perfect for fine steering. Reading the board is part of the challenge—your goal is to combine sign, distance, and speed into one clean line that reaches the ⭐ exit.

Plan your move your way. Turn on AIM LINE to see your initial direction, then enable TRAJECTORY to simulate the predicted curve through the field before you commit. Adjust position, angle, and POWER (1–10) until the preview looks right. When you hit FIRE, a glowing trail shows every curve.

This game rewards experimentation because the physics is consistent. If you choose the same charge, power, position, and angle, you’ll get the same result—so every miss teaches you something. Prefer fast instincts? Shoot quickly and reset in a second. Prefer careful strategy? Use previews and tiny adjustments to land the perfect shot.

With 1,020 levels, the difficulty ramps from gentle introductions to tricky multi-charge interactions where several forces compete at once. You’ll learn to thread between repulsion zones, escape strong attractors, and set up slingshot arcs that curve around a charge and launch you straight toward the star.

New to electric puzzles? Level 1 includes a guided tutorial that walks you through the controls step-by-step.

Sound effects react when you pass near charges, with different cues for attraction and repulsion. No timers—just clean, repeatable physics puzzles and that one more try feeling.

Made for quick sessions: big touch controls, instant retry, level select, and autosave. Play in landscape for the best view and precision.

Key features:
- Choose your charge: fire + or − to attract opposites and repel like charges
- Power control (1–10) to fine-tune speed and curve
- Drag controls: slide the launcher up/down and rotate your aim angle (−90° to +90°)
- Optional helpers: AIM LINE for a straight guide and TRAJECTORY to preview the predicted path
- Instant reset + level select, with progress saved automatically
- Neon 3D look with glow effects, trails, and punchy sci‑fi sound effects

How to play:
1) Drag the launcher on the left edge to set your starting position.
2) Drag on the board to rotate the launcher angle.
3) Tap + or − to pick the electric charge you’ll fire.
4) Set POWER to control launch strength.
5) (Optional) Enable AIM LINE / TRAJECTORY to plan your shot.
6) Press FIRE and guide your charge into the ⭐ exit. If you fly off the board, try again!

Tips for clearing tough levels:
- Opposite charges pull you in—use them to “curve” around corners.
- Same charges push you away—use them like bumpers to redirect your path.
- Lower power helps with tight control; higher power can break through strong fields.

Device note:
Designed for landscape play for the best view and control.

Game progress:
Uses Google Play Games for saving game progress and automatic sign-in Physics puzzle, you shoot a +/- particle, let electrostatic forces bend its path

games.name: Virtual Villagers 7

Virtual Villagers 7 is a deep village simulation game where you guide a tribe, grow your village, explore Isola, and experience a real-time life simulator where villagers live even while you're away.

Your tribe arrives in a mysterious new region of Isola after a devastating storm. Beneath the jungle canopy lies the forgotten valley of a lost civilization, filled with enormous machines, ancient inventions, and a powerful energy known as Spark.

Your villagers live their lives in real time, even when you're away. This unique life simulation game allows your tribe to work, learn, build families, and grow while you're offline.

Harness the mysterious energy known as Spark to power incredible inventions left behind by a lost civilization. Activate ancient machines, solve puzzles, and restore balance to the island.

EXPLORE THE WORLD OF ISOLA
Travel across the island to uncover new lands and hidden secrets. Use new transportation to explore distant regions, sail the skies in an airship, cross deserts in a dune buggy, and descend into ancient mineshafts.

ENCOUNTER RIVAL TRIBES
Meet the mysterious Dwellers, a corrupted tribe who guard the ancient machines. With the help of your guide Esplora, bring peace to the island and unite the tribes of Isola.

FACE THE COGFATHER
A powerful leader known as The Cogfather stands between your tribe and the ancient machines needed to save the island. Outsmart rival factions and unlock powerful invention abilities to overcome him.

SOLVE MYSTERIES AND RESTORE THE ISLAND
Clear toxic swamps, restore frozen glaciers, rebalance scorching deserts, and repair ancient machines that once powered the island.
Every discovery helps your tribe rebuild civilization.

If you love simulation games, village simulators, or life simulation games, you’ll love guiding your tribe in Virtual Villagers 7.
Download now and begin your next village adventure. Village Life Simulation

games.name: Bhabhi Thulla The Gateway

Bhabhi Thulla: The Gateway brings the legendary South Asian card game to your
phone — beautifully animated, fully online, and built for fast 2-to-4 player
matches with friends.

▶ THE CLASSIC GAME YOU GREW UP PLAYING

Bhabhi (also known as Thulla, Get Away, or Bhabi) is the trick-taking card
game every desi household knows. A full 52-card deck is dealt evenly. Whoever
holds the Ace of Spades leads first. Follow suit if you can — if you can't,
you Thulla, and the player who held the highest card of the lead suit picks
up the entire pile. The last player still holding cards is the Bhabhi.

We've kept every rule authentic. No shortcuts. No watered-down "casual"
version. Just the real game, polished into a smooth modern experience.

▶ ONLINE MULTIPLAYER WITH FRIENDS

• Create a private room and share the 6-character code with friends
• Quick Match to instantly join other players online
• Invite friends from your in-game friends list with one tap
• Auto-fill room codes when a friend sends you an invite
• Smart turn timer keeps games moving — no waiting forever

▶ SINGLE-PLAYER VS SMART AI

• 2, 3, or 4 player matches against intelligent computer opponents
• Easy / Medium / Hard difficulty — the AI tracks suit voids and plays
strategically, just like a real opponent
• Perfect for offline play, learning the game, or quick rounds

▶ COINS, LIVES & DAILY REWARDS

• Earn coins for winning single-player games
• Send coins or lives as gifts to your friends
• 5 free lives every day — refilled automatically
• Buy more lives with coins, or grab a coin pack from the store

▶ MAKE NEW FRIENDS

• Add friends by friend code — no phone numbers, no email required
• Invite friends to rooms directly
• Add players you meet in multiplayer matches with one tap from the
game-over screen
• Real-time push notifications when it's your turn or a friend invites you

▶ DESIGNED FOR EVERY HAND SIZE

• Two-row hand layout automatically activates after big Thulla pickups
• Card animations, glow effects, and crisp sounds at every step
• Themes: Royal Green, Sunset, Midnight Velvet
• Optimized for low-end Android devices

▶ AUTHENTIC RULES, NO COMPROMISES

✓ Full 52-card deck, 13 cards per player
✓ Ace of Spades opens
✓ Follow suit when possible
✓ Off-suit play = Thulla, trick ends immediately
✓ Highest of the lead suit picks up the pile
✓ Empty your hand → you "got away"
✓ Last player holding cards = the Bhabhi

Whether you call it Bhabhi, Thulla, Bhabi, Get Away, Gateway, or just "the
auntie game," this is the version your group chat has been waiting for.

▶ PRIVACY & SAFETY

We use anonymous accounts — no email, no phone number, no personal data
required. All purchases are processed securely through Google Play. Read
our full privacy policy for details.

Download Bhabhi Thulla: The Gateway now. Gather your friends. Drop the Ace
of Spades. Don't be the Bhabhi.

games.name: Downfall - Offline Word Puzzle
games.description:
Downfall is a strategic offline word puzzle game and brain training challenge where finding the words is only half the challenge.

Trace letters across the grid to find words. When a word is found, its tiles are removed and everything above cascades down. Simple to learn, but the order you solve the words in changes the entire board. Choose wrong and you'll reach a dead end with no way out.

This isn't a word search or a crossword. Downfall is a letter puzzle that rewards strategy and planning over speed. Every level is a logic problem disguised as a word game.

HOW TO PLAY

Find words by tracing a path through adjacent letters, similar to Boggle or word connect games. Tiles fall when a word is cleared, shifting the grid. Find all the words to complete the level. Stuck? Use a hint or undo your last move and try a different approach.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Unlike most word games, Downfall isn't about finding as many words as possible. Every level has a specific set of words and a specific order that works. Spot the pattern, plan ahead, and clear the board. One wrong move and the whole puzzle changes.

As you progress through chapters, new tile types unlock that change the rules. Stone tiles are shared between words and take multiple clears to remove. Wildcard tiles match any letter. Each new tile type adds a layer to the strategy.

DAILY CHALLENGE

A new puzzle drops every day, harder than the standard levels. Your score is calculated based on time, undos used, hints used and how often you got trapped. Compete on the global leaderboard and see how you rank against players worldwide.

FEATURES

- Hundreds of puzzles across multiple chapters
- New tile types unlock as you progress
- Undo any move and rethink your approach
- Daily word challenge with a global leaderboard
- Fully offline, no internet or wifi required (excludes daily challenge)
- No account needed, no sign up required
- No timers, play at your own pace
- Free to play brain training word game

WHO IS IT FOR?

If you enjoy word search, Boggle, Wordle, word connect, or letter puzzle games, Downfall offers something deeper. A word puzzle game for adults that goes beyond finding letters and asks you to think several moves ahead. Find words, clear the board. Order matters. One wrong move changes everything.

• Blitz Rush — 20 seconds per word, auto-skip if time runs out

• Chain Reaction — get a 3-correct streak, earn +10 seconds bonus time
• High Stakes — bet on yourself before the round: hit your target word count or lose those points. (Simulated wager mechanic — no real money, no real currency. Disclosed for content-rating accuracy.)

✦ 29 LANGUAGES, 1500 WORDS EACH
Play in your own language. The dictionary covers 10 categories — Everyday, Entertainment, Sports, Science, History, Nature, Animals, Food, Travel, Fashion — across three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard). Pick the categories you want, skip the ones you don't.

Supported languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Dutch, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Serbian, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Turkish, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic.

✦ NO ADS. NO IAP. NO LOGIN.
Shout Party is free. There are no advertisements anywhere in the app, no in-app purchases in this version, and no account to create. The app does not need an internet connection to play — words are bundled with the download.

✦ PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
All data collection is OFF by default. On first launch you are asked once whether you want to share anonymous usage analytics, crash reports, or performance metrics — every toggle starts off. You can change your mind at any time in Settings → Privacy & Data. We never collect your name, email, contacts, or the Android Advertising ID. Full policy: https://sepulka.cc/shoutparty/privacy.html

✦ DESIGNED FOR GROUPS
• 2 to 6 teams, name them whatever you want
• Adjustable round length (30 / 60 / 90 / 120 seconds)
• 1, 2, or 3 lap formats — short games or full tournaments
• Optional skip penalty and overtime

✦ TECHNICAL
Android 7.0 (API 24) and up. Works offline.

games.name: Runi - Word Search
games.description:
Word puzzles, but warm. Runi is a hand-crafted word-search and crossword game you pay for once and actually own. No ads. No logins. No subscriptions. Just 480 themed puzzles, a fresh daily every morning, and a cozy little wheel of letters to swipe through.

THE WORD GAME YOU ACTUALLY OWN
Other word games keep asking. Asking you to watch a video for a hint. Asking you to upgrade. Asking you to sign in. Runi asks once - $5.99 unlocks the whole game, forever. That's it.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every level is a word salad - 4 to 7 letters scrambled on a wheel at the bottom of the screen. Drag your finger across them to spell words. The words you find slot into a themed crossword above. Touch a tile twice in a row to reuse a letter. Hit detection is tuned so the wheel feels precise even on a fast swipe. The crossword is capped to stay phone-readable, never a wall of micro-text.

12 THEMED PACKS, 360 HAND-CURATED LEVELS
Every crossword has a theme that holds it together. Forest, Ocean, Cosmos, Archive, Kitchen, Critters, Music, Body, Weather, Sport, Garden, Travel - 30 levels each, every target word on-theme. Bonus words pulled from a 4,675-word common-word dictionary so the surprises feel earned, not random.

KIDS MODE, 6 PACKS, 120 LEVELS
A separate kid-friendly mode with shorter wheels, simpler themes, and big-friendly tiles. Colors, Critters, Numbers, Playtime, Wheels, Yum. The first pack in each mode is free forever - try before you buy.

A NEW DAILY EVERY MORNING
One puzzle a day, free for everyone, generated fresh. Finish it for bonus hints. Build a streak. No notifications nagging you, no "come back" pop-ups - it's there when you want it.

HINTS AND SKIPS, HANDLED FAIRLY
Start with 10 hints and 3 skips. Refresh every 24 hours. Earn more by finding bonus words and clearing levels. No coin economy, no premium currency, no "watch an ad for a hint" - the loop is just play, earn, play.

iCLOUD SYNC, PRIVATELY
Progress, favourites, settings, wallet - all sync across your iPhone and iPad via your Apple ID. No account to create. No data sent to us. Apple's iCloud, your data, full stop.

WHAT YOU GET WITH RUNI PRO
- All 12 themed adult packs (360 puzzles)
- All 6 kids packs (120 puzzles)
- Every future pack we ship, included
- No price increase for existing players, ever

WHAT YOU GET FREE, FOREVER
- The full Forest pack (30 puzzles)
- The first kids pack
- A fresh daily puzzle, every day
- No ads. None. Not even a "watch to unlock" button.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No login. No accounts. No analytics. No tracking SDKs. No ads, so no ad networks. Runi doesn't know who you are and doesn't want to. Made small on purpose.

Privacy policy: https://sararu.net/runi/privacy-policy.html
Terms of use: https://sararu.net/runi/terms-of-use.html A small win, every morning. Drag the wheel, words appear, the day softens. 480 themed puzzles + a fresh daily. One unlock. No ads, no logins, no subscriptions. Daily word salad crossword

games.name: Loki's Leikr
subcategories: Board games with a Norse soul
games.description:
Loki's Leikr brings together eight classic board games in one beautiful
app, unified by a Norse-inspired aesthetic.

THE GAMES

• Ludo - the classic Norwegian Ludo with two named rule sets ("Hoenir"
  from Norway and "Røros" with extra attack rules), plus a custom mode
  where you can toggle 10 individual rule settings yourself.

• Backgammon - three variants (Standard, Hypergammon, Acey-deucy), an
  optional doubling cube, and match play to 1, 3, 5, or 7 points.

• Hnefatafl - the Viking board game where attackers try to surround
  the king and defenders help him escape to a corner. Three board
  sizes: Tablut 9×9, Hnefatafl 11×11, and Alea Evangelii 19×19.

• Nine Men's Morris (Mylna) - two variants (9-piece and 12-piece, the
  latter with extra diagonals and four extra mills), with an optional
  flying phase when one side has only three pieces left.

• Draughts (Dam / Checkers) - five international variants: English,
  Russian, International (10×10), Canadian (12×12), and Turkish (with
  orthogonal rather than diagonal movement).

• Alquerque - the medieval Iberian ancestor of modern draughts,
  played on a 5×5 graph with 12 pieces per side.

• Gomoku - five in a row. Two rule sets (Free Gomoku and Standard
  Gomoku) and two board sizes (13×13 and 15×15).

• Chess - classic FIDE chess with three AI difficulty levels (Easy,
  Normal, Hard), optional time controls (5+0, 10+0, 15+10, or
  unlimited), an undo button, on-board legal-move hints, algebraic
  notation, and full draw-offer and resignation flows.

SHARED FEATURES

• Play solo against the AI or with a friend on the same device
  (hot-seat).
• Optional "pass the device to next player" hand-off screen.
• Statistics overlay that logs all your solo games with per-game
  drill-down (variant, side, AI level, settings) and a 12-week
  time-series chart.
• iCloud sync across devices - statistics, settings, and game setups
  follow you automatically.
• Five languages: Norwegian, English, Old Norse (reconstructed
  orthography), Greek, and Portuguese. Switch live inside the app.
• Animations, sound effects, and haptic feedback for satisfying
  piece movement.
• Built-in rules tutorial for every game - no external manual needed.

PRIVACY

Loki's Leikr collects no personal information. No accounts, no email,
no advertising, no tracking, no analytics, no third-party SDKs.
Everything runs offline. iCloud sync (optional) goes directly between
your own devices via Apple - we never have access to the data.

DESIGN

The boards are drawn in a warm, woodgrain-inspired palette with soft
gold details. The background is a midnight-indigo starfield with a
subtle aurora at the bottom. Norse runes and typography decorate the
screen without dominating - the tone is playful and saga-tinged, not
dark or grim.

Suitable for the whole family - variants and AI difficulty levels are
adjustable so beginners and experienced players alike can find their
challenge.

Built by Okeanos AS for Hoenir.ai. Eight classic board games in one beautiful app - Ludo, Chess, Backgammon, Hnefatafl, Nine Men's Morris, Draughts, Alquerque, Gomoku. Offline, ad-free, no tracking. Board games with a Norse soul

Não exibimos anúncios no meio da digitação ou durante uma tentativa.

games.name: Hoppy Hops
games.description:
Tap to hop. Dodge to survive. Beat your best.
Meet Hoppy — a tiny green frog with one ambition: hop as far as he possibly can. Standing in his way? A relentless gauntlet of lily-pad columns, each gap narrower than the last. Standing with him? Just keep tapping.
Hoppy Hops is a charming one-touch arcade game built for the moments between everything else. Waiting in line. Riding the bus. The two minutes before your next meeting. Pick it up, tap your way past a few obstacles, set a new record, put it down. Or don't. (Most people don't.)
WHAT MAKES HOPPY HOP

Pure one-tap controls — no buttons, no joysticks, no menus to fumble
Simple to learn in five seconds, impossible to master in five hours
Endless play — every run is a fresh shot at your high score
Crisp pond-side visuals and satisfying sound effects
No timers, no energy meters, no waiting to play again
No ads interrupting your run

PERFECT FOR

Anyone who misses the golden age of pick-up-and-play arcade games
High-score chasers and one-more-try strategists
Casual players who want fun without a 40GB download
Frog enthusiasts (a small but passionate demographic)

HOW IT WORKS
Tap the screen to make Hoppy hop. Each column you clear adds a point to your score. Hit a column — or fall too far — and the run ends. Try again. (You will.)
That's it. That's the game. Sometimes the best ideas are the simplest ones.
Download Hoppy Hops free today and see how high you can go. One-tap arcade frog adventure

games.name: Point The Ways
subcategories: Find your way around the world
games.description:
POINT THE WAYS – A GEOGRAPHY GAME FOR CURIOUS MINDS

START WHERE YOU ARE
Naming countries is easy. Pointing to them is humbling. Point The Ways turns your real location into a mental map of the
world — one country at a time.

HOW IT PLAYS
Each round names a destination. You drag an arrow on the map, rotate it toward where you think the country sits, and
release. A score from 0 to 3 stars rates how close you actually got. Miss badly enough and you lose a life — you start each
session with three.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
Play Local points you at the world from your real location — the game starts at your feet. Jump Around drops you into cities
across the globe and aims you from there, each round's destination becoming the next round's origin as you carry yourself
across the map.

CHALLENGE SETS
Random pulls from anywhere on Earth for sessions that never repeat themselves. A–Z works through countries alphabetically.
Regional focuses one part of the world at a time — Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, the Middle East, or Oceania — so you
can drill the region you want to master.

FROM LOCAL TO GLOBAL
Early rounds favor countries near you. As your aim sharpens, destinations creep further: across continents, across oceans,
into corners of the map school never quite covered. The game tracks how you're playing and always serves something new, so
you'll rarely see the same destination twice.

CLIMB THE RANKS
Game Center leaderboards track your aim against players worldwide. A Rookie-to-Legend rating reflects how your sense of
direction is actually improving.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Point The Ways is free to download and play. An optional subscription removes ads and unlocks additional game modes. Pricing
may vary by region.

TERMS OF USE: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
PRIVACY POLICY: https://alexdevgru.github.io/point-the-ways-support/privacy-policy.html

SUPPORT
Questions or issues? Email ialexgru@gmail.com. Naming countries is easy. Pointing to them is humbling. A geography game that turns your real location into a mental map of the world, one country at a time. Find your way around the world

games.name: Chromies
games.description:
Chromies turns your everyday life into a playground.

Every day, a new color is revealed. Your mission: spot it around you and capture it in a photo. It's simple, addictive, and surprisingly beautiful.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

Open the app, discover today's color, and go hunting. Snap a photo, and our analysis system evaluates the quality of your shot and the accuracy of the color match. The better your snap, the more points you earn.

COLOR OF THE DAY

Every morning at 8 AM, a brand-new color drops. Nail the exact shade for a 5x multiplier, or match the color family for a 2x bonus. Shoot during golden hour to double your points. Stack the boosts for spectacular scores.

COLLECT COLORS

Over 100 shades to discover, organized by family: reds, blues, greens, purples, pinks, yellows, oranges, browns, and more. Every snap adds a new shade to your collection. How many colors can you unlock?

EXPLORE YOUR CITY AND THE WORLD

Every photo is geotagged. Discover new neighborhoods, new cities, new countries. Your map fills up with each chromatic adventure. Colors are everywhere — you just need to look up.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD

Compete against other players in weekly leagues. Every week, a fresh start, a new challenge. Stack up points, improve your rank, and prove you've got the sharpest eye.

UNLOCK BADGES

Two quest tracks await you:
• Color Track — from Color Curious (3 colors) all the way to Full Spectrum (104 colors)
• Place Track — from First Steps (1 city) to Cartographer (40 cities)
Every badge you unlock rewards your progress and curiosity.

KEEP YOUR STREAK ALIVE

Snap every day to build your streak. The longer it lasts, the higher your status: Spark, En Route, Flame, Inferno. Don't let the fire go out.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Follow friends, discover their snaps in the activity feed, and react to their finds. Chromies is more fun together.

Chromies is free. No purchases required to play, progress, and have fun.

Download Chromies and start seeing the world in color. The color hunt is on! Every day, a new color to find in your city. Snap a photo, earn points, climb the leaderboard and compete with friends. Ready to play? Hunt Colors with Friends

Carioca Chile is the classic 9-round rummy game from Chile, reborn for iPhone and iPad. Form trios and runs, race to lay your round objective first, and chase the lowest total score across nine increasingly tricky rounds — from "two trios" all the way to "Escala Real" without leftovers.

• Mix & match — fill empty seats with CPUs when not everyone's online yet

SIX HAND-CRAFTED THEMES
• Carioca — the signature green felt + gold accents
• Dino — playful Cretaceous critters on every card
• Tropical — sunsets, palms, marimba sound effects
• Poker — sharp casino blues
• Neon Arcade — '80s synthwave glow
• Retro 8-bit — pixel-perfect chiptune vibes

BUILT FOR iOS WITH CARE
• iCloud sync — settings, stats, and the game you're mid-way through travel automatically between your iPhone and iPad
• Haptics on every draw, meld, and Carioca call
• Four languages — English, Spanish, French, Portuguese
• Accessibility — Reduce Motion, larger text, sound + haptics toggles
• Portrait and landscape, including a polished iPad layout

PRIVACY-FIRST
• No accounts, no email collection, no tracking
• No third-party analytics, no ads
• Local game state and stats stay on your device (and your iCloud, if you allow it)
• Multiplayer rooms auto-delete 24 hours after the game ends

⏱️ DUAL-CLOCK FOCUS

A successful completion arrives when your score reaches the stage target before the session timer expires. Run out of lives first or drain the macro timer without hitting the goal, and Play Sport closes the attempt with a summary that cites the outstanding target. Prefer to bail mid-run? Play Sport honors the Quit option so you can shelve an attempt without forcing unwanted completions. ⏳

Questions roam basketball diamonds, marathon roads, cycling tours, wrestling mats, volleyball rotations, motorsport eras, multisport endurance lore, precision field-event specs, winter disciplines, governance trivia around federations, and sports science snippets.

Play Sport stays perfectly readable on small displays, prefers thumbs-first gestures alongside classic taps for absolute compatibility, and keeps commentary strictly in English across all prompts and buttons. 🎨



🤳 BUILT FOR QUICK BURSTS

The vertical full-screen layout removes all distractions, making it the companion for short breaks, commutes, or any spare moment when you crave fierce neon trivia drills shaped like sports debates distilled into thumb-length bursts. 🌟🌌🏎️✨ Play Sport - neon sport trivia - five timed stages, tap facts, beat targets fast

The pyramid widens upward, the bottom row narrowest. You can only play cards that aren't blocked from below. Tap two cards whose values add to thirteen to remove them. Aces count as 1, Jacks as 11, Queens as 12. Kings count as 13 and play alone — single-tap them to remove.

Clear all cards to win. The faster you finish and the fewer hints you use, the higher your score.

A QUIET KIND OF GAME

Pyramid Thirteen isn't designed to be addictive in the modern, exhausting sense. It's designed to give you something to do with your hands while your mind takes a break. Braize is a competitive brain game hub where you and your friends play the same games each day and fight for the top spot on a shared leaderboard. Every week resets — so it is always anyone's game.

SEVEN BRAIN GAMES, ONE LEADERBOARD
Play once a day, ranked. Your score goes straight onto the leaderboard.

Path Puzzle — Connect every node in order. Everyone gets the same puzzle daily. Compare your times directly with friends.
Math Sprint — 10 arithmetic, algebra, and sequence challenges. How fast can you go?
Memory Run — Recall and visual memory challenges that will test exactly how sharp your brain is.
Speed Tap — Fast visual recognition. Blink and you lose points.
Word Rush — Vocabulary, anagrams, and word association. For the wordsmiths.
Visual Flash — Pattern grids and dot arrays. Train your spatial reasoning.
Logic Blitz — Deduction, induction, and sequencing. Pure reasoning, timed.

ONE HONEST ATTEMPT PER GAME, PER DAY
One ranked attempt per game — that is the rule. No replays, no score shopping. After your attempt you can practice as much as you like, but only your first run counts. This makes the leaderboard real.

THE LEADERBOARD YOU WILL ACTUALLY CHECK
Weekly Standing resets every Monday — your score is the sum of every game you played that week. Everyone starts from zero. It is always competitive, always fresh. The global Brain Score leaderboard tracks your all-time total for the players who want a permanent ranking.

BRAIN BATTLE — 1v1 IN REAL TIME
Challenge a friend to a 60-second Brain Battle. You both get the same 12 challenges simultaneously. Whoever scores more wins. Watch your rank climb from Rookie all the way to Legend.

BUILT TO KEEP YOU COMING BACK
Daily streak — play every day, multiply your XP
Achievements — volume, speed, accuracy, Battle rank, and more
Level system — earn XP and climb from level 1 to 50
Green dot presence — see which friends are online right now
Instant Battle challenges — one tap to challenge any online friend

FAIR AND SIMPLE COMPETITION
Every game uses the same scoring formula: Base Points × Speed Multiplier × Streak Multiplier. Faster correct answers score more. Wrong answers score zero and reset your streak. You always know exactly why you ranked where you did.

SIGN IN WITH APPLE — nothing else. No email, no password, no tracking.

New games are added regularly. Each one slots into the same leaderboard system — no restructuring, no confusion. Braize grows with you.

games.name: Animal Solitaire by SZY
games.description:
Hundreds of adorable animals are waiting for you!

Dive into a fun and highly addictive puzzle game you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Easy to learn—but surprisingly challenging to complete! This game will test your observation skills, patience, and strategic thinking.

Only a small percentage of players can fully complete the challenge… are you one of them?

Join tens of thousands of players who are already enjoying the game every day!

--  Game Objective
Clear the board as quickly as possible by matching and removing pairs of identical tiles.

-- How to Play
Rule 1:
If two identical tiles are in the same row or column with no tiles between them, simply tap to remove them.

Rule 2:
If a tile can be moved to a position where it meets Rule 1 with its matching tile, move it first—then tap to remove the pair. Fun and challenging

games.name: Word Daily - Parole italiane
games.description:
Word Daily è il gioco quotidiano di parole italiane in stile tipografico-editoriale.

LA PAROLA DEL GIORNO
Ogni mezzanotte una nuova parola di cinque lettere, uguale per tutti. Hai sei tentativi per indovinarla. I colori ti guidano: verde se la lettera è al posto giusto, oro se è presente altrove, grigio se non c'è. Una sfida quotidiana condivisa con tutto il Paese.

SETTE MODI DI GIOCARE
- Parola del giorno — la classica, una sola al giorno, uguale per tutti
- Tematica — una parola legata a un tema diverso ogni giorno (cibo, natura, sport, cinema, geografia, professioni...)
- Modalità infinita — partite illimitate a 5 o 6 lettere, sempre disponibili
- Anagramma — lettere mescolate da 4 a 7 caratteri, rimettile nell'ordine giusto
- Percorso a livelli — 100 sfide a difficoltà crescente, raccogli le stelle
- Blitz — tre minuti per risolvere quante più parole puoi
- Boss settimanale — una parola difficile da 7 lettere, ogni lunedì

STREAK, SFIDE E BADGE
Mantieni viva la tua streak giornaliera con i freeze di sicurezza che ti coprono i giorni saltati. Otto sfide a rotazione ti danno obiettivi extra: vinci in tre mosse, completa un livello con tre stelle, fai cinque parole in Blitz. Sblocca badge collezionabili per ogni traguardo raggiunto e guarda crescere la tua griglia annuale.

DESIGN EDITORIALE
Palette crema, terracotta e oliva. Font New York serif. Sfondo carta procedurale, dettagli ornamentali. Niente gradienti chiassosi, niente animazioni stordenti — solo tipografia, colore e parole. Word Daily è un gioco quotidiano da bere come un caffè la mattina.

ITALIANO PURO
Dizionario di parole italiane reali. A fine partita scopri il significato della parola tramite Wikipedia e Wiktionary, integrato direttamente nell'app — così impari qualcosa ogni giorno. Adatto a tutta la famiglia.

WIDGET, GAME CENTER, iCLOUD
— Widget Home Screen con lo stato della parola di oggi e la streak corrente
— 5 classifiche Game Center per misurarti con tutta Italia
— 16 obiettivi da sbloccare nel tuo profilo Game Center
— Sync iCloud automatico tra iPhone, iPad e qualsiasi nuovo device
— Promemoria mattutini configurabili dall'orario che preferisci, opzionali

DIFFICOLTÀ A MISURA
Tre livelli di difficoltà al primo avvio: Assistita (con suggerimenti automatici), Standard (la classica), Difficile (ogni tentativo deve usare gli indizi raccolti). Cambia idea quando vuoi dalle Impostazioni.

PERFETTO PER...
Chi ama le parole italiane e i puzzle eleganti. Chi cerca un'alternativa quotidiana e silenziosa ai giochi urlati. Chi vuole tenere allenato il proprio italiano un po' ogni giorno, senza fretta.

Una parola al giorno per amare l'italiano.
Word Daily ti aspetta ogni mattina.

games.name: Trace Memory Game
games.description:
A shape flashes on screen. You have to redraw it from memory — in the same place, at the same size, before time runs out.

Trace is a memory recall game. Every round walks through three phases: memorize, recall, score. The shorter the flash, the harder it gets. From a generous three-second look on Beginner to a brutal 0.3-second flash on Master, every recall tests your visual memory and your motor precision.

WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE
- 15 hand-tuned Basics shapes — circles, stars, infinity loops, hearts, spirals, more
- Daily challenge: same shape worldwide every day, with a daily streak that builds across days
- All six difficulties: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, Master
- The full scoring breakdown — shape match, position match, scale match — shown after every round so you understand exactly why you scored what you did

UNLOCK TRACE PRO ($2.99 ONE-TIME)
- 106 more shapes across 7 categories: Nature, Animals, Faces, Zig-zags, Constellations, Symbols, and the full A–Z Alphabet
- Streak mode: chain perfect recalls in a single run with a combo multiplier that grows up to 3x. Earn zero stars on any round and the run ends.
- Future shape packs and game modes included at no extra cost

HOW SCORING WORKS
Three sub-scores combine into your final accuracy: how close your drawn curve is to the target shape, how close your stroke's centroid is to the original position on the canvas, and how close your bounding-box span is to the original scale. Faster recalls earn speed bonus points. Recalls completed in a single unbroken stroke earn an extra +100. Stars are awarded based on your total points, capped at three.

DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
- One-time purchase. No subscriptions. No ads. No third-party tracking. No analytics.
- Plays entirely offline — only contacts Apple's StoreKit, and only when you initiate a purchase or restore.
- Phone calls or notifications mid-round automatically pause the round timer so you don't lose progress to interruptions.
- Full VoiceOver support across every screen.
- Dark-mode native.

PRIVACY
Trace collects no personal data. Game progress is stored only on your device. Your finger drawings exist only in memory during a single round and are discarded as soon as the next round begins — they're never written to disk, transmitted, or shared. The complete privacy policy is linked from the in-app Settings screen.

Built by an indie developer in Würzburg, Germany. Memorize a shape. Watch it vanish. Redraw it from memory in the same place at the same size. 121 shapes across 8 categories. Faster flash, harder recall. Memorize. Recall. Score.

games.name: Geopunk
games.description:
Geopunk is a daily country-guessing game wrapped in 80s cyberpunk neon. Three modes, three drops a day: guess by shape, by flag, by capital. Six guesses each. A compass arrow and distance after every wrong shape; one shot per round for flags and capitals. Find it before you run out.

A new trio drops every day at midnight, local time. Everyone gets the same puzzles. Compare streaks. Post your share card. Find out who actually knows their geography.

— THREE DAILY DROPS
SHAPE: country outline, compass bearing and distance after each guess. Hard mode rotates the shape. North isn't up.
FLAG: identify the country from its flag.

games.name: Arrows: Line Escape

Master the Art of the Perfect Exit!
Are you ready to untangle your mind and put your logic skills to the ultimate test? Welcome to Arrows: Line Escape — a beautifully minimalist puzzle experience where simple directions evolve into deeply satisfying brain-teasing challenges.
At first glance, the rules seem easy: every arrow must escape the board by moving in the direction it faces. But there’s a catch — arrows can block each other, paths overlap, and one careless move can trap the entire puzzle. Success depends on careful planning, smart sequencing, and the ability to think several moves ahead.
Every level is a delicate chain reaction waiting to happen. One perfect move can clear the path for everything else, while one mistake can turn order into chaos. Whether you’re a casual player looking to relax or a puzzle enthusiast searching for a true mental workout, Arrows: Line Escape delivers a rewarding experience that constantly challenges the way you think.
Designed with clean visuals, smooth interactions, and a calming atmosphere, the game strips away distractions and focuses entirely on pure puzzle-solving satisfaction. No unnecessary clutter — just you, the board, and the challenge of finding the perfect escape route.
As you progress, the puzzles become increasingly complex, introducing tighter spaces, trickier layouts, and mind-bending arrangements that require patience, strategy, and precision. Every completed level feels earned, creating that satisfying “aha!” moment puzzle lovers crave.

Why You’ll Love Arrows: Line Escape
Minimalist and elegant puzzle design
Easy to learn, challenging to master
Hundreds of handcrafted logic puzzles
Smooth and satisfying gameplay
Train your brain with strategic thinking
Improve planning, focus, and spatial awareness
Relaxing visuals with mentally engaging gameplay
A rewarding experience for players of all skill levels
A Puzzle Game That Keeps Your Mind Moving

Unlike traditional puzzle games, Arrows: Line Escape is all about movement order and spatial logic. Every arrow affects the others, meaning each decision matters. The deeper you go, the more you’ll discover clever solutions, hidden patterns, and unexpected strategies.

Some levels may look impossible at first — until suddenly the perfect sequence clicks into place. That moment of clarity is what makes the game so addictive.
Relaxing Yet Deeply Challenging
The calm presentation makes the experience relaxing, but don’t be fooled — beneath the minimalist design lies a surprisingly deep puzzle system built to test your reasoning and patience. It’s the perfect balance between stress-free gameplay and meaningful mental challenge.

Whether you play for a few minutes during a break or spend hours solving advanced stages, Arrows: Line Escape offers a satisfying journey filled with clever puzzles and rewarding progression.

——————————————————————————

games.name: Schulte Table - Focus Test
games.description:
Sharpen your focus and visual scanning. Train your mind with the classic Schulte Table.

Find the numbers from 1 to 25 in a 5x5 grid and tap them in order — fast as you can. Lower time means sharper focus.

[How to Play]
- A 5x5 grid of shuffled numbers from 1 to 25
- Tap the numbers in order: 1, 2, 3, all the way to 25
- Wrong taps flash red — stay accurate
- Your final time decides your rank

[5 Focus Ranks]
- Lightning Mind (under 25s) — Top 1% concentration
- Sharp Focus (under 35s) — Razor-sharp attention
- Focused (under 50s) — Solid scanning ability
- Trainee (under 75s) — Building focus muscle
- Beginner (75s+) — Everyone starts here

[Key Features]
- Test mode: timed 5x5 round with tier ranking
- Practice mode: endless reshuffle, round counter, last-time display
- Personal best tracking — beat your own record
- Wrong tap detection with instant visual feedback
- Easy / Classic mode toggle — show progress or take the original pure Schulte test
- 5 grid sizes: 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, 6×6, 7×7 — escalate difficulty as you improve
- Two scan directions: ascending (1→N) or descending (N→1)
- History screen — personal best per grid size, recent times chart, attempt counter
- 9 languages supported: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese
- Clean dark UI designed for distraction-free focus

[Why Schulte Table]
The Schulte Table was created by Walter Schulte in the 1950s and is widely used for:
- Speed reading practice
- Peripheral vision training
- Concentration warm-up
- Cognitive exercise for all ages

Train your focus. Beat your record. How fast can you find them all? Train focus and visual scanning with the classic Schulte Table. Tap numbers 1 to 25 in order — fast as you can. Track your time and beat your record! Train focus and speed reading

games.name: Shedding Game
games.description:
Shed your hand, outplay your friends. Shedding Game brings the classic card game online — fast rounds, clever specials, and a Bridge mechanic that can flip the score in a single turn. Jump into a match in seconds, solo with bots or with friends around the world.


HOW IT PLAYS

Discard your cards by matching suit or rank. First to empty their hand wins the round — but every card left in opponents' hands adds points against them. Cross 125 points and you're eliminated. Last player standing takes the game.


SPECIAL CARDS

• 6 — Take another turn, any suit
• 7 — Next player draws 2 (or stacks another 7)
• 8 — Next player auto-draws 1 per eight played
• Jack — Wild card. Finish with jacks for -20 per opponent
• Ace — Skip the next player


THE BRIDGE

When the last four cards of the discard pile share the same rank, you can apply a Bridge — instantly ending the round and doubling every player's score. Time it right and you'll turn a losing hand into a game-winning move.


FEATURES

• Online multiplayer — create a room, share the invite link, start playing
• Play with bots — practice anytime, no waiting
• Smart bot takeover — players who disconnect are covered so the round keeps flowing
• Turn timer — no more waiting on slow hands
• Live emoji reactions — trash talk without saying a word
• Full scoreboard and round history
• Game rules and tips built into the app
• Personal stats — games played, wins, win rate
• Haptic feedback for card actions and timer alerts
• Dark interface designed for long sessions
• Multi-language support (English, Ukrainian)


SIGN IN YOUR WAY

Sign in with Apple, Google, or email — switch methods anytime. Your username, stats, and friends follow you across devices.


FREE TO PLAY

No ads. No pay-to-win. Just the card game you grew up with, built for the way you play now.


PRO TIPS

• Tap the discard pile to peek at the last 4 cards
• Save your Jacks for a big finish — the -20 bonus stacks per opponent
• Hitting exactly 115 points resets you to 0. Push for the flip.
• Watch for Bridge setups — four of a kind can change everything

Invite your friends, gather at the table, and play. The cards are dealt. Online multiplayer card game

games.description:
FreeCell 32000 is a game for the rest of your life.

All 32,000 hand-numbered Microsoft FreeCell deals are here, in their original order. Deal #1 is the same deal that opened in Windows FreeCell in 1995. Deal #11982 is the famously unsolvable one. Every deal in between is yours to clear, in any order, for as long as you keep playing.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• All 32,000 numbered deals — the original Microsoft sequence
• Daily deal — same deal for every player, every day
• Pick any deal — jump straight to #1, #11982, or any number you want
• Continue — the app remembers the next deal you haven't won
• Replay every game you've ever played, move by move
• Stats by today / week / month / year / all-time
• Undo as far back as you like
• Restart the current deal in one tap
• iCloud sync — your progress travels with your Apple ID
• Game Center — global leaderboard for the race to 32,000, plus a
  daily-time leaderboard and tier achievements

NO CLUTTER
No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking. No accounts to create. No internet required to play. Open the app, pick up where you left off.

CRAFTED
Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad. Drag, drop, double-tap to auto-send. The whole app is one focused experience — three tabs, no modals begging for your attention.

HERITAGE
FreeCell was invented by Paul Alfille in 1978 and reached the world through Microsoft Windows in 1995. The 32,000 deals here use Jim Horne's original LCG — the same numbering Windows shipped with. Built to be kept. Quiets my kid without hooking him. Connects you with grandpa. Stays with me for life. Catch me on the leaderboard if you can. A game for the rest of life.

  WHAT'S FREE, WHAT'S PRO

  • Klondike
  • Green felt

  • Every animation, hint, stat, and quality-of-life feature

Features

• 304 players in the bundled roster — no internet needed to play.

• Private by design. No accounts, no logins, no data leaves your device beyond anonymous usage analytics.
• A clean grid that flips, fills, and rewards you when you finally land the right player.

How it works

1. Tap the search bar and type any current player.
2. Tap the player to submit your guess.
3. Read the row of clues that flips into view. Green means exact match, yellow means close (with an arrow showing higher or lower for height and age), gray means no match.
4. Use what you've learned to refine the next guess. Keep going until the row goes all green.
5. Come back tomorrow for a new player.

Whoops Hoops is built for the daily ritual: open it once, play once, and put it down. There's no inventory, no IAP, no ads, no scoreboard you have to compete on. Just one player a day, and a streak that grows when you keep showing up.

Core Gameplay:
At the start, you are presented with a grid of varying sizes, ranging from 4x4 up to 6x6. Each cell within the grid displays a combination of one of four colors (Red, Yellow, Blue, Green) and one of four geometric shapes (Circle, Square, Triangle, Cross).

The challenge begins after a brief three-second static observation period. The entire matrix will begin to periodically shift and deform. Each transformation consists of a grid rotation accompanied by the diffusion of cell attributes—where a color or shape from one cell spreads to its neighbors.

Your objective is to quickly identify and click the specific cell that matches the condition displayed at the top of the screen. Identifying the correct cell rewards you with points and extra time, while incorrect taps will result in point deductions and instantly trigger an additional chaotic deformation of the grid. A game that tests your reflexes in a shifting grid of colors and shapes.

The core combat is simple: you and your opponent each draw one card. The one with the highest power takes all the played cards! But if the power is tied, a "War" begins: players draw additional cards face down and face up, raising the stakes to the limit.

🧩 SMART DEPLOYMENT
After gathering enough cards, you enter the Deployment phase. This is your chance to turn the game around:
— Place cards in 6 slots to trigger powerful effects.
— Your own cards give you buffs, increasing your deck's power.
— Enemy trophy cards apply debuffs! Place them wisely until you can convert them to your side.
— Use unique mechanics: Reroll unwanted cards, Swap their positions on the board, or use Prediction to peek at the enemy's future moves!

🃏 BUILD THE PERFECT DECK
After every victory against an opponent, you claim some of their cards. On the Merge screen, you can:
— Combine 3 identical cards into one card of a higher rarity (from Common to Legendary).
— Spend Influence to recolor an enemy card into your own, turning its debuffs into powerful bonuses.
— Burn excess cards to gain valuable resources.

📈 INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION
Lost? No problem! Every attempt makes you stronger. Earned gold is kept after a defeat. Spend it on global upgrades to prepare for a new run:
— Gain "Royal Insight" or "Tactical Exchange" for a combat advantage.
— Increase your starting Influence with "Noble Pedigree".
— Unlock advanced card alchemy features through "Equal Trade" and other unique upgrades.

With each new run, you'll progress further and further. Start small, adapt your strategy, hoard gold, and become a master of Topdeck Duel! Incremental card roguelike

games.name: Dutch Card Game
games.description:
**Gameplay:**
• Tap the draw pile to draw a card
• Select a card from your hand to play (**Clear and collect mode** - excluding collection cards)
• Play cards with same rank as last played card (out of turn)
• Queens let you peek at face down cards from any player's hand, including your own.
• Jacks let you swap any 2 cards from any player's hand, including your own (**Clear and collect mode** - Including collection cards)

• **Clear and collect mode** - Collect cards from discard pile if they match your collection rank. Collecting all 4 cards of your rank wins the game.


**Final Round:**
If you think you have the least points during your turn, you can call **final round** after you play your card. This will trigger the final round - this was your final round so you won't play again.

**Winning:**
• Player with **no cards** wins
• Player with **least points** wins
• If same points, player with **least cards** wins
• If same points and same cards, player who **called final round** wins

• **Clear and collect mode** - The player that collects all 4 cards of their rank wins the game. Clear all cards from your hand or end the game with the least points.

DEDUCTION, NOT LUCK

Welcome to ReMolthar.

Collect pearls, awaken characters in your portal, and engage in an intense battle of wits toward 12 points.

■ Goal of the Game

Collect Pearl Cards (1–8) and meet activation cost requirements to activate Character Cards and earn points.
The first player to reach 12 points triggers the final round. After all players take one additional turn, the player with the highest score wins.

■ Turn Structure

Each turn consists of 3 actions. For each action, choose one of the following:

Take 1 Pearl Card from either the Pearl Deck or the open market
Place 1 Character Card from either the Character Deck or open characters into your portal
Activate a character in your portal using Pearl Cards from your hand (gain points)
Refresh all 4 cards in the Pearl Market
■ Diverse Activation Costs

Each character requires a unique pearl combination.

Examples include:

2 / 3 / 4 of the same number
3 / 5 consecutive numbers
Total sums of 7 / 10 / 20
3 even numbers
3 odd numbers
Two pairs
Pair + a set of 6
Specific combinations (e.g. 2,2,2 / 3,4,5 / 1,3,5,7)

With over 30 different cost patterns, every game demands a new strategy.

■ Diamond System

When activating a character, you may spend 1 Diamond to adjust the value of one Pearl Card by ±1.
This can become the key to completing difficult combinations.

Numdrop is a fast, colorful brain game where every second counts. Tap, trace and slide your way through quick rounds designed to sharpen reflexes, focus and pattern recognition, with simple rules and a difficulty curve that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Whether you have one minute or one hour, Numdrop is built to be picked up instantly and played anywhere.

The Classic mode drops colored numbered tiles from the top of the screen, and your job is to tap the next number for each color before it leaves the screen. Levels get faster, denser and more demanding as you progress, rewarding clean reactions and disciplined attention. It’s the heart of Numdrop and the perfect place to start.

In Path, the game shows a color-and-number sequence that you must trace by dragging across the grid before time runs out. It’s a clean blend of memory and routing: see the pattern, plan the move, deliver the line — all under pressure. Each round adds new constraints, so the more confident you become, the more interesting the puzzles get.

Trace strips the experience down to its essence. A colored shape appears on the grid, and you have to cover it in one continuous stroke, visiting every highlighted cell exactly once, with no numbers and no distractions. It’s pure path-finding, calming and addictive at the same time, with figures that range from playful to genuinely tricky.

Slide brings an endless puzzle loop with 3×3 sliding boards. Checkpoints every five rounds keep your progress safe, and a free retry per puzzle lets you experiment without breaking momentum. It’s ideal for quick sessions when you want a satisfying mental warm-up rather than a long match.

A redesigned home screen brings all four modes together in a clean, glanceable layout that highlights your personal best for each mode. This makes it easy to pick where you want to push next, whether you’re chasing a new record in Classic or exploring the latest patterns in Path, Trace and Slide.

Numdrop is also designed with privacy and transparency in mind. On iOS, the App Tracking Transparency prompt appears at first launch, before any tracking-related SDK is initialized. The Google UMP/GDPR consent flow is shown when applicable, before ads are initialized, so users in regulated regions are always asked first. When tracking or personalization consent is not granted, the app gracefully falls back to non-personalized advertising instead of disabling content.

Whether you’re a casual player looking for a relaxing puzzle break or a competitive mind chasing perfect runs and new high scores, Numdrop offers a small, focused, beautifully crafted experience you can come back to every day. Tap the right number

games.name: KadiTiri

Bring the authentic Gujarati card game experience to your fingertips!
KadiTiri (કાડી તીરી) is a traditional, strategic trick-taking card game popular in the Gujarat region of India. Now, you can enjoy this unique multiplayer experience with friends and family anywhere in the world—from Gujarat to Canada and beyond!

WHAT IS KADITIRI?
KadiTiri is a point-based bidding game that combines strategy, memory, and hidden-team mechanics. Unlike standard card games, your teammates are unknown at the start! The highest bidder calls for specific "Friend" cards, and teams are only revealed as the game unfolds.
UNIQUE GAMEPLAY MECHANICS:
• Dynamic Deck Scaling: The game automatically adjusts based on the number of players. We use 1 deck for every 4 players (4 players = 1 deck, 5-8 players = 2 decks, etc.), ensuring a perfectly balanced experience every time.
• The Point System: Every card counts!
  ◦ All 5s = 5 points
  ◦ 10s, J, Q, K, and Aces = 10 points
  ◦ The Legendary 3 of Spades (Kadi Tiri) = 30 points!
• Strategic Bidding: Compete to win the bid. The winner chooses the Trump Suit and calls out their "Friends" by naming specific card instances (e.g., "The 2nd Ace of Spades").
• Hidden Teams: Are you playing with the bidder or against them? You won't know for sure until the "Friend" cards hit the table!

KEY FEATURES:
• Real-time Multiplayer: Create private rooms or join open ones. Powered by high-speed synchronization for low-latency gameplay.
• Voice Communications: Don't just play—communicate! Use built-in voice snippets to talk to other players. Featuring Text-to-Speech (TTS) support for localized phrases.
• Multilingual Support: Enjoy the game in your preferred language. Fully localized in English, Gujarati (ગુજરાતી), and Hindi (हिन्दी).
• Smooth Onboarding: New to the game? Our interactive tutorial will teach you the points, bidding, and winning logic in minutes.
• Modern Interface: Built with Jetpack Compose for a beautiful, fluid, and responsive user experience.
• Always Up-to-Date: Integrated In-App Updates ensure you never miss a feature or a bug fix.

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Bid: Based on your hand, predict how many points your team can collect.
2. Call Friends: The highest bidder chooses the Trump and calls the "Friend" cards.
3. Follow Suit: Play your cards strategically. You must follow the lead suit unless you choose to play a Trump.
4. Win: If the bidder’s team meets their point target, they win! If not, the opponents take the victory.

Whether you are looking for a quick round during a break or a long strategic battle with family, KadiTiri is the perfect digital companion for card game lovers.

Download KadiTiri today and start your journey to becoming a master bidder!

games.name: Crissly - Word Grid
games.description:
Crissly — where Wordle meets the crossword.

You know that little thrill when a Wordle falls into place. Crissly takes that same daily a-ha and weaves it into something bigger: a compact crossword grid where every word is hidden, every guess gives you Wordle-style color clues, and every letter you uncover quietly unlocks the next word.
It is the puzzle Wordle fans have been waiting for — and one of the most delightful ways to grow your English.

A smarter twist on the word game you already love:
In Crissly, you do not guess just one word. You guess a connected grid of them. For each level, you're given a grid of words that have been scrambled, and the familiar green and yellow tiles tell you what is right, what is close, and what to leave behind. Because the words cross, a letter you find in one row narrows down the column above it. A solved column hands you a head start on the row beside it. Every move ripples through the whole puzzle.
The result is a game that rewards careful thinking, lateral leaps, and the satisfying feeling of pulling a tangle of clues into a clean, complete grid.

Made for word lovers:
- A fresh daily puzzle the whole community solves together
- Easy mode with Crissly 5 and Hard mode with Crissly 7
- Streaks, stats, and quiet achievements that celebrate consistency, not noise
- Calm, distraction-free design with dark mode, large-text mode, and colorblind-friendly tiles
- No mid-puzzle ads breaking your flow

A favorite of English learners:
Crissly is built so that every minute you play, you are also learning. Tap any solved word to see its meaning, pronunciation, and an example sentence. Save tricky words to your personal vocabulary list and review them anytime in a quick flashcard mode. Difficulty levels are tuned so beginners build confidence with high-frequency words, while advanced players run into the idioms, collocations, and academic vocabulary that show up on TOEFL, IELTS, and Cambridge exams.
Teachers, tutors, and parents tell us the same thing: students who avoid traditional vocabulary drills will happily play Crissly every day. The grid does the teaching for you.

Why people stay:
- Harder than Wordle, in the way you wanted Wordle to be
- Gentler than a full crossword, so you can finish a puzzle on a coffee break
- Built for repeat play — no waiting until midnight to scratch the itch
- Treats your time and your attention with respect

Who Crissly is for:
- Wordle fans hungry for more depth and more puzzle
- Crossword lovers who want a quicker, friendlier daily fix
- English learners building vocabulary for school, work, or travel
- Teachers and parents looking for screen time that pays off
- Anyone who likes the warm satisfaction of a small, daily mental workout

A few minutes a day. A sharper mind for life.
Crissly is free to download and free to play, with optional themed packs and cosmetic touches for fans who want to go deeper. No pressure, no tricks — just one beautifully crafted grid, waiting for you.

Download Crissly and outthink the grid. Today's puzzle is ready. Wordle meets crossword. Solve a fresh word grid daily and sharpen your English.

games.name: PigPen
games.description:
Fence the pigs. Fill the field. One puzzle a day.

PigPen is a daily logic puzzle for the one-finger, coffee-break crowd — players who love Wordle, Connections, and Strands and are ready for something with a little more bite. The board is a grid of farmland with pigs scattered across it. Your job is simple to learn and surprisingly deep to master: drag fences along the grid lines to enclose every pig in its own pen, where each pen is rotationally symmetric around its pig and the whole field is partitioned with no leftover squares.

Three rules. No timers in your face. No fluff. Just a clean, satisfying daily solve.

FEATURES

• A new puzzle every day — three sizes (5×5, 7×7, 10×10), each with Standard and Hard tiers, so you can pick a quick warm-up or settle in for a Sunday-cryptic-sized challenge.
• Globally-keyed daily puzzles so leaderboards stay fair — everyone's puzzle of the day is the same puzzle.
• One-finger play — tap a fence to toggle it, drag along an axis to paint a run of fences, long-press to mark a cell.
• Live symmetry hints (optional) — your moves' rotational counterparts highlight faintly so you can feel the shape of each pen.
• Unlimited undo and redo — experiment freely without losing your place.
• Mistake checker and one daily hint per puzzle when you're truly stuck.
• Clean-solve badges for finishing without hints or mistakes.
• Stats and streaks that track your daily habit, not your wallet.
• Gorgeous, warm visual design — pigs you'll actually want to fence in.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you start your morning with a daily word game and finish it before your coffee's cold, PigPen is the next logic puzzle for your routine. It's deductive (no guessing, no trial-and-error), uniquely solvable, and hand-tuned for satisfying "aha" moments rather than tedious bookkeeping.

INSPIRED BY THE CLASSICS

PigPen is a love letter to Galaxies (Tentai Show) by Nikoli — one of the most elegant pen-and-paper puzzle formats ever invented — reimagined with a warmer hook, modern progression, and the daily cadence that makes a puzzle a habit.

Get one puzzle a day. Build a streak. Become the kind of person who fences pigs. Fence the pigs. Fill the field. A new daily logic puzzle for the Wordle crowd — three rules, three sizes, one 
  satisfying solve. Build your streak.

games.name: INFINITE ZENSAW
games.description:
INFINITE ZENSAW - Shikaku Puzzle Game

Discover the ancient Japanese logic puzzle reimagined for endless play. Infinite Zensaw challenges your mind with Shikaku - a deceptively simple yet deeply satisfying number-grid puzzle where you divide a board into rectangles, each containing exactly one number equal to its area.

No timers forcing you to rush. No ads interrupting your flow. No accounts to create. Just pure, focused puzzle-solving at your own pace.

-- HOW TO PLAY --
* Each puzzle presents a grid filled with numbers.
* Drag to draw rectangles around the numbers.
* Every rectangle's area must match its number exactly.
* Every cell in the grid must be covered - no gaps, no overlaps.
* When the grid is perfectly divided, the puzzle is solved.

It sounds simple. It becomes beautifully complex.

-- INFINITE PUZZLES --
Never run out of challenges. Infinite Zensaw includes a built-in puzzle generator that creates a brand-new, valid Shikaku puzzle every time you tap Shuffle - verified solvable, perfectly balanced, and unique every time. Solve one, generate another. There is no finish line.

-- ZEN FEATURES --
* Seasonal themes - Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall color palettes
* Light and Dark mode - switch instantly to match your environment
* Optional timer - track your speed or play without pressure
* Gentle sound effects - harmonic chimes that reward progress
* Grid rotation - solve puzzles from a new angle
* Reset button - optional on-screen reset for quick restarts
* Offline play - every puzzle works without an internet connection

-- NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNTS. --
Infinite Zensaw collects zero personal information. There are no advertising SDKs, no behavioral tracking, no analytics networks, and no data transmitted off your device. Your progress and preferences are stored locally only - on your device, under your control.

This app is COPPA compliant and safe for users of all ages, including children under 13.

-- ACCESSIBILITY --
Infinite Zensaw is designed to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards:
* Full keyboard navigation - all controls reachable via Tab and Enter
* Screen reader compatible - descriptive ARIA labels on all interactive elements
* Reduced motion support - animations minimized when system preference is set
* High contrast mode compatibility
* All touch targets meet the 44x44pt minimum size requirement
* Skip-to-content link for assistive technology users

-- WHO IS THIS FOR? --
Infinite Zensaw is for anyone who loves quiet, focused brain games. Whether you're a lifelong logic puzzle fan, a Sudoku player looking for something new, or someone who just wants a calming daily challenge - Infinite Zensaw meets you where you are.

Great for:
* Logic and math puzzle enthusiasts
* Fans of Sudoku, Nonograms, Picross, and Kakuro
* People seeking a mindful, screen-time alternative
* Students building spatial reasoning and pattern recognition skills
* Anyone who wants a puzzle game that respects their attention

-- 99 Cents --
Everything in Infinite Zensaw is game play forever.

Download Infinite Zensaw and find your flow. Infinite puzzles. version 1.0-Zero ads. Pure logic. Divide grids into rectangles and find your zen — a new Shikaku challenge every time you play. Endless Shikaku Logic Puzzles

games.name: Ho! Intégral
games.description:
Une application pédagogique québécoise pour apprendre les homophones de manière ludique et magique!
Ho! Homophones est une application éducative conçue au Québec par une orthopédagogue passionner par l’apprentissage ludique depuis 25 ans. Cette appli ne nécessite aucun réabonnement, aucuns frais supplémentaires. 
L’objectif? 
Aider les jeunes de 8 à 14 ans à maîtriser les homophones les plus fréquents grâce à des phrases farfelues aux défis adaptés, des quêtes amusantes et un univers délirant rempli de potions, d'ingrédients secrets… et de transformations loufoques!

À qui s’adresse cette application?
Ho! Homophones s’adresse aux élèves en apprentissage régulier, ou ceux ayant des besoins particuliers, incluant les jeunes avec un trouble du langage écrit (dyslexie/dysorthographie) L’application est idéale pour :
les enfants confondant souvent a / à, son / sont, ces / ses, tous/tout/toute/toutes/toux, etc.
les élèves qui ont besoin de répétition, de motivation et de rétroaction concrète.

Fonctionnement de l’application :
1) Exercices interactifs sur les homophones
Le joueur doit choisir la bonne orthographe parmi plusieurs propositions selon le contexte d’une phrase. Aucune limite de temps n’est imposée à l’apprenant. Chaque bonne réponse lui permet de gagner un ingrédient magique!
2) Création d’élixirs loufoques
Une fois tous les ingrédients récoltés, l’élève concocte une potion… que notre savant fou boit aussitôt dans son laboratoire le plus déjanté Résultat? Une transformation hilarante :
Savant fou transformé en rat intelligent
Savant fou devenu vieillard sage
Savant fou congelé dans un glaçon géant
Et bien d'autres encore!
3) Indicateurs visuels de progression
Cercles d’ingrédients : indique les éléments manquants pour concocter la potion.
Chemin de quête : chaque bonne réponse permet d’avancer dans un chemin menant à l’ultime transformation du scientifique bizarroïde!


Une application personnalisable
Chaque jeune peut avoir son propre profil. Les adultes peuvent choisir les homophones à travailler en priorité. Il est possible de créer des parcours sur mesure pour un élève en particulier. Par exemple, se concentrer uniquement sur les confusions entre, ce / se, ou ou / où. L’apprenant voit son niveau de réussite pour chaque quête accomplie. Il lui est possible de reprendre une même quête autant de fois qu’il le désire, son dernier résultat sera toujours affiché.

Pourquoi cette application est efficace?
Développée par une orthopédagogue, Ho! Homophone respecte les étapes de l’apprentissage de l’orthographe grammaticale. Chaque défi est conçu pour proposer un niveau de difficulté adapté, des rétroactions claires, et un renforcement positif immédiat. Une seule phrase est présentée à la fois pour éviter l’encombrement perceptif, ou une sensation de surcharge cognitive.

L’aspect ludique des transformations du savant fou agit comme un puissant levier de motivation et d’apprentissage. L’enfant a hâte de découvrir quelle forme étrange prendra le savant à la prochaine potion!

Crédits :
Conception pédagogique : Annie Lussier
Développement : Chea Sophir Vuong & Antoine Denis
Design graphique : Victor Gileau
Marketing : Clinique Apprendre!

Ho! Homophone, c’est apprendre à distinguer les homophones tout en s’amusant… et en riant des phrases et métamorphoses absurdes du savant fou!

A word puzzle with the tension of a falling-piece classic and the vocabulary of a relaxed Sunday crossword. Every tap is a small decision. Place this E now and chase a five-letter score, or hold the slot open for the rare Q sitting two rows up. The board rewards patience and punishes greed, gently.

WHY PLAYERS KEEP COMING BACK
• Quick five to seven minute rounds that fit between meetings, train stops, or one last yawn before sleep

WHO IT IS FOR
Made for the player who keeps a crossword app on the home screen, has a favorite Sunday word game, or just wants five honest minutes that leave the brain a little sharper than before.

THE FEEL

games.name: Mala Ronda
games.description:
Mala Ronda no es un trivial cualquiera.
Es preguntas, cartas, trampas y —si te atreves— apuestas sociales.
Todo lo que necesitas para que alguien se enfade de verdad.

Elige modo y prepárate para ganar, perder y jurar venganza.

TRES MODOS, TRES MANERAS DE QUEDAR MAL
• Lobo Solitario: tú contra ti mismo, sin red.
Sin rivales, sin cartas, sin excusas.
Funciona sin conexión... Si pierdes, no le eches la culpa al WiFi.
• Por Turnos: para los que piensan (o eso creen).
Respondes en tu turno mientras los demás miran y se ríen.
• Grupal: para los que aprietan antes de leer.
Todos ven la misma pregunta a la vez. Gana el primero que acierta.

32 CARTAS, MUCHO DRAMA
Por Turnos y Grupal tienen 16 cartas cada uno: 8 de beneficio y 8 de perjuicio. Aquí el fair play no existe.

Beneficios: escudos, boomerangs, pistas, turnos extra, robar el turno, vampiros que se llevan los puntos del rival, apagones que retrasan a todos menos a ti…
Perjuicios: roba puntos en secreto, congela la pantalla del rival, ciérrale la boca, déjale las opciones ocultas, emborrónale la pregunta, átale las manos para que no use cartas, mándale una multa exprés y mucho más.

VARIOS TIPOS DE PREGUNTAS
• Verdadero / Falso: 50% de acertar, 100% de arrepentirte.
• 4 opciones: una correcta y tres que parecen correctas hasta que eliges una.
• Imagen: una foto y cuatro opciones. Si no sabes lo que miras, estás perdido.
• Imagen con efecto: la imagen se revela poco a poco. Cuanto antes respondas, más puntos. Cuanto más esperes, más evidente… y menos puntos.
• Palabra oculta: dos imágenes, una palabra que las conecta. Tecléala letra a letra antes de que se acabe el tiempo.

22 LOGROS PARA PRESUMIR DE TUS FECHORÍAS
Unos caen en la primera partida, otros te van a costar sudor y una racha decente. Hay medallas por ganar, por robar turnos, por trasnochar a horas indecentes e incluso por acabar una partida en números rojos. Tu progreso se sincroniza con tu cuenta: cambias de móvil y tus fechorías siguen ahí, presumiendo por ti.

APUESTAS SOCIALES (SI TE ATREVES)
Opcional, pero mucho más divertido. Nada de dinero real: solo retos entre colegas. El que pierde paga la ronda, friega los platos o baila lo que diga el grupo.

PÚBLICA O PRIVADA, TÚ MANDAS
Abre la sala a desconocidos y que se sumen al caos, o ciérrala con código de 6 caracteres y arruina amistades en petit comité. De 2 a 6 jugadores.

INVITA EN UN CLIC
Comparte un enlace y tus víctimas entran directas a la sala. Sin códigos, sin instrucciones, sin escapatoria.

TIEMPO REAL, CERO ESPERAS
Multijugador online sin turnos eternos y sin piedad.
Si alguien deja de responder, fuera. Aquí no se espera a nadie.
Al acabar, el grupo vota revancha con la misma configuración en un clic.
Spoiler: siempre la pide el que pierde.

RANKING QUE LO CUENTA TODO
Aciertos, fallos, cartas recibidas, turnos perdidos por cartas chungas, turnos extra que te cepillaste, y ahora también quién empezó la partida y quién se largó antes de acabar. Que conste por escrito quiénes son los cobardes.

ENTRA COMO QUIERAS
Apple ID, email o como invitado. Sin excusas para no jugar.

¿LISTO PARA LA MALA RONDA?

games.description:
TRIVIALE è il quiz che dubita seriamente di te.

Niente domande facili regalate. Niente "complimenti, sei un genio". Solo cultura generale vera, difficoltà che cresce col tuo livello, e un Lampi che ti prende in giro a ogni risposta sbagliata.

LE MODALITÀ DI GIOCO
- CATEGORIE: 8 mondi da esplorare. Storia, Geografia, Musica, Sport, Cinema, Scienza, Tecnologia, Cultura. 20 domande per categoria, sempre più difficili.
- VELOCE: 10 domande contro il tempo. Solo i riflessi contano.
- SFIDA: domande senza fine, difficoltà che sale. Fino al cap di 100, solo per chi sopravvive. Diventa LEGGENDA TRIVIALE.
- GIORNALIERA: 5 domande, punti doppi, una sola al giorno. Il rito quotidiano.
- MULTIPLAYER: pass-and-play locale fino a 4 amici. Sfidali nel tuo salotto, senza bisogno di connessione.

15 LIVELLI DA SCALARE
Da Schiappa a Triviale Supremo. Ogni livello sblocca un nuovo avatar e una nuova frase ironica. Filosofo da mensa, Sherlock di condominio, Politologo da spritz, Zio Wikipedia: scopri tutti i 15 personaggi.

CLASSIFICHE
Oggi, settimana, sempre. Per categoria e per modalità. Scala fino al top 100. Per chi è sotto, vedi sempre la tua posizione esatta con il banner dedicato.

LEGGENDA TRIVIALE
Per chi raggiunge il cap di 100 in Sfida: avatar dorato esclusivo + badge permanente nel profilo. Pochi ce la fanno.

PREMIUM
Niente pubblicità, vite illimitate. Una tantum, mai abbonamento. Triviale non ti vende l'aria.

PERCHÉ TRIVIALE È DIVERSO
- Difficoltà progressiva REALE: le prime domande sono facili, le ultime no.
- Quasi 4000 domande verificate, in italiano, scritte da chi sa cosa stai pensando.
- Tono ironico, mai aggressivo. Triviale ride con te, non di te. (Quasi sempre.)
- Niente paywall per le funzioni base. Niente "guarda una pubblicità per continuare".
- Multiplayer locale: nessuna connessione richiesta, nessuna lobby, nessun amico online.

GRATIS, IN ITALIANO
Login con Apple o Google per salvare i tuoi progressi su più dispositivi. Oppure gioca come ospite, senza registrazione.

Sviluppato in Italia. Domande in italiano. Frasi scritte da chi parla davvero italiano.

Vai. Triviale ti aspetta. E dubita di te.

games.name: Goalix
games.description:
Goalix is a fast-paced arcade football runner built around quick reactions and smart lane choices. You control a ball with responsive swipe steering, then read each obstacle pattern in real time: static, moving, and charging goalkeepers all create different risks. Some formations block every lane, so every decision matters. Do you cut through the center for speed, or choose the side with the smallest penalty?

As you play, you collect coins and stars to grow a trailing ball chain that acts like your survivability resource. Collisions reduce chain mass, and penalties scale with your progress, so the run naturally becomes more intense over time. Gates reward strong timing with score bonuses, while boosts add tactical moments: Shield can absorb a hit, Magnet helps vacuum pickups, Slow Motion buys thinking time, Double Score amplifies gains, and Dash gives explosive momentum.

The game is designed for short, exciting sessions with clean controls, readable visuals, and instant feedback through particles, sound, and haptics. Whether you want a quick one-minute challenge or repeated attempts to beat your best score, Goalix keeps each run tense, skill-driven, and highly replayable.

games.name: Pyramind - Polyomino Puzzle
games.description:
Twelve pieces. Fifty-five cells. Two puzzles, one shape language.

Pyramind is a quiet polyomino puzzle. You're given the same twelve pieces — five tetrominoes and seven pentominoes — and asked to fit them, exactly, into a five-row flat grid or into a five-layer pyramid. The same pieces, two completely different problems. The pyramid is the harder one. The grid is the welcoming one. Both reward patience.

There are sixteen built-in challenges across four difficulties, from First Steps to Pure Mind. Every challenge starts with a few pieces already placed, so you're never staring at an empty board with no idea where to begin. As you solve them, your best times stay with you. A Daily Challenge gives you one carefully chosen puzzle each morning — different every day, the same one for everyone playing that day.

THE SUNDAY COPPA MATCH

PROFILES & BADGES

THE RULES

2 questions daily, Monday – Sunday (morning + evening)

14 questions per week total

Streaks: attempt-based, not correct-answer-based

WHO IS IT FOR?

MONARCH GRID — a logic puzzle where you place crowns across the colored regions of the realm. Elegant, minimal, and just the right amount of tricky.

ONE WORLD, ONE PUZZLE
Every day, a single challenge — the same one for every player on Earth. Solve it, beat your best time, build your streak.

INFINITE MODE
Four difficulty tiers — Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert — calibrated by deductive complexity, not just board size. Play as many puzzles as you want, whenever you want.

HOW TO PLAY
Place one crown in each row, each column, and each colored region. Two crowns can never touch — not even diagonally. Simple rules, deep logic.

THINK CLEARLY
· Auto-mark forbidden cells when you place a crown
· Highlight errors in red so you can spot mistakes quickly
