Unlike traditional Ludo, King's Rules introduces powerful mechanics, defensive systems, and player-controlled rules that make every match unique.

🎲 Strategic King's Rules
When the first 6 is rolled, players unlock special rules that change how the game is played:

• Back Kick – Move backward by the dice roll and capture enemies on landing. Blocked by safe tiles and enemy walls.
• Line Kick – Dash parallel onto enemy tokens to capture, bypassing normal path movement.
• Home Kick – Attack across the board-home boundary for unexpected captures.
• Double Dice – Roll two dice per turn, choose which to use first. Double 6s grant two extra turns.

Rules are chosen at match start and locked in for the entire game.

🛡️ Defensive Systems
• Safe Tiles – 8 star-marked zones where tokens cannot be captured. Shelter vulnerable tokens strategically.
• Walls – 2+ same-color tokens on a tile form a Wall, blocking enemy movement and captures.
• Prison – Captured tokens go to the captor's Jail. Roll a 6 to release back to start.
• Bonus – Each capture earns a Bonus, activable later as a free roll of 6.

• Smart AI opponents that use rule captures, prioritize releases, and advance optimally

한 번의 탭, 끝없는 연쇄 폭발

ARROWS BOOM은 화살표 하나를 탭해서 시작되는 연쇄 반응 퍼즐 게임입니다.
단순한 조작으로 시작하지만, 화살표의 방향과 충돌 순서를 계산해야 하는 깊이 있는 두뇌 퍼즐입니다.

화살표를 탭하면 지정된 방향으로 날아가고, 다른 화살표와 충돌하며 새로운 연쇄 반응이 시작됩니다.
짧은 순간의 선택이 큰 폭발로 이어지고, 더 긴 콤보를 만들수록 강력한 손맛과 성취감을 느낄 수 있습니다.

주요 특징

1. 직관적인 화살표 퍼즐
누구나 쉽게 이해할 수 있는 간단한 규칙으로 시작합니다.
하지만 스테이지가 진행될수록 화살표의 배치, 방향, 순서를 전략적으로 생각해야 합니다.

2. 50개 섹션과 990개 스테이지
ARROWS: BOOM은 총 50개 섹션, 990개 스테이지로 구성되어 있습니다.
초반에는 가볍게 즐길 수 있고, 후반으로 갈수록 더 깊은 사고력과 집중력이 필요합니다.

3. 짜릿한 연쇄 반응과 콤보
한 번의 탭이 또 다른 충돌을 만들고, 충돌은 다시 새로운 폭발로 이어집니다.
연쇄가 길어질수록 화면 효과와 진동 피드백이 강해져 더 큰 몰입감을 제공합니다.

4. 퍼즐 모드
넓은 보드에서 최소한의 탭으로 모든 화살표를 제거하는 모드입니다.
시간 제한 없이 천천히 생각하며 풀 수 있어 로직 퍼즐과 두뇌 게임을 좋아하는 분들에게 적합합니다.

5. 타임어택 모드
제한 시간 안에 최대한 높은 점수를 기록하는 모드입니다.
빠른 판단력과 정확한 선택이 중요하며, 전 세계 유저들과 점수를 비교할 수 있습니다.

6. 1:1 랭킹전
실시간으로 상대와 대결하며 더 빠르고 강한 콤보를 만들어 승리하는 경쟁 모드입니다.
랭킹 시스템을 통해 자신의 실력을 확인하고 더 높은 티어에 도전할 수 있습니다.

7. 성장과 도전의 재미
스테이지를 클리어하고 별을 모으면 새로운 모드가 해금됩니다.
단순한 퍼즐을 넘어, 계속해서 도전하고 성장하는 재미를 제공합니다.

8. 깔끔한 디자인과 편안한 플레이
미니멀한 디자인과 직관적인 UI로 누구나 부담 없이 즐길 수 있습니다.
짧은 시간 집중해서 플레이하기 좋으며, 출퇴근길이나 쉬는 시간에도 가볍게 즐길 수 있습니다.

이런 분들에게 추천합니다

머리 쓰는 퍼즐 게임을 좋아하는 분
짧은 시간 즐길 수 있는 캐주얼 게임을 찾는 분
연쇄 반응과 콤보의 쾌감을 좋아하는 분

games.name: Quran Words: Learn & Memorize

Memorize the Quran by playing, not just reading.

Quran Words is a puzzle game built around real Quranic verses. Instead of flipping flashcards, you solve the ayah yourself. Swipe letters on the wheel, fill the blanks, and lock the verse into memory the way puzzles make things stick.

How to play

-Tap the Play button to open an ayah with one or more missing words.
-Swipe across the letter wheel to form the right word.
-Solve every blank word to complete the ayah.
-Listen to the full recitation and dive into the tafsir, if you want to go deeper.
-Earn coins, keep your streak alive, and move on to the next verse.

What is inside

-6236 ayahs from all 114 surahs, across all of the 30 juzzes.
-Letter wheel gameplay with shuffle and hint support.

-English tafsir at the end of the completed level.
-Difficulty that grows with you, from short verses to longer ones.
-Daily streaks, accuracy tracking, and a 7-day activity view.
-Stats screen that shows ayahs memorized, juz started, and time spent in the puzzles.
-Quick tutorial on your first level so you can jump in without guessing.
-Coin rewards for every solve, free shuffles, and hints when you are stuck.

Why it works

Reading a verse is one thing. Reconstructing it from memory is another. The puzzle format forces you to recognize ayahs, anticipate the next word, and notice the rhythm of the ayah. That is the same recognition muscle you use when you recite. Add a daily streak and a few minutes a day, and the Quran starts to feel familiar in a way passive review never delivers.

Whether you are working toward hifz, refreshing what you already memorized, or just want to understand more of what you recite, the app meets you where you are.

games.name: MatchMaxxer Color Memory Game
subcategories: Train your eyes and your ears
games.description:
Your eyes are liars. So are your ears.

Most people can't reliably remember a color or a tone from one second to the next. MatchMaxxer is a brutally honest test  of how good your perception actually is.
                                                                                                                      
Two disciplines. Five rounds each. One chance per round.

Every score comes with a verdict your group chat needs to see. Some are kind. Most are not.

COLOR

We show you a color for five seconds. You recreate it from memory using hue, saturation, and brightness sliders. Score is
computed in CIE Lab Delta E, a real perceptual distance, not a fake.

SOUND                                                     

We play you a tone for two seconds. You drag your finger up and down to dial the pitch back from memory. Score is computed in cents, the unit your inner ear actually thinks in.

Easy and Hard modes. Hard fades the source between the cue and the recall.

Solo or pass-and-play multiplayer.

Global leaderboard via Game Center.                                                                                      

Beautiful share cards for Stories and Messages.                                                                          

No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Everything runs locally.
   
Built by one person, on a Mac, in Swift. If your eyes and ears reject your guesses, that is between you and them. Five colors. Five tones. One chance each. Find out who actually has the eyes and ears, and who's been bluffing.        
Pass-and-play your friends and ruin friendships. Train your eyes and your ears

- MAGNET (Level 4) — Bakterien werden zu dir gezogen

———————————————
WAS CYTORUNNER BESONDERS MACHT
———————————————

- Cartoon-Pop-Stil — niedliche Monster mit lustigen Augen, Reißzähnen und kräftigen Farben
- 6 handgezeichnete Hintergründe, jeder einem echten Gewebe nachempfunden

- Pro-Level-Highscores und Fortschritts-Tracking

KOMPLETT OHNE GEDÖNS

- Keine In-App-Käufe
- Kein Tracking, kein Analytics

- Keine Anmeldung erforderlich

Was Du kaufst, gehört Dir. Punkt.

———————————————
PERFEKT FÜR
———————————————

- Familien und Schulkinder ab 6 Jahren
- Biologie-Begeisterte und Lernfans

games.name: Fortress Maze
games.description:
Hide your fortresses. Navigate the unknown. Reach the castle first.

Hidden Keep is a two-player strategy duel where every game is a fresh puzzle. Place seven fortresses on your secret board, then race through your opponent's hidden maze to the castle. Run into a fortress? Try another path. The first to reach the keep wins.
Inspired by Battleships and the classic pen-and-paper games of childhood, Hidden Keep is easy to learn in under two minutes — and surprisingly deep once you start playing.

HOW TO PLAY
Secretly place 7 fortresses on your board
Take turns moving toward your opponent's castle
Discover their fortresses by running into them
First to reach the keep wins

FEATURES
Single Player — challenge a thoughtful AI opponent
Local Two-Player — pass the device, no internet needed
Online Multiplayer — match instantly or play with a friend using a room code
Four Game Variants — Classic, Chain 3, Memory, and Double Entry
Stats Tracking — wins, flawless victories, and lifetime games
No Ads, No In-App Purchases — completely free, supported by optional tips

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
Classic — The original. Seven fortresses, max chain of two, single entry.
Chain 3 — Longer fortress chains create tighter mazes and harder routes.
Memory — Hit a fortress and it flashes for a moment before you're sent back to start. Remember where they are or pay the price again.
Double Entry — Choose to start from either side of the board. Your opponent doesn't know which way you'll come.

FOR FAMILIES, FRIENDS, AND RIVALS
Hidden Keep was designed by a father who wanted a game his kids could play anywhere — on a phone, in the car, or with just pen and paper at the kitchen table. The rules are simple enough for young children, the strategy is rich enough to keep adults coming back. Games last about five minutes. There's always time for one more. Inspired by classic pen-and-paper games. Place your fortresses in secret. Race through your opponent's maze. The first to reach the castle wins.

Esse jogo foi feito com todo o meu amor e carinho. Espero feedbacks de vocês pra aprimorar cada detalhe e deixá-lo cada vez mais incrível.

O jogador controla um personagem que caminha pelo cenário, pula obstáculos, coleta frutas e evita perigos. Cada partida desafia a criança a observar o que aparece na tela, escolher o momento certo para pular e acompanhar sua pontuação de maneira simples e visual.

O jogo conta com comandos fáceis, botão de iniciar, pulo normal e super pulo 2X, alertas visuais, efeitos sonoros, trilhas musicais, contadores por categoria e cenários com diferentes condições de tempo, como sol, nevoeiro, chuva, neve e furacão.

Também é possível personalizar o avatar para que a criança se identifique mais com o personagem, escolhendo entre menino e menina e ajustando características como roupas, boné e tênis.

A experiência foi pensada para ser clara, colorida e acolhedora, com elementos grandes, feedback imediato e regras objetivas. Autista Feliz transforma cada partida em uma oportunidade de brincar, treinar reflexos, reconhecer padrões e celebrar conquistas.

games.name: Catch the Phantom
games.description:
Catch the Phantom verwandelt deine Stadt in ein Spielfeld. Ein Spieler übernimmt das Phantom und versucht, durch die Stadt zu entkommen, während die anderen als Agenten Jagd auf ihn machen. Alles passiert in Echtzeit, auf echten Straßen, mit echtem GPS.

SO FUNKTIONIERT’S
Eine Person erstellt ein Spiel und teilt einen 6-stelligen Code mit den Mitspielern. Sobald 2 bis 6 Spieler in der Lobby sind, wählt jeder seine Rolle: Phantom oder Agent. Dann beginnt die Jagd.

• Treffpunkt: Alle starten an einem gemeinsamen Punkt – das Phantom 250 m vom Host entfernt, damit niemand schon vorher weiß, wer es ist. 
• Stationen: Über die Stadt verteilt warten echte Orte, die das Phantom besuchen muss, um Dossiers zu sammeln. 
• Enthüllungen: Alle 10 Minuten wird die Position des Phantoms kurz sichtbar – dann zählen Sekunden. 
• Sieg: Schaffen die Agenten es, das Phantom abzufangen? Oder erreicht es alle Stationen rechtzeitig?

WAS DICH ERWARTET
• Live-Karte mit echten Straßen (OpenStreetMap) 
• Live-Kompass, der dich zur nächsten Station führt 
• 20 Avatare zur Auswahl 
• Drei Spielbereiche: kompakt (1 km), Standard (1,5 km) oder weitläufig (2 km) 
• Spielzeit zwischen 60 und 120 Minuten 
• Routen-Auswertung nach jedem Spiel: Sieh, wo das Phantom war und wie nah die Agenten dran waren

STRATEGISCHE GADGETS
Macht das Spiel zu mehr als nur Verfolgung. An ausgewählten Stationen findest du Hilfsmittel:
• Tracker (Phantom): Zeigt für 30 Sekunden alle Agenten – verrät dabei aber deine eigene Position als Unschärfekreis 
• Decoy (Phantom): Erzeugt einen falschen Phantom-Marker, um Agenten in die Irre zu führen 
• Smokescreen (Phantom): Überspringt die nächste Enthüllung 
• Scanner (Agenten): Zeigt das Phantom für 15 Sekunden auf der Karte 
• Roadblock (Agenten): Sperrt eine Station für das Phantom

FÜR WEN
Catch the Phantom ist ein Outdoor-Spiel für Gruppen, die ihre Stadt anders erleben wollen. Geeignet für Game Nights,
Freundeskreise, Familienausflüge, Teams oder Junggesellenabschiede. Empfohlen ab 12 Jahren – durch das aktive
Bewegungselement etwas anstrengender als klassische Smartphone-Spiele, dafür mit echtem Erlebnischarakter.

WAS DU BRAUCHST
• Smartphone mit GPS und mobilem Internet 
• Mindestens 2 Mitspieler – ideal sind 3 bis 6 
• Eine Stadt oder ein größeres
Stadtviertel 
• Ein paar Stunden Zeit und Lust auf Bewegung

KOSTEN
Catch the Phantom ist kostenlos zu installieren. Du kannst öffentliche Spiele jederzeit gratis spielen, sofern andere
Spieler in deiner Nähe online sind. Für private Spiele mit eigener Spielergruppe steht ein einmaliger Kauf zur Verfügung.

DATENSCHUTZ
Standortdaten werden ausschließlich während des Spiels verwendet, um die Karte zu aktualisieren und faire
Spielmechaniken zu ermöglichen. Sie werden nicht für Werbung verwendet und nicht weitergegeben. Nach Spielende
werden die Live-Positionen verworfen, nur eine anonymisierte Routen-Auswertung bleibt für die Spieler sichtbar.

games.name: Simon Learns

• No user data is collected or stored.

Every child deserves a learning adventure that meets them exactly where they are — and grows with them every step of the way.

Simon Learns is built from the ground up with your family's safety in mind:

• No third-party analytics, trackers, or SDKs are used.

games.name: Auntie's Baskets
games.description:
Auntie's Baskets is a quiet puzzle game built around documented
basket designs from Northern California — Maidu, Yana, Atsugewi,
Achomawi, Mountain Maidu, Pit River, and (in the Northwestern
catalog) Yurok, Karok, and Hupa basketry traditions. Each of the
three modes — Match-3, Jigsaw, and Slide — ends with a basket
design revealed, named, and credited to the people who wove it.

Forty-two documented designs. Three modes. No timers. No lives.
No leaderboards. Done when you're done.

**The modes**

**Match-3** — Tiles you match brighten the basket above the board,
shape by shape, until the whole design is woven. Eighteen single-
band levels with covered tiles, locked tiles, and woven blockers
as the curve deepens. The band-stacking engine ships ready for
multi-band levels that weave two or three designs from the same
people into a single puzzle.

**Jigsaw** — Twelve documented designs as puzzle images on woven
tan. Pieces snap when they're right.

**Slide** — A sliding puzzle with a twist: one tile is held off
the grid. Solve the grid, then set the held weft to finish — the
way a real basket is completed by working in the last strand by
hand.

**The designs**

The first twelve baskets are traced from Paul E. Schulz's *Indians
of Lassen* (Loomis Museum Association, 1954). The Northwestern
catalog of thirty designs — Yurok, Karok, and Hupa — comes from
A. L. Kroeber's *Basket Designs of the Indians of Northwestern
California* (UC Publications in American Archaeology and
Ethnology, 1905, public domain). The names, the peoples, and the
verbatim captions in the reveal screens come from the books. The
designs are not decoration; they are the content.

Wolf's eye. Earthworm. Arrow-point. Mountain and cloud. Sturgeon-
back. Spread-hand. Forty-two designs your grandmother might have
known.

**Your basket**

Every completed level adds its design to a cumulative basket
surface organized by people — a quiet record of what you've
woven across your full playthrough.

**Made by**

Auntie's Baskets is built by H. L. Delaney, a member of the
Klamath Confederated Tribes. The background music is composed
and mastered by the developer. The cultural framing of the app —
what the designs are credited to, what the captions preserve,
what is and isn't documented — is the spine. Geometric shapes
get matched and assembled; the cultural ground is held.

**What this game is not**

Not free-to-play. Not ad-supported. Not session-based. There is no
daily login bonus, no energy meter, no premium currency, no
leaderboard. One purchase, one app, finite levels. Plays on
iPhone and iPad.

Designed for people who like puzzles, who like learning quietly,
and who would rather play three levels well than thirty levels
badly.

• Earn bonus points for consecutive matches and first-time flips
• Steal matches from the active player — if you dare! A failed steal costs you big

WIN & COLLECT PHOTOS
• Match multiple pairs in a row to trigger a winning streak and claim a card as your own
• In multiplayer, win copies of your opponents' photos — everyone keeps their originals
• Only the game's winner keeps their won cards — so every point matters
• Build a growing collection across every game you play

GAME CENTER
• Climb the leaderboards across five difficulty tiers
• Compare scores with friends

Comes with a hand-picked collection of stunning AI-generated artwork created with Grok Imagine. Add your own photos to make it personal. No ads. No data collection. Just pure, fun gameplay.


HOW TO PLAY:

Flip two cards per turn. If they match, score points and keep flipping. If not, your turn ends and the next player goes.

SCORING
• Match a pair: +10 points
• First time a card is ever flipped face-up in a match: +5 bonus per card (up to +10 per pair)
• Match consecutively (run bonus): +10 extra for each back-to-back match
• No match: −1 point
• Time penalty: −1 point per second of your turn

STEAL MECHANIC (Multipeer Only)
When exactly one card is face-up, any non-active player can tap a card to attempt a steal. If it matches — you claim the pair and score the match points. If it doesn't — you lose 15 points and the card flips back. The active player's turn continues either way.

WINNING STREAKS & CARD COLLECTING
Match two or more pairs in a row to start a winning streak. When the streak ends, one random pair stays face-up with a glitter effect — you've won that card! The image is saved to your photo library for use in future games. In multiplayer, only the player(s) with the highest score keep their won cards.

Sblocca uno dopo l'altro 15 borghi italiani — da Alberobello a Cinque Terre — 
ognuno con la sua palette, la sua storia, le sue parole.

  900 LIVELLI CURATI
15 borghi × 60 livelli ciascuno. Difficoltà progressiva: i primi pacchetti ti 
accolgono dolcemente, gli ultimi ti sfidano davvero. Lessico misto: parole 
italiane comuni + termini tematici per ogni borgo (calce, trullo, cipresso, 
tufo, scogliera...).

   5 MODALITÀ DI GIOCO
- Storia — il cammino sequenziale tra i 15 borghi
- Sfida del Giorno — 1 livello al giorno per tutti gli utenti, con streak
- Borgo Infinito — pesca random senza fine, score = livelli consecutivi
- Modalità Tempo — 3 minuti per completare, bonus monete in base alla velocità
- Modalità Maestro — solo livelli difficili, ricompensa raddoppiata
- Indovina il Borgo — risolvi senza sapere dove sei, poi indovina il borgo

  STREAK QUOTIDIANO
Apri ogni giorno per accumulare giorni consecutivi. Premi crescenti a 3, 7, 
14, 30, 60, 100 e 365 giorni. Anche se salti un giorno hai un freeze 
automatico (non perdi tutto al primo errore).

   SCOPRI L'ITALIA
Ogni borgo è raccontato con una scheda divulgativa: storia, curiosità, 
significato dei suoi nomi e tradizioni. Il gioco diventa un viaggio.

   SINCRONIZZAZIONE iCloud
I tuoi progressi viaggiano con te tra iPhone e iPad. Niente account da creare,
niente server esterni: tutto nel tuo iCloud privato.

   GAME CENTER
Trofei e classifiche per i giocatori più appassionati. Confrontati con altri 
amanti dei borghi italiani.

   COSA TROVERAI
- Ruota lettere fluida con drag & trace
- Cruciverba con animazioni di rivelazione
- 5 palette visive uniche per i borghi MVP
- Audio originale e musica di sottofondo opzionale
- Modalità di accessibilità VoiceOver
- Funziona offline al 100%
- Niente account, niente login

UN PROGETTO ITALIANO
Sviluppato in Italia, per chi ama le parole italiane e i borghi della 
nostra storia. Ogni borgo è scelto a mano, ogni descrizione scritta con 
cura.

Riportiamo a casa la bellezza dei nostri paesi più piccoli - un livello alla volta.

games.name: Scout Impostor

HOW IT WORKS

Everyone passes the phone to see their secret word — everyone except the impostor, who gets no word. In turns, each player drops a clue related to their word. 100% OFFLINE, NO STRINGS

No network, no accounts, no sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection. The app needs no connection: install once, play anywhere — including the mountain, a plane, or a bus.

100% offline. All settings stay only on your device. Full details in the privacy policy linked from this listing. The impostor party game for groups. 100% offline. No ads, no accounts. Party game for groups

HOW TO PLAY
1. Reveal: Hand the phone around. Everyone sees the secret word—except for the Imposter.
2. Discuss: Each player gives a subtle, one-word hint related to the secret word.
3. Vote: Based on the hints, the group must decide who is bluffing.
4. The Catch: If the imposter is caught, the insiders win. If the imposter blends in or guesses the word, they steal the victory!

GAME MODES
- Classic: The pure experience. One imposter, one secret word.
- Similar Word: The imposter gets a related clue instead of nothing. Harder to spot, higher stakes!
- Double Imposter: Two moles at the table. Double the suspicion, double the chaos.
- Civil War (Faction): No imposter! Team A vs Team B. Discover who shares your secret word, and vote the other team out!
- The Interrogation: Clues are banned! Players must ask and answer tight Yes/No questions to root out the Imposter.
- The Twins: Two players are secretly linked. If one twin is voted out, the other dies too. High stakes, double danger!
- Chaos: A wacky random modifier is activated every round (e.g. Rhyme Time, Gestures Only, Bleep Mode) to disrupt standard play.

KEY FEATURES
- Offline Pass & Play: Only one device needed for the whole group! Perfect for travel and parties.
- Online Multiplayer: Join or host games with friends anywhere in the world.
- Fair Play Weighted Selection: A smart, ticket-based system ensures that Imposter roles are distributed fairly and evenly across the group.
- 13 Diverse Categories: Choose from Movies, Food, Animals, Technology, Sports, Travel, Music, Objects, Nature, Jobs, Transport, Buildings, and Fashion.
- 1,800+ Unique Scenarios: A massive library of secret words and similar pairs to ensure every round is different.
- Random Mode: Can't decide? Let the app pick a category for you.
- Premium Experience: A sleek, modern design with haptic feedback and smooth animations.
- Global Support: Fully localized in over 20 languages including English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Japanese, and more.
- Customizable: Match your style with Dark/Light modes and custom accent colors.
- Privacy Focused: Your game data stays on your device. No unnecessary tracking.

PERFECT FOR
- Weekend game nights
- Family dinners and holidays
- Icebreakers for new groups
- Killing time on commutes or flights

Are you a master of deception or a top-tier detective? Download Amongly today and start the hunt!

easy — harmlos, jeder hat sofort eine Antwort.
real — trifft, mit einem Auge zugedrückt.
oof — kein Filter. Die Karte, über die danach zwei Tage niemand redet.

EHRLICH AUCH SONST

games.description:
BondWizard is a daily puzzle suite for people who want their brain working but don't want to be yelled at by an app. Eight original games, one new puzzle each, every single day.

WHAT YOU GET DAILY

• Tangle — a 4×4 or 5×5 word grid where every row and column already spells a word. Swap the letters until everything reads cleanly. No clues. The marquee weekend game.

• Solo — peg solitaire on a different shape each day of the week. Triangle, diamond, heart, octagon, English cross. Earn bronze, silver, gold by clearing the board the right way.

• Tumble — five scrambled words a day, growing in length from four letters to eight. Anagram lint guarantees the answer is always unique.

• Wedges — six trivia questions across six fixed categories: history, science, geography, sports, language, screen. Build the sandwich one layer at a time.

• Sides — twelve items, one yes-or-no question. Tap the ones that fit. Confess what you actually know.

• Timelines — six events from a single theme, in the wrong order. Drag them into chronological place. Score in rounds.

• Consessant — five things to rank from most popular to least. Reveal shows how Gen Z, Millennials, Gen X, and Boomers actually ranked them. Find out which generation you really belong to.

• Contrarian — six binary picks across six everyday categories. Real-time crowd data reveals where you're alone on your hot takes.

WHY BONDWIZARD

• No streaks, no notifications guilt-tripping you, no rewatching a paywall video to keep playing. Daily means daily.

• Built on real generational data: when you finish Consessant or Contrarian, you see your generation's actual responses, not a fake leaderboard.

• Local time, local quiet. Today's puzzles drop at midnight in your time zone. No worry about whether you missed a day in some other country.

• Free. The whole suite. No ads tucked between rounds, no premium tier locking the marquee game. Just eight puzzles a day. A new puzzle every day across eight original games. No timers, no streaks, no shouting. Just one quiet ritual you'll actually want to come back to. Fresh games. One daily ritual.

games.name: N-Back

Unlock your brain's full potential with Dual N-Back, the comprehensive cognitive training game designed to improve your working memory, focus, and fluid intelligence.

Whether you are looking to sharpen your mind, enhance your concentration, or challenge yourself with a stimulating puzzle, Dual N-Back is the perfect mental workout for you.

What is N-Back?
Dual N-Back is a scientifically backed memory training exercise. "Dual" means you must process two different streams of information simultaneously:

    Visual: The position of a square on a 3x3 grid.

    Audio: A spoken letter.

Your goal is to remember if the current position or letter matches the one that appeared "N" steps back in the sequence. It starts easy at N=1 or N=2, but as you progress, the challenge intensifies, pushing your brain to adapt and grow.

Key Features:
• Classic Dual N-Back Experience: Train with simultaneous visual (grid positions) and auditory (spoken letters) stimuli.
• Customizable Difficulty: Choose your 'N' level to match your current skill and gradually increase it as your memory improves.
• Adjustable Speed: Control the pace of the game to make it as relaxing or as intense as you want.
• Multiple Languages: The audio letters are available in multiple languages, making the game accessible and versatile.
• Clean & Minimalist Interface: A completely distraction-free design that lets you focus entirely on your brain training.
• Track Your Progress: See your scores at the end of each round and watch your cognitive capacity expand over time.

Why Play N-Back?
Studies suggest that practicing the Dual N-Back task can lead to improvements in working memory and fluid intelligence—the ability to reason and solve new problems independently of previously acquired knowledge. Regular training can help you:
• Enhance your daily concentration and focus.
• Improve your ability to multitask in real life.
• Keep your mind sharp, active, and healthy.

Ready to take the brain test? Download Dual N-Back today and start your journey towards a sharper, faster, and more focused mind! Train your working memory and focus with Dual N-Back! A scientifically proven brain puzzle to enhance cognitive skills, concentration, and mental sharpness every day. Memory training

games.name: Tilt Hit

■ Whose angle sense is sharpest? ■

Tilt Hit is a simple angle-guessing game played entirely with your phone's tilt. Hide the screen, tilt to what feels like the target angle, and see how close you got — using only the device's gravity sensor (CoreMotion).

No special equipment, no internet, no camera. Pure physics versus your gut feeling — solo, or pass the phone around with friends.


■ How to Play ■

1. Place your phone flat on a table and tap CALIBRATE / RESET to record 0°
2. Pick a target: 30°, 45°, 60°, or 90°
3. Tap START — the screen goes dark (or light, in Soft theme)
4. Lift your phone and tilt to what feels like the target
5. Tap the screen — see your measured angle and the Δ (error)
6. Get within 1°? Perfect! Within 3°? Great!


■ Key Features ■

● Pure tilt-based gameplay
Uses CoreMotion to track your phone's tilt with high accuracy. No camera, no AR — just raw physics and your intuition.

● Great with friends
Each round takes seconds, so it's perfect for taking turns and competing for the best score. The look on someone's face when they nail "Perfect!" is half the fun.

● Two visual themes
Switch instantly to fit your mood:
・Cyber — neon green cyberpunk look (dark background, monospace)
・Soft — warm cream world (light background, rounded type)

● Fully offline
No network connection required. Nothing collected, nothing transmitted. Privacy by design.

● Quick & rhythmic
Each round takes seconds. Perfect for a coffee break or a competitive moment with friends.


■ Great For ■

・Friendly score battles ("who has the best angle sense?")
・Quick fun during breaks, solo
・Sharpening your spatial sense for design / architecture / hobbies
・Anyone who loves either cyberpunk or calm minimalism


■ Requirements ■

iPhone (iOS 16.0 or later)
Built-in motion sensor required (all iPhones support it)


■ Privacy ■

Tilt Hit collects no personal information or usage data. Sensor values stay entirely on your device.


How sharp is your angle sense? A simple angle-guessing game using just your phone's tilt. Pick 30°, 45°, 60°, or 90°, tilt blindly, tap to reveal your error. Solo play or take turns with friends. Guess angles by tilt alone

Geo Card Quest is a location-based adventure game for families that turns ordinary walks and trips into a real quest for magical creatures. Instead of struggling with whining and tired kids, you give them a reason to want to keep going on their own.

WHO GEO CARD QUEST IS FOR

The game was created for children and parents who explore the world together. You know that feeling when the planned route is beautiful, but after fifteen minutes you hear "I'm bored" or "Is it much further?". Geo Card Quest solves exactly this problem — every place you want to show your child becomes another stop in the game.

HOW IT WORKS

The parent is the Game Master. You plan the route — you choose locations in Google Maps, share them to Geo Card Quest, and assign a magical creature card to each of them. This way, you create a personalized expedition: a park where you want to rest, a monument worth seeing, or a favorite cafe on the way back — everything becomes a collectible point.

The child is the seeker. Walking with you — with their own phone or yours — they see where the cards are hidden and lead you toward them. To unlock a card, they must physically reach the location. This very walk, which a child normally wouldn't want to take, becomes the best part of the day.

WHAT THE CHILD COLLECTS

The cards feature unique, fantastic creatures — forest spirits, mountain beasts, creatures from the deep, and many more. Each has its own look, name, and personality. Unlocked cards go into a collection that the child can browse in the gallery. Every trip leaves behind a lasting souvenir in the form of a set of creatures — along with the memory of the places where they were captured.

KEY FEATURES

• Route planning by the parent — turn any location into a game goal
• Google Maps integration — add points with a single link share
• Collectible magical creature cards in themed sets
• Unlocking a card requires physically reaching the destination — no cheating from the couch
• Collection gallery to view captured creatures
• Cards within a single trip do not repeat — every location is a new discovery

PERFECT OCCASIONS

• Sunday walks that usually end with "I want to go home"
• Vacation city sightseeing where you need to get from one landmark to another
• Trips to mountains, forests, and national parks
• Visiting family in another city
• The daily route from school or kindergarten that you want to spice up

WHY IT’S WORTH IT

Geo Card Quest doesn't replace the real world — quite the opposite, it gives the child a reason to actually see it. Instead of staring at a tablet in the backseat, the child looks out the window, searches for the next location, and asks when you'll finally get there. And you have full control over what the family visits because you are the one designing the adventure map.

Hit the road. Collect creatures. Discover the world together. Geo Card Quest: Family GPS adventure. Turning walks into magic creature hunts.

games.name: Buwaya: Political Engine
games.description:
Welcome to Malacañang, Mr. / Madam President. You have six years. Don’t mess it up.

Step into the highest office in the land in this wildly strategic, deeply satirical political rogue-like engine-builder!

You have exactly two motions (action) per year to build a legacy, balance the national budget, and keep the public from ousting you. Will you be the "Grassroots Hope" who relies on the love of the masses, or "The Iron Fist" with infinite manpower but zero public trust?

Draft from a deck of 50+ Project Cards to build your political engine. Sign a BPO Tax Holiday to secure long-term funds, rush a Mega-Dam Project, or take the easy way out and accept a China Debt Trap for instant cash (just don't ask about the interest rate).

But in Philippine politics, the math isn't your only enemy. Every year, you must pass a Krisis Check—from a devastating Jeepney Tigil-Pasada to a terrifying Senate Blue Ribbon Probe. If your infrastructure, trust, or welfare tracks are too low, your administration will suffer catastrophic penalties.

And just when you think you've balanced the books? The Delubyo hits.
Face a brutal RNG chance every year of enduring typhoons, El Niño droughts, or a random MRT-3 breakdown. Do you spend your precious budget to mitigate the disaster, or take the raw hit and pray you have enough approval ratings to survive?

🌟 KEY FEATURES:

🃏 Rogue-like Engine Building: See 5 random Project Cards a year. With only 12 actions per game, every single click matters. Can't afford the EDSA Subway? Sell it to the market for a free action to fund your survival!

🌪️ Dual-Threat System: Anticipate the yearly Krisis thresholds, but stay paranoid about the unpredictable chance of a Delubyo disaster.

⚖️ Reiner Knizia-Style Scoring: A thriving economy means nothing if your healthcare system is zero. Your final score is heavily penalized by your lowest performing track. You must balance Tibay (Infrastructure), Ginhawa (Welfare), and Tiwala (Trust) to win.

🏛️ Mandates: Start your run as "The Unity Successor", "The Balimbing Coalition", "The People Power Icon" and many more. Every mandate completely changes your starting economy and strategy.

📖 The Compendium: Track your progress! Play to unlock the hidden silhouettes of all 50 Project Cards, Delubyos, and Crises in your interactive compendium.

Card counting won’t save you from a super typhoon, and money can't buy your way out of a Missing Health Funds scandal.

Do you have the strategic genius to build a lasting legacy, or will you be ousted before your term ends? Take the oath and find out. Build your legacy (or barely survive your 6-year term) in this rogue-like!

games.name: NumShift!
games.description:
Slide. Sum. Score.

NumShift is a fresh take on the number puzzle. Slide entire rows and columns across a 5×5 board — when adjacent tiles add up to the target number, they merge and you score.

Start simple with pairs that equal 10, then level up as the target climbs to 15, 20, and beyond. What begins as easy arithmetic becomes a strategic challenge as you plan moves ahead, set up chain reactions, and keep the board from filling up.

WHAT MAKES NUMSHIFT DIFFERENT
Unlike other number puzzles, you shift entire rows or columns — not every tile at once. This gives you precise control over the board. And tiles don't merge by matching — they merge by summing to a target. That one twist changes everything.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe left or right to slide a row
• Swipe up or down to slide a column
• Adjacent tiles that add up to the target number merge automatically
• New tiles spawn after every move
• The game ends when the board fills with no possible merges

FEATURES
• Unique target-sum mechanic — not just another 2048 clone
• 4 levels with increasing targets (10 → 15 → 20 → 25)
• Combo multiplier system — chain consecutive merges for massive scores
• Multi-tile merges — combine 2, 3, 4, or even 5 tiles at once
• Undo button — take back your last move
• Game Center leaderboards — compete globally for high score and highest level
• Satisfying haptic feedback and sound effects
• Clean, minimal dark-mode design
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• No ads. No timers. No nonsense.

Built by PapaG Studios — a one-person indie studio making games worth your time. A number puzzle with a twist — slide rows and columns, merge tiles that hit the target sum, and chase your highest score. No ads, no timers, just pure puzzle. Slide. Sum. Score.

This creates a unique gameplay loop where:
- Every decision matters

You are not simply connecting paths — you are managing constraints, optimizing timing, and solving dynamic puzzles.

games.name: Only Screw Puzzles
games.description:
Bringing the Casual, back to Casual Games

A premium, minimalist physics puzzle game where logic is your only tool. Solve intricate mechanical boards by unscrewing various puzzle pieces using a 100% realistic physics engine. Only Screw Puzzles features no ads every tap, no pay-to-win mechanics, no deceptive levels, and no bloated mini-games. Experience pure, tactile, and fair mechanical challenges.

Only Screw Puzzles was inspired by my own need for a casual game that was actually casual. When I want a five-minute break to release some puzzle pieces, I don't want to be shown windows of upgrades or forced to play mini-games for a high score. I want the game to just start. I created this game to focus on the core, mechanical gameplay. No noise, no fluff — Only Screw Puzzles.


No Ads every Tap or for Bonuses — Only Screw Puzzles
I am not interested in pulling you into an endless loop of watching ads just to get an upgrade or move to the next level. I respect your time. In this game, you only watch a single ad, and every tool or upgrade is yours for the entire level. You can stay in the flow without being interrupted every thirty seconds.


No Pay-To-Win Microtransactions — Only Screw Puzzles
You cannot buy your way through these puzzles. There are no super-boosters or paid skips designed to take your money. Whether you solve a level depends entirely on your own spatial reasoning and logic. It is a fair challenge, every single time.


No Deceptive Levels — Only Screw Puzzles
I don’t use psychological tricks to get you to watch ads. Many games in this genre are designed to look solvable, only to reveal an impossible bottleneck right when you are close to completion. They wait until you’ve invested time and effort before forcing a "fail" state that requires an ad to fix. In Only Screw Puzzles, every board follows the laws of physics consistently from start to finish. There are no hidden traps or scripted failures. If you can see a solution, it will work.


No Mini-Games or Side-Quests — Only Screw Puzzles
You don’t have to deal with unwanted bloat here. There are no side-quests to play just to get upgrades, and no chores to complete before you can progress. I focused 100% of my energy on creating high-quality, realistic physics puzzles. This isn't a game about decorating a house, managing a farm, or playing match-three sub-games—it is exactly what the name says.


Full Control with Custom Levels
We all have days where we want a brain-melting challenge, and other days where we just want to unwind and watch things fall. If you hit a complex level but just feel like relaxing, you have full control. My Custom Level mode lets you set the following rules to fit your mood:
• No. of Layers
• No. of Puzzle Piece Shapes
• Puzzle Piece Materials
• No. of Puzzle Piece Screws
• No. of Screw Colours
• No. of Screws in Boxes


Realistic Materials and Weight
To make the physics feel truly authentic, I’ve included the following materials that have their own physical properties for different physics. You’ll feel the difference in how they swing, collide, and drop, adding an extra layer of tactical depth to every move you make.
• Foam
• Wood
• Metal
• Stone


Only Screw Puzzles is an honest, premium experience built by someone who actually loves the genre. If you are looking for a tactile, realistic physics puzzle that stays out of your way and lets you play, this is for you.

games.name: 37 - The Math Puzzle
games.description:
Can you turn seven dice into the number 37?

Think fast, solve puzzles, and practice mental math skills. Compete globally, challenge friends,

and track your progress on the Daily Challenge Leaderboard in this addictive math and brain

training game.

A Fresh Twist on Math & Logic

37 is an original math puzzle game designed to provide a fun and engaging way to exercise

your thinking while exploring arithmetic and logic. It is suitable for casual players, students, and

educators, combining entertaining gameplay with educational elements.

Each puzzle starts with seven random dice showing values 1–6. Players aim to build a valid

equation equaling 37 using:

• Addition

• Subtraction

• Multiplication

• Division

• Exponents

• Parentheses

These puzzles encourage problem solving, mental calculation, and arithmetic practice, making

37 a useful brain exercise. 

Animated Tutorial & Math Review

New players or those needing a review can access the in-app animated tutorial. Learn the

order of operations (PEMDAS) and how to construct valid equations with dice (for the math

teachers out there, this is GEMDAS, but without the brackets, making it solely PEMDAS). The

tutorial also offers a quick review of key arithmetic rules, helping players understand the

puzzles more clearly.


Multiple Ways to Play

37 offers seven unique modes:

● Easy Mode – Practice puzzles at your own pace, perfect for beginners.

● Challenge Mode – Introduces Power Dice: green (addition/subtraction), blue

(multiplication/division), red (exponents). In all Challenge-based modes (Challenge, Daily

Challenge, Challenge Blitz), Power Dice rules apply, but players only need to use two

of the three correctly for a valid solve.

● Daily Challenge – One daily puzzle for all players. Timed rounds and Power Dice rules

add a layer of challenge. Completion can earn a spot on the Daily Challenge

Leaderboard. New puzzles available daily at 12:00AM EST.

● Solo Easy Blitz & Solo Challenge Blitz – 10 minute timed puzzle sprints. Track your

stats, practice mental calculations, and challenge yourself.

● Easy & Challenge Blitz Battles – Face friends in 10 minute head-to-head battles.

Solve identical sequences of puzzles and earn Battle Points.

These modes offer opportunities for speed, accuracy, and mental exercise, while keeping gameplay engaging and enjoyable.


Points, Badges & Achievements

● Battle Points – Earned by winning Blitz Battles.

● Puzzle Points – Earned by completing Daily Challenges using all 3 Power Dice

correctly, a move known as a “Perfect Solve”.

Track streaks, pursue records, and unlock colorful achievement badges to display next to your

username. Each puzzle provides a chance to practice arithmetic and problem-solving skills.

Connect with Friends

Search for friends by username, send friend requests, and view their stats. Challenge them to

Blitz Battles, compare Daily Challenge results, and see who solves puzzles fastest. Social

features offer an extra layer of fun and motivation while practicing math.

Free, Privacy-Friendly, & Cross-Device

37 is free to play and does not collect personal data unless you choose to enter your email to save your stats and access it across devices. Player privacy is respected at all times and no personal information is sold.

A Brain Game for All Ages

Whether you're a student practicing arithmetic, a teacher looking for a fun possible study tool, a puzzle enthusiast, or an older player looking to keep your mental acuity engaged, 37

provides an entertaining and educational experience. 37 offers a visually appealing way to explore mental math, arithmetic, and logic, combining engaging puzzles with optional competitive and social features.

Download 37 today and try your hand at improving mental math speed, arithmetic skills, and problem-solving abilities in a fun, interactive environment!

games.name: Kanji: Spot the Odd One
games.description:
Can you spot the difference?

Japanese kanji are full of look-alikes: 末 vs 未, 土 vs 士, 微 vs 徴, 戌 vs 戍 vs 戊…

This is a simple brain training game where you find the one different kanji in a grid of identical-looking ones.

• Japanese learners practicing visual kanji recognition

• Quick brain training in line, on the train, before bed

2. Get it right → next puzzle, your streak grows

Easy at first. By 6×6, even native readers slow down.

Shape: 大/犬/太/天, 王/玉/主, 日/曰/目, 田/由/申/甲
Subtle: 微/徴/徽, 績/積/責, 待/侍/持/特, 検/険/験/倹
Tricky: 摘/適/敵/滴, 鳥/烏/島, 戌/戍/戊, 己/已/巳

games.name: Playnono
games.description:
Playnono is a picross puzzle game built around the simple act of solving.

A picross — also known as a nonogram or griddler — is a logic puzzle where numbered clues along the rows and columns tell you which cells to fill in. Each puzzle has exactly one correct solution. 

Find it, and a hidden image emerges.                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  What's different about Playnono:                                                                                                                                                                      
   — Hand-curated puzzles. Every grid was designed and tested individually. No procedural noise, no filler — each puzzle has a recognizable image at the end. New ones added regularly.
  — Calm, distraction-free design. A warm cream surface, an editorial type system, and a single terracotta accent. No flashing ads, no nagging upsells, no engagement bait.
  — Create your own. A built-in editor lets you draw a puzzle, validate that it has exactly one solution, and publish it for everyone else to play.                                                  
  — Smart helpers without spoilers. Auto-mark fills in the rest of a row once your filled cells match the clues. A debounced wrong-cell flagger gives you a beat to self-correct before pointing out mistakes.
  — Pinch-to-zoom and pan for larger grids on smaller screens. Axis-locked dragging paints a whole row or column at speed without smudging into the neighbor.
  — Sign in to sync progress across devices, or play signed-out. Everything works either way.  

What Playnono doesn't do:                                                                                                                                                                             
  — No ads, no analytics SDKs, no third-party trackers
  — No data sale or sharing — full disclosure at playnono.app/privacy
  — No "rate the app" prompts, no daily-streak guilt, no engagement gimmicks
  — No pay-to-skip or pay-to-unlock — the library is free

Puzzles range from 5×5 introductions to 30×30 challenges. Solved or in-progress, your work is preserved across sessions.

Built by Marius Bocanu. Bug reports and requests welcome at marius@playnono.app. Pause, think, solve.

games.name: Inkline: Sumi-e Knot Puzzle
games.description:
Inkline is a meditative knot-untangling puzzle, drawn in ink on washi paper.

Drag any point on the tangled strand. Remove every crossing. When the last knot resolves, the rope settles into a sumi-e form — a mountain, a crane, a folded moon — and a vermillion seal is stamped onto your scroll.

There is no timer. No score. No streak. No ads. No five-stars-please popup. Nothing is chasing you. The strand will wait as long as you do.

SIX SCROLLS, 648 FORMS

— Mountain. The first scroll. A gentle introduction.
— River. Bending water, returning currents.
— Crane. Folded wings, the bird in flight.
— Bamboo. Hollow stems and quiet wind.
— Moon. The full circle, the crescent, the void.
— Stillness. The final scroll. Calligraphy held in the breath.

Each scroll holds 108 procedurally generated puzzles — the same auspicious number as the worldly desires a practitioner is said to unwind in meditation. Every puzzle is unique, deterministically seeded, and never repeats the same untangling twice.

THE GARDEN

Every form you reveal becomes a brush stroke in a single hanging scroll — a sumi-e composition that grows with you across weeks and months. The mountains rise where you placed them. The crane flies through air you brushed open. By the time the scroll is full, you have painted it.


DAILY KNOT

One new puzzle each day, the same one for every player worldwide. A small ritual — a haiku, in tangle form.


CRAFTED, NOT GENERATED

Every brush stroke is hand-drawn vector calligraphy. Every sound is procedurally synthesized — a koto-like pluck on every untie, a quiet ambient bed of pentatonic notes if you want it. Every shape resolves into a real Japanese kanji or sumi-e motif. No stock images. No generated art.


WHAT INKLINE IS NOT

— Free-to-play. 
— No accounts. No sign-in. No email. No tracking. Your progress lives only on your device.
— No subscriptions. No microtransactions. No ads, ever.
— Not "casual." It is unhurried, which is a different thing.


PRO

Mountain — the first scroll — is free in its entirety. The remaining five scrolls unlock with a single one-time purchase. After that, Inkline costs you nothing again.


For players who untangle their headphones before bed.

Inkline is single-player and offline-first. The only network calls the app makes are to Apple's IAP service to verify your one-time purchase.
Support url: https://playpalapps.github.io/Inkline/support.html Untangle the strand. The form reveals itself. 648 hand-crafted sumi-e puzzles across six scrolls. No timer. No score. Just one unhurried breath, then the next. Untangle. Reveal. Breathe.

Cognera is an engaging educational mobile application that combines logic puzzle-solving with language learning. Inspired by the classic Einstein's Riddle, this app presents a progressive series of deductive reasoning challenges designed to sharpen critical thinking skills while helping users improve their English language comprehension.

Key Features:

- Progressive Puzzle System: The app features a carefully curated collection of logic puzzles organized by difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard). Each puzzle is locked until the previous one is completed, creating a structured learning path that builds confidence and skills gradually.

- Story-Driven Challenges: Every puzzle comes with an engaging narrative context—from matching neighbors to their colored houses, to solving mysteries about flight destinations and personal preferences. These stories make abstract logic problems tangible and relatable.

- Interactive Grid-Based Solving: Users solve puzzles using an intuitive grid interface where they can mark relationships between different categories and items. The visual grid system helps learners understand logical deductions clearly and systematically.

- Integrated Language Learning: Unlike traditional puzzle apps, Cognera doubles as a language learning tool. Each puzzle includes:

-- Glossary: Vocabulary definitions for key terms used in the story and clues
-- Grammar Notes: Explanations of grammatical structures encountered in the puzzles
-- Language Hints: Interactive text elements that provide contextual language support

- Learning Interventions: After attempting a puzzle, users receive comprehension questions with feedback to reinforce understanding and ensure they've grasped both the logical solution and the language used.

- Modern, Beautiful UI: Features a sleek glassmorphic design with gradient backgrounds, smooth animations, and a polished user experience. The interface uses color-coded difficulty indicators (green for easy, orange for medium, red for hard) for quick visual reference.

Educational Value:

Cognera serves dual purposes: developing logical reasoning abilities while enhancing English language proficiency. The combination makes it perfect for:

- English language learners seeking engaging practice material
- Students looking to improve critical thinking skills
- Puzzle enthusiasts who want educational context
- Anyone interested in classic logic problems with a modern twist
- The app's scaffolded difficulty progression ensures that users of all skill levels can find appropriate challenges. Whether you're a beginner tackling simple three-category puzzles or advancing to complex multi-variable problems, Cognera adapts to your learning pace. Think deeper, solve smarter

WHY RHYTHM TRAINING MATTERS
Rhythm is the heartbeat of every song. Many musicians struggle not with notes, but with the timing between them. Taptum bridges the gap between hearing a groove and understanding its technical structure. By connecting your ears to visual notation, you develop a "rhythmic vocabulary" that allows you to read sheet music faster and improvise with more confidence.

FEATURES:

100+ Levels of Increasing Complexity
Start with simple quarter notes and progress to the professional league. Our carefully curated curriculum ensures you never feel overwhelmed but are always challenged. As you give correct answers, you unlock new categories, moving from the basics to advanced syncopation and polyrhythmic-style patterns.

9 Unique Musical Categories
Explore the diversity of rhythm through dedicated modules:
BASIC: The foundation. Master 4/4 time, quarter, and eighth notes.
ROCK & POP: Learn the standard grooves that power the world's greatest hits.
GALLOPS: Dive into the energetic world of "galloping" patterns and shuffles.
DOTTED NOTES: Master the precision of dotted eighths and sixteenth notes.
SYNCOPA: Learn to feel the "off-beat" and understand shifted accents.
TRIPLETS: Perfect the rolling feel of three notes per beat.
FAST: Increase your mental processing speed with rapid sixteenth-note patterns.
COMPLEX: A mix of all the above. Only for those who have mastered the basics.
METAL: The ultimate test. Experience ultra-fast "blast beats" and extreme precision.

Two Dynamic Game Modes
PRACTICE MODE: Learn at your own pace. There are no lives or time limits. Every correct answer earns you experience points (XP) to unlock new categories. It’s the perfect environment for deep learning and focused ear training.
SURVIVAL MODE: Ready for a challenge? You have 3 lives. The tempo is consistent, but the pressure is on. How many patterns can you identify in a row? Compete with yourself to break your "High Streak" and prove your mastery.

Master Your Mistakes with "Compare"
Making a mistake is the best way to learn—if you know what went wrong. Taptum’s unique "Compare" feature allows you to play the correct rhythm and your mistaken choice back-to-back. Hear the subtle differences in timing and notation to ensure you don’t make the same mistake twice.

Professional Sound Packs
Ear training shouldn't be boring. Customize your experience with high-quality samples:
Classic Snare: Sharp and mid-range for clear identification.
Heavy Kick: Low-frequency training to feel the pulse.
Hi-Hat: High-frequency, crisp sounds for speed training.
Electronic Synth: A modern, digital take on rhythmic training.

Track Your Musical Growth
Your personal Profile stores all your achievements.
Accuracy Rating: See the percentage of your correct answers.
Best Streak: Keep track of your longest win streak in Survival mode.
Progress Map: See exactly how many categories you’ve unlocked on your road to becoming a Rhythmic Grandmaster.

WHO IS TAPTUM FOR?
Drummers: Improve your sight-reading and internal clock.
Guitarists & Bassists: Lock in with the drum kit more effectively.
Composers & Producers: Translate the beats in your head into your DAW with ease.
Music Students: Prepare for ear training exams in a fun, gamified way.
Casual Music Lovers: Simply enjoy the satisfaction of mastering a new skill.

CLEAN & ERGONOMIC DESIGN
We designed Taptum to be used anywhere. The interface is optimized for one-handed use, with large, responsive buttons and a clear visual hierarchy. Interactive drum sticks provide a visual reference for every hit, helping you "see" the sound.

Start your rhythm journey today and never miss a beat again!

games.name: Stelo: Night Sky Diary
games.description:
A private night sky that fills itself, one star a day.

Stelo is a slow, ambient stargazing companion. Every night, one to three new stars quietly fall into your personal night sky. Connect them with your finger to draw your own constellations, give them names, and watch a gallery slowly fill over weeks and months.

There is no score. No timer. Nothing to lose. Just a quiet space that asks nothing of you, and gives back a sky that is yours alone.

– – –

HOW IT WORKS

• Open the app. New stars from last night pulse gently to greet you.
• Touch a star to begin a constellation. Drag your finger between stars to draw lines. Branches are allowed; loops are allowed; whatever feels right is right.
• Tap save. Name the constellation, or leave it untitled. It joins your gallery.
• Tomorrow, more stars will be waiting.

SPECIAL NIGHTS

The sky knows what day it is. On 24절기 (Korean solar terms), full moons, meteor-shower nights, and your birthday, special stars appear with a label and a warmer color. Catch them in a constellation for keepsake meaning.

THE ALMANAC

Without telling you what to draw, Stelo quietly compares your shapes to all 88 IAU constellations. If you accidentally rediscover Lyra, Orion, or Cassiopeia, a small banner appears: "Looks like Cygnus." Your discoveries gradually unlock the Almanac with mythology and historical notes — no quiz, no pressure.

WIDGETS

Place a small or medium widget on your home screen to keep your latest constellation glowing through the day.

WHAT WE DO NOT DO

• No ads. Ever.
• No in-app purchases in v1.
• No accounts. No sign-up.
• No analytics, no tracking, no SDKs that phone home.
• No leaderboards. No friends. No sharing pressure. No social.
• No push notifications nagging you to come back.

All your stars and constellations live on your device only. We literally cannot see them.

WHO IT IS FOR

• People who like Universe, Alto's Odyssey, Mountain, or any app that asks nothing
• People who keep a one-line journal or use bedtime apps
• People who like astronomy but find sky-map apps overwhelming
• People who play idle games for the slow accumulation, not the optimization

LANGUAGES

English, 한국어, 日本語. Time zones and 24절기 calendar honored locally.

– – –

Stelo. The Esperanto word for "star." A night sky you can hold.

games.name: Water Sort Puzzle
games.description:

**Water Sort Puzzle** is a simple, fun, and highly strategic logic game designed to test your logical reasoning and patience. If you're looking for a pastime that exercises your brain without causing stress, this is the perfect game for you.

### How to Play?

The mechanics are intuitive, but the challenge increases with each level:
1. **Tap any jar** to pour the colored water into another jar.

2. **The rule is clear:** you can only pour the water if it is the same color as the top layer of the destination jar and if there is enough space.

3. **The ultimate goal** is to separate all the colors so that each jar contains only one unique color.

### Why play Water Sort Puzzle?

* **Elite Brain Exercise:** Stimulate your cognitive skills and your ability to plan strategically.

* **Progressive Difficulty:** Start with simple levels and advance to complex challenges that will demand every ounce of your focus.

* **No Pressure:** There are no timers or time limits. Play at your own pace, relax, and think carefully before each move.

* **Minimalist and Elegant Design:** Enjoy a clean look, vibrant colors, and soothing water sounds that provide a therapeutic experience.

* **Works Offline:** No internet? No problem! Play anywhere, whether on the subway, in a waiting room, or in the comfort of your home.

### Premium Version Highlights:
* **Uninterrupted Experience:** As a paid app, you focus only on the fun and the challenge.

* **Hundreds of Levels:** A vast library of levels to guarantee hours of entertainment.

* **Undo Button:** Made a mistake? Use the undo function to correct your strategy without having to restart the level.

* **Lightweight and Fast:** Optimized to work perfectly on various Android devices without taking up much space.

---

**Get ready to organize the colorful chaos!**

**Water Sort Puzzle** is more than a game; it's a test of intelligence hidden beneath a relaxing mechanic. Can you predict the moves and solve the most difficult levels with the fewest moves possible?

**Download now and prove you're a master of logic!**

---
*Developed by Aristófanes Paulino.* Challenge your mind: organize the colors and solve the most addictive water puzzle!

games.name: FF333Shift

Welcome to FF333Shift, a captivating puzzle game designed to challenge your spatial reasoning and memory skills. Engage with a dynamic grid environment where your objective is to manipulate colorful blocks.

Each block features a directional arrow and a specific color—red, blue, green, or yellow. Your goal is to navigate these blocks across the board so that all arrows eventually point directly toward the center of the grid. Moving a block pushes an entire row or column, creating intricate chain reactions.

After each movement, the blocks rotate based on their assigned colors. Red blocks turn 90 degrees clockwise, blue blocks rotate 90 degrees counter-clockwise, green blocks flip 180 degrees, and yellow blocks remain static. You must calculate the outcome of each slide to ensure the correct final orientation of every piece.

ZyloShift includes 50 structured levels that gradually increase in complexity, introducing you to the mechanics on smaller grids before expanding to the full challenge. Additionally, an Endless Mode generates continuous puzzle layouts based on your progress, offering an ongoing test of your puzzle-solving abilities. Track your step counts and strive to complete each level with optimum efficiency. All your progress is saved locally for continuous play. Test your spatial logic and memory in ZyloShift. Slide blocks and align arrows!

games.name: Soccer Target Rush
games.description:
Soccer Target Rush is a focused arcade-style football challenge built around precision shots, timing, and a clear objective. The gameplay is simple and easy to understand: kick the ball toward a target and complete all attempts within a limited time.

The player is given 8 attempts to kick the ball toward the target. Each shot sends the ball toward a random point, which means every attempt requires attention and readiness to react to the outcome. Because of this randomness, the gameplay remains dynamic while still keeping the core objective clear and consistent.

The main task is to complete all 8 kicks successfully within the given time. A timer is always active during the session, adding pressure and requiring quick decisions. You need to act efficiently and use every attempt without hesitation. If the player manages to complete all 8 kicks before the timer reaches zero, the game ends with a victory screen and displays the results.

However, if the time runs out before all attempts are used, the game immediately restarts. This creates a clear success and failure condition, making each session focused and goal-oriented. The combination of limited attempts and time restriction ensures that every action matters and every second counts.

Soccer Target Rush follows the classic arcade principle of simple rules combined with skill-based execution, where accuracy and timing play a key role in achieving results ([tintedwindowsmusic.com][1]). The structure remains compact and easy to follow, allowing players to quickly understand the objective and jump straight into the gameplay.

The visual presentation supports the experience with a clean and clear design. The ball, target, and playing area are easy to recognize, helping you stay focused on your actions and timing. This clarity ensures that each attempt feels direct and responsive.

The game is built around repetition and improvement. Each session gives you another chance to complete all 8 shots faster and more efficiently. The more you play, the better your reaction and timing become, allowing you to achieve better results.

Soccer Target Rush delivers a straightforward and engaging football arcade experience. Kick the ball, complete all 8 attempts, beat the timer, and reach the final result screen. Stay focused, act quickly, and complete the challenge within the time limit. Kick 8 balls to the target before time runs out.

Bead 16 - Sholo Guti brings the traditional Bengali board game to your phone — pick up beads, jump captures, and outsmart your opponent. Three classic variants in one polished app.

🎯 THREE GAMES IN ONE
• Sholo Guti (Bead 16) — the original 16-bead capture game played across South Asia for centuries
• Baro Guti (Bead 12) — faster 12-bead variant on a smaller board, same deep strategy
• Baagh Chal — asymmetric Tigers vs. Soldiers from Nepal: 4 tigers hunt, 20 soldiers trap

🤖 PLAY HOW YOU LIKE
• VS AI — three difficulty levels (Easy 🥉, Medium 🥈, Hard 🥇) with smart move evaluation
• Local multiplayer — pass-and-play on one device with a friend
• Online multiplayer — challenge real players, in-game chat, leaderboards (coming soon)

✨ DESIGNED FOR EVERY PLAYER
• Bilingual interface — English & বাংলা
• Five board themes: Classic Wood, Modern Dark, Premium Green, Royal Purple, Ocean Blue
• Tap-to-move and Drag-and-drop control schemes

📜 LEARN AS YOU PLAY
Built-in tutorials walk you through movement, capturing, multi-jumps, and tips for every variant. New to traditional board games? You'll be capturing beads in minutes.

🏆 BUILT FOR FOCUS
• No forced sign-up — play instantly
• Lightweight under 100MB

A tribute to a centuries-old folk game from Bengal, rebuilt for today's screens. Whether you grew up playing on the dirt with stones and pebbles, or you're discovering Sholo Guti for the first time, this is the home for the game on Android.

ABOUT BEAD 16 / SHOLO GUTI
"Sholo Guti" literally means "sixteen pieces" in Bengali. Played on a Char Goti board with sixteen beads per side, the goal is simple: capture every opposing bead by jumping over it onto an empty point. Multiple captures in a single turn are allowed and rewarded. The game has roots in rural Bengal and continues to be played at family gatherings, tea stalls, and now — on your phone.

Baagh Chal ("Tiger Move") is a Nepali variant where four tigers must capture five soldiers while soldiers try to immobilize the tigers. A pure asymmetric strategy game.

PERFECT FOR:
✅ Strategy & board game lovers
✅ Players nostalgic for childhood folk games
✅ Anyone learning traditional South Asian games
✅ Couples & families wanting a quick local match
✅ Online players hunting fresh asynchronous strategy
✅ Bengali, Bangladeshi & diaspora players

PERMISSIONS
We only request what's necessary: internet for online play, ads, and notifications. No contacts, no camera, no microphone, no location reading beyond what advertising uses.

SUPPORT & FEEDBACK

Found a bug? Have a feature idea? Tell us — we read every message.

games.name: Fenster-Das Karten-Trinkspiel
games.description:
🍺 WINDOW – The Card Drinking Game
🎯 Game Objective

The players work together to correctly reveal all the cards in the "window."

They guess whether the face-down cards are higher, lower, the same, between, or outside the range of the already revealed cards.

Mistakes are penalized – correct guesses bring security or the opportunity to pass the turn.
... 🃏 Game Setup

The game is played with cards from 7 to Ace.

Each card appears exactly 4 times in the game.

The cards are laid out in a 5x5 square.

Only the edges are filled with cards; the center is empty.

At the start, two opposite corner cards are face up.

All other cards are face down.

▶ Gameplay

1️⃣ Choose a card
A player clicks on a face-down card that is directly adjacent to one or two face-up cards.
The adjacent face-up cards determine which choices are allowed.

2️⃣ Possible choices
🔹 One adjacent face-up card
The player may choose:
Higher
Lower
Equal
🔹 Two adjacent face-up cards
The player may choose:
Between (between the two cards in value)
Outside (lower than both or higher than both)
Equal (equal to one of the two cards)

3️⃣ Reveal card
The chosen card is Revealed

The game automatically checks whether the decision was correct or incorrect.

✅ Correct Decision

The card remains face up.
The player may continue playing.
🔁 After two correctly guessed cards in a row, the player may voluntarily pass to the next player.
👉 This is optional – the player can also continue playing themselves.

❌ Incorrect Decision

All connected revealed cards belonging to this turn are removed.

These cards are replaced with new face-down cards.

The other corner of the playing area remains untouched.

🍻 Drinking Rule

👉 The player must take as many sips as cards were removed.

Example:

3 connected cards are replaced → 3 sips

🔁 Cards & Probability

Removed cards are returned to the deck.
The deck is reshuffled.
This ensures:
No card appears more often than allowed.
Probabilities remain fair.

🏁 End of Round

When all cards in the window have been revealed:
The playing area is reshuffled.
A hint appears: "EX"

This means that if a player makes a mistake, they have to chug their drink.

🧠 Important Notes

A player can play in multiple areas simultaneously. Mistakes only affect the connected cards in that area. No one has to drink if they guess correctly (unfortunately 😏).

Have fun! 🍻🤯 Reveal cards in the rectangle / Guess higher - lower / Wrong sip of drink

games.name: Dread peak
games.description:
Welcome to Dread peak, a chilling survival horror experience that throws you into the depths of an unforgiving Antarctic wasteland. In this horror game, you play as a lone investigator sent to uncover the truth behind CORE’s last, ill-fated expedition. What you find buried beneath the ice is not just a collapsed research facility—but something far more terrifying. Inspired by classic analog horror and VHS-era horror, this immersive experience combines atmospheric dread, psychological tension, and creature-driven fear in ways that will haunt you long after the game ends.
Unravel CORE’s Dark Secrets
Traverse the harsh, icy terrain of Antarctica in search of what remains of the CORE expedition. This isn’t just a test of endurance—it’s a battle against madness. Every echoing footstep and shadowed corridor amplifies the creeping sense of dread. You’ll need to stay sharp, as each discovery brings you deeper into a mystery rooted in analog horror, scientific obsession, and unspeakable fear.
Whether you’re combing through frozen labs, deciphering journals stained by frostbite, or descending into dark caves carved by something inhuman, the story unfolds through a VHS-style horror aesthetic that plunges you into a surreal and unsettling world. Static-laced screens, glitchy recordings, and distorted audio give Dread peak its signature analog horror feel—an immersive style that elevates every scare.
Solve Cryptic Puzzles & Survive the Cold
Your survival depends on more than just running from the monster. You’ll need to solve challenging puzzles to unlock key areas, repair broken machinery, and piece together the wreckage of a Zeppelin that may be your only escape. These puzzles are embedded within a terrifying landscape where time is always against you, and the cold isn't your only enemy. Each piece of the puzzle is a breadcrumb in a story that weaves horror, science fiction, and psychological dread into a uniquely twisted narrative.
Relentless Creature Encounters
No horror game is complete without a monster—and in Dread peak, it’s one you’ll never forget. The creature doesn’t just hunt; it stalks. It listens, learns, and lurks. Within the echoing silence of the cave systems, your every breath may be the one that gives you away. Its grotesque form, flickering across old security monitors in VHS-quality grain, only adds to the terror. Whether you’re hiding in a narrow crevice or sprinting across a frozen chasm, you’ll feel the creature’s presence—relentless, unknowable, and nightmarish.
This is survival horror at its finest: tension, timing, and terror.
Meet the Last Survivors
Not everyone perished. As you explore, you’ll encounter broken, haunted NPCs—each clinging to sanity in their own way. Through disturbing dialogue and tragic backstories, you’ll unravel the deeper motives behind CORE’s experiments. Who is still human? Who is hiding something? Their cryptic insights, combined with analog horror-style environmental storytelling, paint a picture far worse than you imagined.
Immersive Horror, Analog-Style
Blending the aesthetics of VHS horror with the immersive gameplay of classic survival horror, Dread peak delivers an atmospheric masterpiece. Limited resources force tough choices. The ever-present cold and the unpredictability of the creature keep you on edge. And the haunting analog visuals—complete with visual distortion, screen tearing, and eerie magnetic warping—create an experience that feels pulled from an unearthed tape, lost to time. Dreadpeak Guardian Horror Game

games.name: Downfall - Offline Word Puzzle
games.description:
Downfall is a strategic offline word puzzle game and brain training challenge where finding the words is only half the challenge.

Trace letters across the grid to find words. When a word is found, its tiles are removed and everything above cascades down. Simple to learn, but the order you solve the words in changes the entire board. Choose wrong and you'll reach a dead end with no way out.

This isn't a word search or a crossword. Downfall is a letter puzzle that rewards strategy and planning over speed. Every level is a logic problem disguised as a word game.

HOW TO PLAY

Find words by tracing a path through adjacent letters, similar to Boggle or word connect games. Tiles fall when a word is cleared, shifting the grid. Find all the words to complete the level. Stuck? Use a hint or undo your last move and try a different approach.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Unlike most word games, Downfall isn't about finding as many words as possible. Every level has a specific set of words and a specific order that works. Spot the pattern, plan ahead, and clear the board. One wrong move and the whole puzzle changes.

As you progress through chapters, new tile types unlock that change the rules. Stone tiles are shared between words and take multiple clears to remove. Wildcard tiles match any letter. Each new tile type adds a layer to the strategy.

DAILY CHALLENGE

A new puzzle drops every day, harder than the standard levels. Your score is calculated based on time, undos used, hints used and how often you got trapped. Compete on the global leaderboard and see how you rank against players worldwide.

FEATURES

- Hundreds of puzzles across multiple chapters
- New tile types unlock as you progress
- Undo any move and rethink your approach
- Daily word challenge with a global leaderboard
- Fully offline, no internet or wifi required (excludes daily challenge)
- No account needed, no sign up required
- No timers, play at your own pace
- Free to play brain training word game

WHO IS IT FOR?

IQ MAXX is the daily IQ test + cognitive training app.

Take a 27-question multi-domain test in about 15 minutes. Get your score, percentile, and 4-domain cognitive profile. Then train daily across Pattern recognition, Numerical reasoning, Verbal ability, and Memory — and retake the full test every two weeks to see how your score moves.

WHAT'S INSIDE

— 27-question IQ test across 4 cognitive domains
— Your IQ score, percentile, and Gaussian-curve placement
— 4-domain cognitive profile: Pattern · Numerical · Verbal · Memory
— Daily training rotations to build a streak
— Bi-weekly retests to track score growth over time
— Progress charts and full session history
— Wrong-answer reviews with worked explanations

HOW IT WORKS

The test uses validated psychometric item types — Raven-style matrix reasoning, digit span, spatial sequence, verbal analogies — the same families used in clinical assessment. Your score is calibrated against the standard normal distribution, with a mean of 100 and σ of 15, using a difficulty-weighted model.

After the test, daily training keeps you sharp across all four domains. Bi-weekly retests show how your score actually moves over time.

PRIVACY

No ads. No third-party trackers. No data sold. Your test responses and training history stay on your device. Subscription state is managed by RevenueCat under an anonymous user ID. See the in-app Privacy Policy for the full breakdown.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

— Monthly: $12.99/month
— Annual: $59.99/year (saves 62% vs monthly)

Both plans unlock the full app. Cancel anytime in iPhone Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

games.description:
My 4-year-old wanted to play checkers on a table. I searched the App Store for a checkers game with no ads and no in-app purchases — and couldn't find one. So I decided to build it myself.

To make it more fun for a little kid, I added playful capture animations, color themes, and a silly bunny character who watches the game and reacts to what's happening on the board. My daughter suggested that captured pieces should look like actual pieces, not numbers — she can already count, but can't read digits yet. That small idea made the whole game feel better.

I also added flexible rule settings to cover all the major checkers variants played around the world:

• English (American) checkers — short kings, forward captures only
• Russian checkers — flying kings, backward captures, promotion during chain
• Brazilian checkers — flying kings with majority capture rule
• Italian checkers — short kings, men cannot capture kings
• Pool checkers — flying kings with immediate piece removal

Each rule can also be toggled individually, so you can mix and match to create your own variant.

Difficulty levels range from truly Easy (random moves — perfect for toddlers just learning the game) to Pro (minimax AI that plays several moves ahead). There's also a brief stats screen after each match so kids can see how they did.

Features:
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No tracking. Ever.
• Play vs AI or pass-and-play with a friend
• 4 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Pro
• 5 rule presets + individual rule toggles
• 3 color themes: Pastel, Bright, Cotton Candy
