• Symmetric shoot-the-moon. If the AI would attempt it, you can too - and vice versa. The AI never silently blocks a moon shot it would try for itself.

• Hint button anytime. Tap it to see which card the Hard AI would play in your position, with a one-line reason. Hints cost 10 coins each - meaningful but cheap.

• Undo your last card on your own turn, before any opponent play changes hidden information.

HOW THE COIN SYSTEM WORKS

• Start with 500 coins. Each new game costs 50.
• Wins pay back 100 coins. Shoot the moon for 200.
• Get 50 free coins every day, automatically - no daily-bonus modal to dismiss.
• One $0.99 unlock removes the per-game cost forever. Coins keep accumulating after you buy it; they just stop gating play.

That is the entire monetization. No coin packs, no boosters, no "watch an ad to play another hand." A single optional unlock and the daily refresh.

CORE GAMEPLAY

• Standard Hearts and Omnibus (Jack of Diamonds = −10) rule variants.
• Pass rotation: Left → Right → Across → Keep, plus a No-pass toggle.
• Configurable game length: 50 (default), 100, or 150 points.
• Autosave after every card - resume your game after a phone call, a force-quit, or a relaunch. No lost hands.

PRESENTATION

• Seventeen card backs, clean green felt.
• Universal binary for iPhone and iPad. Portrait and landscape. Not a stretched phone UI.
• Dark mode supported.
• Random animal-emoji opponent avatars - different cast every match.
• Haptic feedback on iPhone.

WHAT THIS APP IS NOT

• Not ad-supported. No ads, ever.
• Not subscription-based. No recurring charges.
• No coin packs, no boosters, no second-tier monetization. The Unlimited Play unlock is the only purchase.
• No accounts, no sign-in, no Apple ID prompts, no iCloud prompts, no analytics opt-in modals.
• No multiplayer, no servers. Just you versus three AI opponents.

Free to download. Optional $0.99 unlock removes the 50-coin per-game cost. Family Sharing enabled - one purchase covers the household. The only Hearts app where the AI cheats only if you ask it to. TWO RULE MODES

Bao la Kujifunza - the "learning" version. The board starts with two seeds in every pit, the rules are streamlined, and there is no opening phase. Perfect if you are new to bao or just want a quick game.

Bao la Kiswahili - the full traditional rule set. Includes the namua opening (each player has 22 seeds in hand), the special nyumba (house) pit with taxation and safari, mandatory captures, multilap relay sowing, kichwa relay after capture, kuendelea continuation, kutakatia blocking, and the classic "more than 15 seeds" rule. Modeled on the Zanzibari rules transcribed by Alex de Voogt.

LEARNING THE GAME

Bao rewards planning many laps ahead. If you are starting out, play a few games of Kujifunza against the Beginner opponent to internalize the way multilap relays cascade and how captures relay back from a kichwa. When that feels comfortable, switch to Kiswahili to learn the namua opening and the rhythm of the nyumba.

PRIVACY

The app does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It does not require an internet connection. No accounts, no third-party SDKs, no ads, no analytics. The East African mancala

It relies on a Foundry VTT module, the "Companion Bridge", to connect to your game and provide real-time updates to your character sheets, and interactions with your spells and items.

The "Companion Bridge" module is installed on your Foundry VTT server. It acts as a bridge between the server and the mobile app, enabling real-time synchronisation. The module is available in both free and premium versions, offering different levels of functionality and integration with Foundry VTT.
With the free version, all connected players can view their stats, inventory, and spells as they change in Foundry. Players can also change the local state of their character (HP, spell slots, exhaustion, ...), however, it does not include the possibility to send changes to Foundry, cast spells, use items, etc.
The premium version unlocks full two-way updates, rest mechanisms, complete roll integration, items, features, and spells usage, and so much more! It also helps us continue developing, maintaining the app and adding new features.

If you're interested or want some more information, don't hesitate to visit our Patreon or the wiki page :) A Foundry VTT Mobile Companion

ChessP2P is the chess app that works when nothing else does — on a plane, in a tunnel, deep in the basement, halfway up a mountain. Two iPhones pair directly over Bluetooth or peer-to-peer Wi-Fi. No internet, no accounts, no ads. Just open and play.

- Saved games — pick up where you left off if you get disconnected.
- No accounts. No login. No tracking. No ads. No nags.

How it works:

1. Open ChessP2P on both phones.
2. One taps Host, the other taps Join. Connect over Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi.
3. Play. Moves sync instantly between devices.

That's the whole onboarding. If you've ever spent five minutes trying to play chess on a plane and watched every "offline" chess app demand a connection, this is the app you wanted.

Built for real offline.

ChessP2P uses Apple's MultipeerConnectivity — direct device-to-device. No servers. No router. No Wi-Fi network required. The two phones find each other directly, even in airplane mode (just keep Bluetooth on).

If a peer drops out, the game is saved on both sides. Reconnect and it picks up where it left off.

Free, with optional premium.

The full chess experience above is free, with no ads. A one-time premium unlock will add board and piece themes, expanded clock presets, multiple concurrent games, and post-game analysis. Pay once, unlock for life — no subscriptions. When you play a friend in a P2P session, your premium features extend to them for the duration of the game; they never have to pay to play with you.

Perfect for flights and airplane mode, subway commutes, cafés where the Wi-Fi is "ask the bartender," camping trips, festivals, and casual games between friends, parents and kids, or anyone learning the game.

games.name: Dual Knights
games.description:
In the mystical realm of Dualaria, two ancient orders of knights maintained the delicate balance between the primordial forces of fire and water. For millennia, the Flame Knights and Aqua Knights served as guardians of their respective elements, dwelling in opposing temples at the far edges of the kingdom.

Legend spoke of a catastrophic event known as the Sundering, when a powerful artifact called the Equilibrium Crystal shattered into countless sigils, scattering across the land. This crystal had once kept the elemental forces in perfect harmony, but its destruction threatened to plunge the world into chaos.

Two knights – Flame and Aqua – discovered that they shared a unique bond through the crystal's magic. When one moved, the other was compelled to move in the opposite direction, as if they were reflections in nature's grand mirror. What seemed at first like a curse revealed itself to be a blessing, for only through this connected opposition could they hope to restore balance to their realm.

Together, they embarked on a sacred quest to collect the scattered sigils. Each pair of sigils they gathered would restore a small measure of harmony to Dualaria. Their journey became known as the Mirror Quest, where every step forward by one knight required an equal step in the opposite direction by the other – a dance of fire and water, a puzzle of movement and cooperation.

The knights learned that their seemingly contrary movements were not a hindrance but a representation of the natural order itself: for every action, there must be an equal and opposite reaction. Only by embracing this fundamental truth could they hope to restore the Equilibrium Crystal and bring peace back to their troubled land.

Now, Flame and Aqua travel across Dualaria, navigating increasingly complex paths to reach their designated sigils. Their quest serves as a reminder that opposing forces need not be enemies – indeed, they are essential partners in maintaining the balance of all things. Mirror movement puzzle game

games.description:
Welcome to Malacañang, Mr. / Madam President. You have six years. Don’t mess it up.

Step into the highest office in the land in this wildly strategic, deeply satirical political rogue-like engine-builder!

You have exactly two motions (action) per year to build a legacy, balance the national budget, and keep the public from ousting you. Will you be the "Grassroots Hope" who relies on the love of the masses, or "The Iron Fist" with infinite manpower but zero public trust?

Draft from a deck of 50+ Project Cards to build your political engine. Sign a BPO Tax Holiday to secure long-term funds, rush a Mega-Dam Project, or take the easy way out and accept a China Debt Trap for instant cash (just don't ask about the interest rate).

But in Philippine politics, the math isn't your only enemy. Every year, you must pass a Krisis Check—from a devastating Jeepney Tigil-Pasada to a terrifying Senate Blue Ribbon Probe. If your infrastructure, trust, or welfare tracks are too low, your administration will suffer catastrophic penalties.

And just when you think you've balanced the books? The Delubyo hits.
Face a brutal RNG chance every year of enduring typhoons, El Niño droughts, or a random MRT-3 breakdown. Do you spend your precious budget to mitigate the disaster, or take the raw hit and pray you have enough approval ratings to survive?

KEY FEATURES:

Rogue-like Engine Building: See 5 random Project Cards a year. With only 12 actions per game, every single click matters. Can't afford the EDSA Subway? Sell it to the market for a free action to fund your survival!

Dual-Threat System: Anticipate the yearly Krisis thresholds, but stay paranoid about the unpredictable chance of a Delubyo disaster.

Reiner Knizia-Style Scoring: A thriving economy means nothing if your healthcare system is zero. Your final score is heavily penalized by your lowest performing track. You must balance Tibay (Infrastructure), Ginhawa (Welfare), and Tiwala (Trust) to win.

Mandates: Start your run as "The Unity Successor", "The Balimbing Coalition", "The People Power Icon" and many more. Every mandate completely changes your starting economy and strategy.

The Compendium: Track your progress! Play to unlock the hidden silhouettes of all 50 Project Cards, Delubyos, and Crises in your interactive compendium.

Card counting won’t save you from a super typhoon, and money can't buy your way out of a Missing Health Funds scandal.

games.name: Book, please
games.description:
BookPlease is not about “tap and get a reward.” It is about the morning when there is already a line at the door, the collection is short on a popular genre, a reader’s card is overdue, and the display shipment is still on its way. You are the owner of a private library: you are behind the counter yourself, and the rules are fair — but carelessness gets expensive.

Serve visitors at the counter: check books out, extend loans, refuse requests with a reason — and every action is checked against the database and the collection. Make a mistake, and you get a fine, an entry in the error log, and a hit to trust and reputation. Do everything by the book, and the cash register comes alive while readers keep coming back.

Manage your readers and your collection: copies on the shelf, statuses, repairs, courier returns, and batches “in transit.” Order books from the online store, catch shortages by genre, handle online reservations, and do not let down the readers who arrive on the promised dates. At the bank, you have a credit line, required payments, and a deposit: without money, you cannot expand; without discipline, you will hit the ceiling.

Each in-game day can begin with a daily goal: a calm plan, a focus on accuracy, or a risky challenge with a reward — depending on your style and the state of your cash flow. Hire staff, pay salaries, and grow their skills. Unlock achievements and move toward the big goal: buying out the premises. It is not decoration, but a financial and reputational peak.

A warm paper-like interface, an error log with no surprises, and rules you can read inside the game. Want to calmly catalogue the collection? You can. Want to squeeze everything out of a risky day? You can do that too. The main thing is simple: do not promise a reader what is not in the collection.

BookPlease is a library as a job: attentive, a little strict, and deeply satisfying when everything adds up at the end of the day.

games.name: Prior: Calibration Trainer
games.description:
Most people think they're better at predicting the future than they actually are. A perfect predictor knows the quality of their predictions, and you can rely on their 80% forecasts to be right exactly 80% of the time. This skill is called calibration. 
THE ENGINE
An infinite question bank spanning science, economics, technology, history, sports, and culture. For every question, you don't just answer true or false; you state how confident you are. That confidence is what Prior measures.
Binary mode tests your true/false predictions with a confidence slider. Continuous mode (Prior Pro) asks you to estimate ranges - the harder, more revealing challenge that separates calibrated thinkers from lucky guessers.
THE CALIBRATION CURVE
Your calibration curve is the most honest thing about you. It shows whether the things you believe with 80% confidence actually happen 80% of the time. Most people are overconfident at high confidence levels - their curve bends away from perfect. Prior makes that visible.
THE JOURNAL
Track your real-world predictions - markets, elections, sports, personal decisions. Set a resolution date, state your confidence, come back when the answer is known. Your journal builds a permanent record of your forecasting history, scored alongside your engine training.
THE LEADERBOARD
Compete globally against other forecasters ranked by Brier score.
PRIOR PRO
Unlimited continuous (range estimate) questions, full calibration curve with domain breakdown, Brier trend over time, confidence distribution analysis, unlimited journal predictions, and a Pro badge on the global leaderboard.
Free users get unlimited binary training, basic stats, and up to 10 active journal predictions.
PRIVACY
No advertising. No data sold. Optional account for leaderboard access - anonymous training requires no sign-in.

games.name: Chance Knight
games.description:
Welcome to Chance Knight. This application is a mini game designed for those who want to practice speed arithmetic checks and test their mental calculation abilities.

Gameplay mechanics and process:
The main task in the game is to evaluate mathematical equations under time pressure. Each round presents you with a simple addition or subtraction problem that includes a suggested total result. Your goal is to decide whether the equality is mathematically correct or incorrect before the timer reaches zero.

Rules of the game:
You start each session with a time limit of two seconds per question. To give your answer you must tap the True button if you believe the equation is correct or tap the False button if it is wrong. Accuracy is key because providing one wrong answer or failing to answer before time runs out will immediately end your current run.

Increasing challenge:
The game features a dynamic difficulty system. Every correct decision you make slightly shortens the time limit for the subsequent question. This creates a challenging environment where you must maintain focus and process information faster as you progress. The primary goal is to chain as many correct decisions as possible while the timer keeps getting tighter.

Tracking your progress:
During the game you can monitor your current score and the remaining time on the screen. Once a run is finished, the application displays a summary screen showing exactly how many answers you cleared during that session. From this screen you can choose to use the Try again button to start a new attempt or return to the main menu.

Visual and interface:
The game features a clear interface with prominent buttons for comfortable interaction. The background elements include thematic illustrations with palm trees and treasure chests which accompany the mathematical tasks. Chance Knight offers a simple way to spend time while engaging your brain in quick calculation exercises. Test your speed arithmetic skills and improve your reaction in Chance Knight.

games.name: Fortune Hunter
games.description:
Welcome to Fortune Hunter. This application is a mini game designed to test your reaction time and visual attention through a simple grid interface.

What you do in the game:
The gameplay takes place on a three by three grid. During the round tiles light up in a random order. Most of these pulses are blue and stay visible for a short moment. Your task is to tap these blue tiles while they glow to register a successful hit. However, you must remain observant because sometimes a tile stays red for two full seconds. You should never tap a red tile as this is a core rule of the game.

Round flow and mechanics:
Each session runs on a timer that counts down. A round ends naturally when the clock reaches zero. If you successfully survive the countdown you will automatically move to the second screen to see your results. Please note that if you accidentally tap a red tile, the round stops immediately and you advance to the results screen early.

Tracking your results:
The second screen provides a clear summary of your performance. It displays the number of successful blue taps you earned in the most recent round. Additionally, the app keeps track of your running total of successful taps across every finished round you have played on your device.

Quick rules to remember:

Tap blue pulses before they fade away.

Leave red pulses alone until they disappear from the grid.

Survive the full countdown or accept an early stop if a red tile is touched.

Use the Play again button for another round or return to the main menu when you are done.

Fortune Hunter offers a focused experience where staying calm and reading the rhythm of the pulses helps you maintain a high success rate. Test your attention and reaction speed by catching blue pulses in Fortune Hunter

games.name: Treasure Map
games.description:
Welcome to Treasure Map. This application features a Ten second Tap Sprint mini game designed to test your speed and consistency through a simple interactive interface.

The primary objective of the game is to tap the teal circle as many times as possible during a live ten second countdown. Every legal tap you perform increases your score in real time. Your goal is to achieve the highest tap count before the timer reaches zero.

The application process consists of several stages. The first screen streams the active countdown, your running total of taps, and the large tap target. You must focus on tapping only the designated circle while the timer remains above 0 seconds. Each tap is counted exactly once throughout the duration of the sprint.

When the time expires, the app automatically forwards you to the results dashboard. This summary screen allows you to review your performance by displaying the following data points:

Taps achieved during the current round.

Your clicks per second (CPS) pace, calculated as total taps divided by ten.

Your saved personal record for total taps.

Your all time best clicks per second (CPS) rate.

After reviewing your summary, you can choose to use the Play again button to start a new sprint and chase a stronger record. Alternatively, you can close the summary to return to the main menu. Treasure Map provides a straightforward way to track and improve your tapping speed over time. Test your speed in Treasure Map by tapping the target during a 10 second sprint

Rope Cut Jam – A Satisfying Rope Cutting Puzzle

Get ready for a colorful grid-based puzzle challenge where every move matters! In Rope Cut Jam, ropes twist across the board like snakes, cutters slide in straight lines, and your goal is to find the perfect order to cut every rope.

Each level is filled with colorful ropes, sharp cutters, clever blockers, and tricky mechanics. Tap a cutter, send it forward, and watch it move across the grid. But be careful — cutters can only cut ropes that match their own color. If they hit the wrong rope, another cutter, or an obstacle, they bounce back!

Plan your moves, clear the path, and solve each rope-cutting puzzle before the board gets too crowded.

How to Play
Tap a cutter to launch it in its direction
Cutters move straight until they hit something
Match the cutter color with the rope color to cut it
When a rope is cut, all of its connected points disappear
Wrong-color ropes block the cutter and make it return
Other cutters can block the path too
Clear all ropes to complete the level
Puzzle Elements

As you progress, new mechanics make every level more strategic:

Hidden Ropes
Some rope parts are hidden until you reveal the right move.

Mirror
Mirrors change the way cutters move and create more complex puzzle paths.

Pole
Poles block the board and force you to think around them.

Stacked Cutters
Multiple cutters can be stacked on the same tile, creating deeper move-order puzzles.

Lock & Keys
Find the right keys to unlock blocked ropes, cutters, or paths.

Boosters

Need a little help on a difficult level? Use powerful boosters:

Hint
Get a helpful clue when you are stuck.

Scissors
Cut through the puzzle with a direct solution tool when the board gets tricky.

Game Features
Unique rope-cutting puzzle gameplay
Simple tap controls
Color-matching strategy
Satisfying rope-cut animations
Grid-based levels with clever move ordering
Fun blockers, locks, mirrors, and hidden elements
Easy to learn, hard to master
Relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle experience
Perfect for fans of logic games, color puzzles, and satisfying cut games

Think before you tap, match the right colors, and clear every rope from the board.

Can you solve every Rope Cut Jam puzzle? Tap cutters, match rope colors, and solve satisfying puzzles!

Immersive Sci-Fi Story: Every puzzle is tied to repairing a specific part of the ship. You aren't just moving numbers; you are fixing the life support.

100% PREMIUM EXPERIENCE:
bis - 010 respects you and your time.

No Advertisements.

No In-App Purchases.

No Data Collection or Tracking.

Play entirely offline.

Pay once, and the complete game is yours forever.

games.name: Zabble - Word Chain Puzzle
games.description:
Zabble is a daily word puzzle for people who love language, chains, and the satisfying click of a word that just fits.

Every day you get a single letter and a target word. Your job: build a chain between them by adding one letter at a time, forming a real word at every step. Short and sweet on Monday. A seven‑letter beast by Sunday.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Start with the day's letter.
• Insert one new letter to make a longer valid word.
• Keep extending — every step has to be a real word.
• Reach the bonus word to clear the round and earn your stars.
• Keep going into Bonus Mode for extra points after the target.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY

EXPLORE MODE
Not in the mood for today's daily? Dip into:
• Challenges — themed rounds (Food & Drink, Animals, Travel, Science, and more). Build words that fit the category to rack up theme bonuses.
• Practice — unlimited random puzzles. No streaks, no pressure, just play.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Stars and scores for every day you play.
• Streak counter that rewards showing up.
• Weekly heat‑map of your runs.
• Tap any day to replay your chain, look up the bonus word, and share your result.

iCLOUD SYNC
Your stats, streaks, and full chain history sync seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac. Start on one device, finish on another — the score, the chain, and the recap all travel with you.

APPLE WATCH
A real watch app, not a glorified notification. See today's letter, target length, and your current score at a glance.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Today's puzzle status, your streak, and your latest score — right on your home screen.

ZABBLE PREMIUM
• Remove all ads.
• Unlimited Practice rounds.
• All Explore challenges unlocked.
• Replay missed days from earlier in the week.
• One‑time purchase or subscription, your call.

MADE WITH CARE

• Built natively for iOS, iPadOS, watchOS — no compromises.
• Words validated against a real dictionary, not auto‑generated nonsense.
• No accounts. No friend graph. Just you and the puzzle.
